en: We bought a second-hand sofa and it’s perfect.
ru: Мы купили подержанный диван, и он отличный.
meaning: not new; already used by someone else
ex: In this market you can sell second-hand gear to other players.

en: I’ll post my stream schedule in the chat tonight.
ru: Сегодня вечером я выложу в чате расписание своих стримов.
meaning: A plan that lists when things will happen.
ex: My work schedule changes every week.

en: If someone is rude in chat, just block them.
ru: Если кто-то грубит в чате, просто заблокируй его.
meaning: to stop someone from contacting you online
ex: Please block that website, it is full of ads.

en: You lost one round. Let it go and focus on the next one.
ru: Ты проиграл один раунд. Отпусти это и сосредоточься на следующем.
meaning: Stop being angry or worried about something.
ex: It was a small mistake, so let it go.

en: I’m going to go for the headshot, cover me.
ru: Я попробую сделать хедшот, прикройте меня.
meaning: to choose something, or try to get it
ex: I’ll go for the pasta, what about you?
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We need to clean up the kitchen before the guests arrive.
ru: Нужно прибраться на кухне, пока не пришли гости.
meaning: to make a place tidy
ex: I’ll clean up the last enemies while you open the chest.

en: Her advice had an impact on my career.
ru: Её совет сильно повлиял на мою карьеру.
meaning: to have a strong effect on something
ex: Every choice in this game has an impact on the ending.

en: We’ll never finish this level. Just kidding, we’re almost there!
ru: Мы никогда не пройдём этот уровень. Шучу, мы почти у цели!
meaning: Said to show that you were not serious.
ex: I’m moving to Mars next week. Just kidding!

en: I’d say this is the best game of the year so far.
ru: По-моему, это лучшая игра года на данный момент.
meaning: used to give an opinion in a careful way
ex: I’d say the party was a success.

en: You can count on us, we’ll be online at eight sharp.
ru: Ты можешь на нас рассчитывать: мы будем в сети ровно в восемь.
meaning: to be sure that someone will do what you need
ex: I’m counting on you to bring the tickets.

en: There was a long queue at the supermarket.
ru: В супермаркете стояла длинная очередь.
meaning: a line of people waiting for something
ex: We’ve been in the queue for the server for twenty minutes.

en: The event has a deadline, so we need to finish it by Sunday.
ru: У ивента есть крайний срок, так что нужно закончить его до воскресенья.
meaning: The latest time by which something must be done.
ex: I have a deadline on Friday for the report.

en: Send me the link and I’ll join your game right away.
ru: Скинь мне ссылку, и я сразу зайду в твою игру.
meaning: a web address you can click
ex: I’ll add the link to the report in the email.

en: If you don’t buy tickets for the tournament now, you’ll miss the boat.
ru: Если не купишь билеты на турнир сейчас, упустишь шанс.
meaning: Lose a chance by being too slow.
ex: I missed the boat on that cheap flight, and now it costs double.

en: Prices have gone up a lot since last year.
ru: С прошлого года цены сильно выросли.
meaning: to increase or rise
ex: Your level goes up every time you finish a quest.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The teacher is giving out the exam papers.
ru: Учитель раздаёт экзаменационные листы.
meaning: to hand something to each person in a group
ex: The game gives out free coins every day.

en: Should we take a risk and open the chest without checking for traps?
ru: Рискнём и откроем сундук, не проверяя на ловушки?
meaning: to do something that might have a bad result
ex: He took a risk and left his job to start a business.

en: Don’t panic, we still have two lives left.
ru: Без паники, у нас ещё две жизни.
meaning: Do not become frightened and lose control.
ex: Don’t panic, the keys are probably in your other bag.

en: From my point of view, working from home is more productive.
ru: С моей точки зрения, работать из дома продуктивнее.
meaning: used to say how you see something
ex: From my point of view, the ranked mode is too stressful.

en: Don’t blame the new guy, we all made mistakes in that fight.
ru: Не вини новичка, мы все ошибались в этом бою.
meaning: to say that someone did something bad or is responsible for it
ex: You can’t blame him for the traffic.

en: The checkout is on the left, next to the exit.
ru: Касса находится слева, рядом с выходом.
meaning: the place in a shop where you pay
ex: Add the item to your cart and go to checkout.

en: It took a while, but eventually we found the right bus.
ru: Это заняло время, но в итоге мы нашли нужный автобус.
meaning: After a long time, or after a lot of effort.
ex: Keep searching, and eventually you’ll find the hidden key.

en: I’ll send you an email with the details after the meeting.
ru: После встречи отправлю тебе письмо с подробностями.
meaning: a message sent over the internet
ex: He checks his email first thing in the morning.

en: I’m still on the fence about buying the expansion.
ru: Я всё ещё сомневаюсь, покупать ли дополнение.
meaning: Not able to decide.
ex: She’s on the fence about moving to another city.

en: Our server keeps going down every time lots of viewers join.
ru: Наш сервер постоянно падает, когда заходит много зрителей.
meaning: to become lower, or to stop working
ex: The temperature will go down tonight.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We set off early to avoid the traffic.
ru: Мы выехали пораньше, чтобы не попасть в пробки.
meaning: to begin a journey; to make something start working
ex: Be careful not to set off the alarm in the vault.

en: Let’s take a break, my coffee is cold and my eyes hurt.
ru: Давай сделаем перерыв, мой кофе остыл, и глаза болят.
meaning: to stop for a short rest
ex: You should take a break every hour if you work at a computer.

en: Stay calm and watch the boss’s pattern.
ru: Сохраняй спокойствие и следи за движениями босса.
meaning: Do not get nervous or angry.
ex: Stay calm and call the number on the card.

en: As for me, I always take the shield.
ru: Что касается меня, я всегда беру щит.
meaning: used to give your own view after others
ex: As for me, I’d rather take the train.

en: My friends tease me because I always pick the cutest character.
ru: Друзья подшучивают надо мной за то, что я всегда выбираю самого милого персонажа.
meaning: to make friendly jokes about someone, often to annoy them a little
ex: Her brothers tease her about her new haircut.

en: Sadly, the rare armor isn’t in stock today.
ru: К сожалению, редкой брони сегодня нет в наличии.
meaning: available to buy in a shop
ex: Do you have this shirt in stock in a larger size?

en: The train is late, so in the meantime let’s get some coffee.
ru: Поезд опаздывает, так что пока давай возьмём кофе.
meaning: During the time before something else happens.
ex: The boss respawns in ten minutes, so in the meantime let’s craft some potions.

en: The result of the match surprised everyone in chat.
ru: Результат матча удивил всех в чате.
meaning: something that happens because of something else
ex: The test results will be ready in two days.

en: Are you serious or are you pulling my leg? You really beat it in one hour?
ru: Ты серьёзно или разыгрываешь меня? Ты правда прошёл это за час?
meaning: Joke with someone by saying something untrue.
ex: Stop pulling my leg, I know you didn’t win the lottery.

en: I’ll go along with your plan, but doubts remain.
ru: Я поддержу твой план, хотя сомнения остаются.
meaning: to agree with someone’s idea or plan
ex: The team went along with my idea to rush the tower.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I want to be a pilot when I grow up.
ru: Я хочу стать пилотом, когда вырасту.
meaning: to change from a child into an adult
ex: He grew up playing arcade games.

en: If we take a chance and go for the final boss now, we might win.
ru: Если мы рискнём и пойдём на финального босса сейчас, то можем выиграть.
meaning: to try something even though it may fail
ex: She took a chance and applied for the job abroad.

en: Before you speak on stage, take a deep breath.
ru: Перед выступлением на сцене сделай глубокий вдох.
meaning: Breathe in slowly to relax.
ex: Take a deep breath, the last jump is the hardest one.

en: Personally, I’d choose the cheaper hotel.
ru: Лично мне ближе отель подешевле.
meaning: used to say this is your own opinion
ex: Personally, I think the new skin looks great.

en: Thanks for the compliment, chat, but we just got lucky.
ru: Спасибо за комплимент, чат, но нам просто повезло.
meaning: a kind thing you say to praise someone
ex: He paid me a compliment on my cooking.

en: The concert tickets are sold out already.
ru: Билеты на концерт уже распроданы.
meaning: with no more left to buy
ex: The limited skin is sold out, so wait for the next season.

en: We need to leave this area as soon as possible, a storm is coming.
ru: Нам нужно покинуть эту зону как можно скорее: надвигается буря.
meaning: As quickly as you can.
ex: Please call me back as soon as possible.

en: Our customer wants the website to be ready by Monday.
ru: Наш клиент хочет, чтобы сайт был готов к понедельнику.
meaning: a person who buys goods or services
ex: A shop in the game lets each customer pick one free item.

en: Take it easy, the boss only has ten percent health left.
ru: Спокойнее, у босса осталось всего десять процентов здоровья.
meaning: Relax; don’t worry or work too hard.
ex: Take it easy this weekend and just rest.

en: We’ll have to go without a healer tonight, he’s offline.
ru: Сегодня придётся обойтись без хилера, его нет в сети.
meaning: to manage when you do not have something
ex: I can go without coffee, but not without sleep.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Please sit down, dinner is ready.
ru: Пожалуйста, садитесь, ужин готов.
meaning: to move into a sitting position
ex: Everyone, sit down on the couch, the final round is starting.

en: He should take responsibility for the mistakes in his report.
ru: Он должен взять на себя ответственность за ошибки в своём отчёте.
meaning: to accept that something is your duty or fault
ex: As team leader, you must take responsibility for the loss in the final round.

en: The bus left already? Better luck next time.
ru: Автобус уже ушёл? В следующий раз повезёт больше.
meaning: Said to someone who failed, hoping they win later.
ex: Better luck next time, we’ll get the chest on the next run.

en: Easy? I wouldn’t say that, this level took an hour.
ru: Лёгкий? Не сказал бы, этот уровень занял час.
meaning: used to politely disagree
tr: не сказал бы, не стал бы так говорить
ex: I wouldn’t say that he’s lazy; he just works slowly.

en: Sorry, we don’t want to let the team down, so we’ll practice more.
ru: Извини, мы не хотим подвести команду, поэтому будем больше тренироваться.
meaning: to disappoint someone by not doing what they expected
ex: I never want to let my family down.

en: The delivery should arrive tomorrow morning.
ru: Доставка должна прийти завтра утром.
meaning: the act of bringing goods to someone’s home
ex: Delivery of your in-game items is instant.

en: I can’t join at the moment, the update is still downloading.
ru: Сейчас я не могу присоединиться: обновление ещё скачивается.
meaning: Right now, at this time.
ex: I’m at work at the moment, can I call you later?

en: Let’s do some training in the practice mode before the real match.
ru: Давай потренируемся в тренировочном режиме перед настоящим матчем.
meaning: teaching or learning a skill or job
ex: The company gives new staff a week of training.

en: Don’t take it for granted that the server will always be free.
ru: Не считай само собой разумеющимся, что сервер всегда будет бесплатным.
meaning: Expect something to always be there and not value it.
ex: We take clean water for granted, but not everyone has it.

en: A bad cold is going around our office this week.
ru: На этой неделе в нашем офисе ходит сильная простуда.
meaning: to spread from person to person
ex: A rumor is going around that the next update adds a new boss.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Speak up, we can’t hear you on voice chat.
ru: Говори громче, мы не слышим тебя в голосовом чате.
meaning: to talk louder; to say what you think
ex: If you disagree, please speak up in the meeting.

en: I’m going to take notes on the boss patterns for next time.
ru: Буду записывать приёмы босса на следующий раз.
meaning: to write down important information
ex: Please take notes during the meeting.

en: It’s not your fault, the game lagged for everyone.
ru: Это не твоя вина, игра тормозила у всех.
meaning: You are not the one who caused the problem.
ex: It’s not your fault the flight was delayed.

en: You’ve got a point, we should check the price first.
ru: Ты прав, сначала надо проверить цену.
meaning: you are right about that
tr: ты прав, в этом что-то есть
ex: You’ve got a point, chat; the mage is stronger than I thought.

en: Chat, we’re really impressed by how fast that player reacts.
ru: Чат, нас впечатляет, как быстро реагирует этот игрок.
meaning: to admire someone or something because it is very good
ex: The teacher was impressed by her essay.

en: I want to return these shoes, they’re too small.
ru: Я хочу вернуть эти туфли, они слишком малы.
meaning: to take something back to a shop
ex: Can I return this item to the shop if I don’t like it?

en: Nowadays most people book their hotels online.
ru: Сейчас большинство людей бронируют отели онлайн.
meaning: In the present time, compared with the past.
ex: Nowadays every game has a battle pass.

en: You need more practice with this character before the tournament.
ru: Тебе нужно больше практики с этим персонажем перед турниром.
meaning: doing something again and again to get better
ex: Speaking English every day is great practice.

expr: the ball is in your court
en: My build is in your inbox, so now the ball is in your court.
ru: Моя сборка уже у тебя в почте, так что теперь твой ход.
meaning: It’s your turn to act or decide.
tr: теперь твой ход, дело за тобой
ex: We made our offer, so the ball is in your court now.
hint: t… b… i… i… y… c…

en: Don’t go after the boss alone, wait for the team.
ru: Не лезь на босса в одиночку, дождись команды.
meaning: to chase or try to get someone or something
ex: You should go after that job if you really want it.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Hurry up, the timer is almost over!
ru: Поторопись, таймер почти вышел!
meaning: to move or act more quickly
ex: Hurry up or we’ll miss the train.

en: The wedding will take place in a small village by the sea.
ru: Свадьба пройдёт в небольшой деревне у моря.
meaning: to happen, especially at a planned time
ex: The final match will take place on Saturday.

en: Don’t apologise, it’s no big deal.
ru: Не извиняйся, ничего страшного.
meaning: It is not important or serious.
ex: It’s no big deal, we’ll just start the level again.

en: So we meet at nine? Exactly, right in front of the station.
ru: Значит, встречаемся в девять? Именно, прямо у вокзала.
meaning: used to strongly agree
ex: Exactly, that’s what I was trying to say about the new patch.

en: We’re satisfied with second place; the other team was better today.
ru: Мы довольны вторым местом: сегодня другая команда была сильнее.
meaning: to feel pleased because something is good enough
ex: Are you satisfied with your new phone?

en: Can I exchange this sweater for a bigger size?
ru: Можно обменять этот свитер на размер побольше?
meaning: to give something and get something else instead
ex: Players can exchange items with each other in the market.

en: Have you played anything good lately?
ru: Ты играешь во что-нибудь хорошее в последнее время?
meaning: During the last few days or weeks.
ex: I’ve been very tired lately.

en: Making videos is a hobby now, but it might become a career one day.
ru: Сейчас монтаж видео — хобби, но когда-нибудь это может стать карьерой.
meaning: the series of jobs a person has in life
ex: Many players dream of a career in esports.

en: We’ve been playing together through thick and thin for ten years.
ru: Мы играем вместе десять лет, в радости и в горе.
meaning: In good times and bad times.
tr: и в горе, и в радости, в любых условиях
ex: She stayed with her friends through thick and thin.

en: That jacket will go with your blue jeans.
ru: Эта куртка подойдёт к твоим синим джинсам.
meaning: to match or suit something
ex: Does this helmet go with my armor?
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Slow down, you’re driving too fast.
ru: Помедленнее, ты едешь слишком быстро.
meaning: to go or happen at a lower speed
ex: Slow down and wait for the boss to finish his attack.

en: Do you want to take part in the tournament next month?
ru: Хочешь принять участие в турнире в следующем месяце?
meaning: to join an activity with other people
ex: Many people take part in the city marathon every year.

en: Pizza or sushi? It’s up to you.
ru: Пицца или суши? Решать тебе.
meaning: You are the one who decides.
ex: It’s up to you, chat, which weapon should I pick?

en: Is this game fun? Absolutely, we play it every night.
ru: Эта игра весёлая? Безусловно, мы играем в неё каждый вечер.
meaning: used to agree strongly
ex: Do you mind if I open the window? Absolutely not.

en: I’m addicted to this game, one more match and I’ll stop. Promise.
ru: Эта игра меня совсем затянула: ещё один матч — и всё, обещаю.
meaning: to be unable to stop doing or using something
ex: He’s addicted to coffee and drinks five cups a day.

en: The phone comes with a two-year guarantee.
ru: На телефон действует двухлетняя гарантия.
meaning: a promise that a product will work or be repaired
ex: There’s no guarantee that you’ll get the rare item from the chest.

en: We’re ahead of schedule, so we can stop for lunch.
ru: Мы идём с опережением графика, так что можем остановиться пообедать.
meaning: Earlier than planned.
ex: We cleared the dungeon ahead of schedule, so the stream can end early.

en: If the game crashes again, contact the support team.
ru: Если игра опять вылетит, свяжись со службой поддержки.
meaning: to get in touch with someone by phone or online
ex: You can contact me by email any time.

en: We have swords, shields, potions, you name it.
ru: У нас есть мечи, щиты, зелья, чего только нет.
meaning: Used to say that anything of that kind is available.
tr: чего только нет, всё что угодно
ex: The market sells fruit, cheese, bread, you name it.

en: I don’t want to go into details now, we’re late.
ru: Не хочу сейчас вдаваться в подробности, мы опаздываем.
meaning: to talk about something in detail, or to enter
ex: Let’s not go into that cave without more potions.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Can I try this jacket on?
ru: Можно примерить эту куртку?
meaning: to wear clothes to see if they fit
ex: Try on the new armor set to see how it looks.

en: I’ll take care of the cat while you’re on holiday.
ru: Я присмотрю за котом, пока вы будете в отпуске.
meaning: to look after someone or something
ex: Take care of the healer, she is our only support.

en: Honestly, waiting in that queue was a waste of time.
ru: Честно говоря, стоять в той очереди было пустой тратой времени.
meaning: Something that gives no useful result.
ex: Fighting the same enemy for an hour is a waste of time.

en: I couldn’t agree more, the service there was terrible.
ru: Полностью согласен, обслуживание там было ужасное.
meaning: I completely agree with you
tr: полностью согласен, не могу не согласиться
ex: I couldn’t agree more, this soundtrack is incredible.

en: Please don’t insult other players in the chat, it ruins the game.
ru: Пожалуйста, не оскорбляйте других игроков в чате, это портит игру.
meaning: to say something rude that hurts or offends someone
ex: He insulted the waiter, and everyone felt uncomfortable.

en: I have a coupon for fifty gold off, so let’s use it!
ru: У меня есть купон на скидку в пятьдесят золотых, давай используем его!
meaning: a small paper or code that gives you a lower price
ex: I found a coupon for free coffee in my mailbox.

en: We’re behind schedule, and the timer says only five minutes are left.
ru: Мы отстаём от графика, а на таймере осталось всего пять минут.
meaning: Later than planned.
ex: The building work is three weeks behind schedule.

en: I prefer a digital copy of the game, because it doesn’t take up space on the shelf.
ru: Я предпочитаю цифровую копию игры, потому что она не занимает место на полке.
meaning: using computers and the internet
ex: The school is switching to digital textbooks.

en: You have a point, we really should upgrade our armor first.
ru: В этом что-то есть: нам правда сначала стоит улучшить броню.
meaning: What you say is reasonable.
tr: ты прав, в этом что-то есть
ex: You have a point, it is too late to start a new project.

en: Time goes by so fast when we’re traveling.
ru: Когда мы путешествуем, время летит так быстро.
meaning: to pass, said about time, or to move past
ex: Hours went by while we tried to beat that final boss.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I want to try out the new character today.
ru: Хочу сегодня опробовать нового персонажа.
meaning: to test something to see how good it is
ex: We tried out the new restaurant last week.

en: Wait, let me take a photo of this view before we leave.
ru: Погоди, дай я сфотографирую этот вид, пока мы не ушли.
meaning: to make a picture with a camera
ex: Take a photo of your score screen and send it to the group.

en: There’s no point in arguing about it now.
ru: Нет смысла спорить об этом сейчас.
meaning: It is useless to do something.
ex: There’s no point in fighting him, he can’t be killed.

en: I totally agree, chat, the final boss was way too long.
ru: Полностью согласен, чат, финальный босс был слишком долгим.
meaning: I strongly agree
ex: I totally agree; we need a longer break.

en: Nobody should bully new players just because they play badly.
ru: Никто не должен травить новичков только из-за того, что они плохо играют.
meaning: to hurt or frighten someone weaker again and again
ex: Teachers must stop kids who bully others at school.

en: Thanks for the subscription, that means a lot to us!
ru: Спасибо за подписку, нам это очень важно!
meaning: regular payment to receive a service or content
ex: I pay a monthly subscription for a music app.

en: We go hiking from time to time, when the weather is nice.
ru: Мы время от времени ходим в походы, когда погода хорошая.
meaning: Sometimes, but not often or regularly.
ex: From time to time a rare creature appears near the lake.

en: Send me a message when you’re ready to start the game.
ru: Напиши мне сообщение, когда будешь готов начать игру.
meaning: a piece of written or spoken information you send to someone
ex: He left a message on my phone.

en: Are you into strategy games or do you prefer shooters?
ru: Ты увлекаешься стратегиями или предпочитаешь шутеры?
meaning: Be interested in something.
ex: I’m really into cooking lately, so I try a new recipe every week.

en: Are you really going to go through with the all-in plan?
ru: Ты правда собираешься довести этот план ва-банк до конца?
meaning: to do something you planned, even if it is difficult
ex: She was nervous but went through with the interview.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Don’t forget to switch off the lights when you leave.
ru: Не забудь выключить свет, когда будешь уходить.
meaning: to stop a machine or light with a switch
ex: Switch off the chat for a minute, I need to focus.

en: Let me pay the bill, you paid for lunch last time.
ru: Давай я оплачу счёт, ты платил за обед в прошлый раз.
meaning: to give money for food or services
ex: You need to pay the bill before you can use the in-game hotel.

en: We’ve cleared three rooms without dying, so far so good.
ru: Мы прошли три комнаты, ни разу не погибнув, пока всё хорошо.
meaning: Everything is fine up to now.
ex: So far so good, the new job is going well.

en: Money makes you happy, but only up to a point.
ru: Деньги делают счастливым, но только до определённой степени.
meaning: partly, but not completely
tr: до некоторой степени, до известного предела
ex: Speed helps in this game, but only up to a point.

en: Throwing the controller is a bit immature, don’t you think?
ru: Бросаться геймпадом — это немного по-детски, не находишь?
meaning: behaving in a childish way for your age
ex: It was immature of him to stop talking to her.

en: Thank you for the donation, I’ll read your message right now.
ru: Спасибо за донат, прямо сейчас прочитаю твоё сообщение.
meaning: money or a gift that you give to help someone
ex: We made a small donation to the animal shelter.

en: Let’s stay in this camp for the time being.
ru: Давай пока останемся в этом лагере.
meaning: For now, until something changes.
ex: You can stay with us for the time being.

en: Come on, join our team, we need one more player.
ru: Давай, присоединяйся к нашей команде, нам нужен ещё один игрок.
meaning: to become a member of a group or to take part
ex: She decided to join an online English club.

en: I can’t wait for the new season to start!
ru: Не могу дождаться начала нового сезона!
meaning: Be very excited about something in the future.
ex: We can’t wait to see you at the wedding.

en: When do you come back from your trip?
ru: Когда ты возвращаешься из поездки?
meaning: to return
ex: Come back to the base, we need a healer!
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Switch on the flashlight, it’s too dark in the cave.
ru: Включи фонарик, в пещере слишком темно.
meaning: to start a machine or light with a switch
ex: Switch on the kettle, please.

en: We will keep in touch after the game, we have the same time zone.
ru: Мы будем на связи после игры, у нас один часовой пояс.
meaning: to continue to talk or write to someone
ex: Let’s keep in touch when you move abroad.

en: Sooner or later, everyone has to learn to cook.
ru: Рано или поздно всем приходится учиться готовить.
meaning: At some time in the future, certainly.
ex: Sooner or later the boss will make a mistake, so be patient.

en: To some extent, luck decides who wins in this mode.
ru: В какой-то степени, в этом режиме победителя решает удача.
meaning: partly, but not completely
ex: To some extent, the news is true.

en: Our team is very competitive, we hate losing even a practice match.
ru: Наша команда очень азартная: мы не любим проигрывать даже тренировочные матчи.
meaning: wanting very much to win or be better than others
ex: My brother is competitive and always wants to win at cards.

en: Fifty dollars for a hat? That’s a total rip-off!
ru: Пятьдесят долларов за шляпу? Это же чистый грабёж!
meaning: something that costs far too much money
ex: The hotel was a rip-off: the room was tiny and dirty.

en: It’s only a temporary bridge, so cross it quickly.
ru: Это всего лишь временный мост, так что переходи быстро.
meaning: Lasting only for a short time.
ex: I have a temporary job until the summer.

en: I’ll invite you to my lobby, just accept it.
ru: Я приглашу тебя в мою комнату, просто прими приглашение.
meaning: to ask someone to come or join
ex: We’re going to invite everyone from the office to the party.

en: Just make up your mind, are we going to the left cave or the right one?
ru: Просто определись: идём в левую пещеру или в правую?
meaning: Decide.
ex: I can’t make up my mind between the blue and the green jacket.

en: Come in, chat, the stream just started!
ru: Заходите, чат, стрим только что начался!
meaning: to enter a room or place
ex: Please come in and take off your shoes.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: That boss is too strong, let’s run away!
ru: Этот босс слишком сильный, давайте убегать!
meaning: to leave quickly to escape from something
ex: The cat ran away from home yesterday.

en: Can you keep a secret? I’m planning a surprise party for Anna.
ru: Умеешь хранить секреты? Я готовлю для Анны вечеринку-сюрприз.
meaning: to not tell other people something private
ex: Can you keep a secret? There’s a hidden room behind the waterfall.

en: The metro is broken again, here we go again.
ru: Метро опять сломалось, ну вот, опять то же самое.
meaning: Said when a bad thing happens once more.
ex: Here we go again, that boss is back with full health.

en: In general, I prefer tea to coffee.
ru: В целом чай нравится больше, чем кофе.
meaning: usually, or in most cases
ex: In general, melee characters are easier to learn.

en: I’m sick of this map, can we play another one, please?
ru: Мне уже осточертела эта карта, давай сыграем на другой?
meaning: to be very tired of something and want it to stop
ex: She’s sick of the rain and wants some sun.

en: We spend too much money on takeaway food.
ru: Мы тратим слишком много денег на еду навынос.
meaning: to use money to buy things
ex: I spent all my gold on armor and now I have nothing for potions.

en: She wants a permanent job, not a short contract.
ru: Она хочет постоянную работу, а не краткосрочный контракт.
meaning: Lasting for a long time or forever.
ex: The damage to the weapon is permanent, so be careful.

en: Thanks for the feedback, chat, I’ll fix the sound in the next stream.
ru: Спасибо за отзывы, чат, исправлю звук в следующем стриме.
meaning: opinions about what someone did, to help them improve
ex: My manager gave me useful feedback on my presentation.

en: It’s sort of a puzzle game, but you can also fight.
ru: Это что-то вроде головоломки, но можно ещё и драться.
meaning: In a way; not completely.
ex: Is he your boss? Sort of, he manages our team.

en: The new patch comes out tomorrow, and I can’t wait.
ru: Новый патч выходит завтра, не могу дождаться.
meaning: to be released or to appear
ex: His new book comes out in March.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The little boy fell down but he wasn’t hurt.
ru: Мальчик упал, но не ушибся.
meaning: to drop to the ground
ex: My character fell down the cliff again.

en: Please keep an eye on the minimap while I go for the chest.
ru: Присмотри за мини-картой, пока я иду за сундуком.
meaning: to watch something carefully
ex: Can you keep an eye on my bags for a moment?

en: Take an umbrella just in case.
ru: Возьми зонтик на всякий случай.
meaning: Because something might happen.
ex: Let’s save the game just in case.

en: Generally speaking, healers should stay at the back.
ru: В общем говоря, хилеры должны держаться сзади.
meaning: used before a general statement that is not always true
ex: Generally speaking, flights are cheaper on weekdays.

en: You’re so talkative on stream today, chat is loving it!
ru: Ты сегодня такой разговорчивый на стриме, чату нравится!
meaning: liking to talk a lot
ex: My grandmother is very talkative on the phone.

en: He decided to invest his money in a small business.
ru: Он решает вложить свои деньги в небольшой бизнес.
meaning: to put money into something to make more money
ex: It’s smart to invest in better armor before the boss fight.

en: Leave the zone immediately, the gas is spreading!
ru: Немедленно покиньте зону, газ распространяется!
meaning: Right now, without any delay.
ex: Call me immediately if something happens.

en: My channel makes gaming content every day, mostly short funny clips.
ru: На моём канале каждый день выходит игровой контент, в основном короткие смешные клипы.
meaning: things such as videos or articles that are put online
ex: This website has a lot of interesting content about history.

en: Do I want to play ranked tonight? You bet!
ru: Хочу ли я сегодня играть в рейтинге? Ещё бы!
meaning: Used to say yes strongly.
ex: Will you come to the concert? You bet.

en: Come on, just one more try and we’ll beat him!
ru: Давай, ещё одна попытка, и мы его победим!
meaning: used to encourage someone, or to tell them to hurry
ex: Come on, we’ll miss the bus.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Sorry about that mistake, I’ll make up for it in the next round.
ru: Извини за ошибку, в следующем раунде я это компенсирую.
meaning: to do something good to fix a bad thing
ex: I’ll make up for missing your birthday by taking you to dinner.

en: Keep calm, everyone, we still have one life left!
ru: Спокойно, все, у нас осталась ещё одна жизнь!
meaning: to stay relaxed and not get angry or afraid
ex: It’s hard to keep calm when you miss a train.

en: No matter what happens, we stay together in this fight.
ru: Что бы ни случилось, в этом бою мы держимся вместе.
meaning: In every possible situation.
tr: что бы ни случилось, несмотря ни на что
ex: No matter what happens, I’ll be at your wedding.

en: It isn’t hard. In fact, it’s quite easy.
ru: Это не сложно. На самом деле это довольно легко.
meaning: used to add stronger or more exact information
ex: The boss isn’t scary; in fact, he’s easy with the right weapon.

en: If we cooperate with the other squad, we can finish this quest faster.
ru: Если мы будем сотрудничать с другим отрядом, то пройдём это задание быстрее.
meaning: to work together with someone to achieve something
ex: Neighbours should cooperate with each other to keep the yard clean.

en: Can you send me the recipe for this cake?
ru: Можешь прислать мне рецепт этого пирога?
meaning: instructions for cooking a particular dish
ex: You can find the recipe for this potion in the old library.

en: Once in a while we take a weekend trip to the lake.
ru: Время от времени мы ездим на выходные на озеро.
meaning: Sometimes, but not very often.
ex: Once in a while this boss drops a rare item.

en: Our audience is mostly teenagers, so we keep the language simple.
ru: Наша аудитория — в основном подростки, поэтому мы говорим простым языком.
meaning: the people who watch or listen to something
ex: The speaker asked the audience a question.

en: No way, you actually found the hidden room!
ru: Не может быть, ты правда нашёл тайную комнату!
meaning: Used to show surprise or to say no.
tr: не может быть, ни за что
ex: No way, they sold out all tickets in one minute?

en: Do you want to come over for dinner tonight?
ru: Хочешь прийти к нам на ужин сегодня вечером?
meaning: to visit someone’s home
ex: Come over to my side of the map and help me.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I can’t make out what the sign says from here.
ru: Отсюда не разобрать, что написано на табличке.
meaning: to see, hear or understand something with difficulty
ex: I can barely make out the enemy in this fog.

en: It’s hard to keep track of all my expenses when I travel.
ru: В поездках трудно следить за всеми своими расходами.
meaning: to always know what is happening or where something is
ex: I can’t keep track of all the quests in this game.

en: Take the spare key, you never know when we might need it.
ru: Возьми запасной ключ, никогда не знаешь, когда он пригодится.
meaning: Used when something unexpected may happen.
ex: Check the empty barrel, you never know what’s inside.

en: Actually, I think this build is better than mine.
ru: Вообще-то, эта сборка лучше моей.
meaning: used to say what is really true
ex: Actually, I haven’t seen that film yet.

en: I was totally embarrassed when my phone rang during the meeting.
ru: Было ужасно неловко, когда посреди встречи зазвонил телефон.
meaning: feeling shy or uncomfortable because of what people think of you
ex: Oops, I’m embarrassed — my mic was on and the whole stream heard me sing.

en: I need a snack before the next round, I’ll be back in a minute.
ru: Мне нужен перекус перед следующим раундом, вернусь через минуту.
meaning: a small amount of food eaten between meals
ex: I always take a healthy snack to work.

en: Let’s see the museum first and have lunch afterwards.
ru: Давай сначала сходим в музей, а пообедаем потом.
meaning: At a later time, after something else.
ex: Do the quest first, and talk to the merchant afterwards.

en: Who is in charge of the server rules in our guild?
ru: Кто отвечает за правила сервера в нашей гильдии?
meaning: to have control of someone or something
ex: She is in charge of the marketing team.

en: Oops, my bad, the wrong skill got clicked.
ru: Упс, мой косяк: нажался не тот навык.
meaning: Informal way to admit your mistake.
ex: My bad, I forgot to send you the file.

en: Prices should come down after the holidays.
ru: После праздников цены должны снизиться.
meaning: to become lower, or to move down
ex: Come down from the tower, we’re waiting by the gate.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Chat keeps bringing up my last loss.
ru: Чат всё время припоминает моё последнее поражение.
meaning: to start talking about a subject; to raise a child
ex: Please don’t bring up politics at dinner.

en: If you go out without a jacket, you’ll catch a cold.
ru: Если выйдешь без куртки, простудишься.
meaning: to get a mild illness with a runny nose and cough
ex: I caught a cold last week, so I couldn’t stream for three days.

en: You don’t want to go out tonight? Fair enough.
ru: Не хочешь сегодня никуда идти? Что ж, справедливо.
meaning: Said to accept what someone says as reasonable.
ex: Fair enough, you’ve played this level ten times, let’s try another one.

en: It’s basically a small cafe with a nice terrace.
ru: В основном это небольшое кафе с приятной террасой.
meaning: used to give the main idea in a simple way
ex: Basically, you just need to dodge and then attack.

en: My brother is jealous because I got a new bike and he didn’t.
ru: Брат завидует: у меня новый велосипед, а у него нет.
meaning: unhappy because someone has something that you want
ex: Don’t be jealous, chat, I’ll share the new skin with a friend.

en: The portions in this restaurant are huge.
ru: Порции в этом ресторане огромные.
meaning: the amount of food served to one person
ex: I eat a small portion of rice during streams so I don’t get sleepy.

en: By the time we arrive, the shop will be closed.
ru: К тому времени, как мы приедем, магазин уже закроется.
meaning: Before or at the moment that something happens.
ex: By the time we reach the top, the boss will be ready.

en: Did you jump into the lava on purpose, or was it a mistake?
ru: Ты прыгнул в лаву специально или это ошибка?
meaning: deliberately, not by accident
ex: I didn’t break the cup on purpose, I promise.

en: Hey chat, what’s up? Welcome to the stream!
ru: Привет, чат, как дела? Добро пожаловать на стрим!
meaning: A casual greeting; what’s happening.
ex: Hey, what’s up? Long time no see.

en: We came across an old photo while cleaning the garage.
ru: Мы наткнулись на старое фото, пока убирались в гараже.
meaning: to find or meet by chance
ex: While exploring, I came across a hidden chest.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The new law brought about big changes in the city.
ru: Новый закон вызвал большие перемены в городе.
meaning: to cause something to happen
ex: The new patch brought about a total change in the meta.

en: Hurry up, we have to catch a train in this level or the mission fails!
ru: Быстрее, нам нужно успеть на поезд на этом уровне, иначе миссия провалится!
meaning: to get on a train before it leaves
tr: успеть на поезд, сесть на поезд
ex: We need to catch a train at seven to get there on time.

en: Let’s give it a shot and attack from above.
ru: Давай попробуем и атакуем сверху.
meaning: To try something, even if it may not work.
ex: I’ve never cooked fish, but I’ll give it a shot.

en: Apparently, there’s a secret level behind the waterfall.
ru: Судя по всему, за водопадом есть секретный уровень.
meaning: used for something you heard but are not sure about
ex: Apparently, the shop is moving to a new street.

en: You need a lot of patience to teach a child to ride a bike.
ru: Чтобы научить ребёнка кататься на велосипеде, нужно много терпения.
meaning: the ability to wait or deal with problems calmly
ex: This boss needs patience; just wait for his attack and dodge.

en: This noodle soup is delicious, chat, you should try it.
ru: Этот суп с лапшой очень вкусный, чат, вам стоит попробовать.
meaning: having a very good taste
ex: The cake at the party was delicious.

en: He’s always punctual, so he’ll be there at nine sharp.
ru: Он всегда пунктуален, так что будет там ровно в девять.
meaning: Arriving or doing things at the right time.
ex: Our raid leader is very punctual, so don’t be late.

en: I deleted my save file by accident, and now everything is gone.
ru: Сохранение случайно удалено, и теперь всё пропало.
meaning: not on purpose, by chance
ex: I sent the email to the wrong person by accident.

en: I can’t stand campers, they ruin the game.
ru: Не выношу кемперов, они портят игру.
meaning: Strongly dislike something.
ex: I can’t stand waiting in long queues.

en: Want to come along to our raid tonight? We need one more.
ru: Хочешь пойти с нами на рейд сегодня вечером? Нам не хватает одного человека.
meaning: to go with someone, or to make progress
ex: How’s your new project coming along?
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The developers will bring out a new expansion next month.
ru: Разработчики выпустят новое дополнение в следующем месяце.
meaning: to release a new product
ex: The band is bringing out a new album in spring.

en: The sudden music helps draw attention to the secret door.
ru: Внезапная музыка помогает привлечь внимание к секретной двери.
meaning: to make people notice something
ex: He drew attention to a mistake in the report.

en: The boss appeared out of nowhere!
ru: Босс появился из ниоткуда!
meaning: Suddenly and without any warning.
ex: A dog jumped out of nowhere and scared me.

en: Obviously, we can’t finish this by tomorrow.
ru: Очевидно, до завтра мы это не закончим.
meaning: in a way that is easy to see
ex: Obviously, you should heal before the boss fight.

en: It takes time to trust a new colleague.
ru: Нужно время, чтобы довериться новому коллеге.
meaning: to believe that someone is honest and will not hurt you
ex: I trust you to guard the base while we explore.

en: I only buy fresh vegetables from the local market.
ru: Я покупаю только свежие овощи на местном рынке.
meaning: recently made or picked; not old
ex: In this game, fresh bread heals more than old bread.

en: We need to arrange a meeting with the landlord next week.
ru: Нам нужно организовать встречу с арендодателем на следующей неделе.
meaning: To plan and organize something in advance.
ex: Can we arrange a time for the co-op session on Friday?

en: This is the most efficient way to farm coins in the game.
ru: Это самый эффективный способ собирать монеты в игре.
meaning: working well without wasting time or energy
ex: Our new system is more efficient and saves us hours.

en: This music in the menu really gets on my nerves.
ru: Эта музыка в меню меня реально раздражает.
meaning: Annoy someone.
ex: His constant humming gets on my nerves at work.

en: Sorry we’re late, something urgent came up at work.
ru: Простите за опоздание, на работе возникло срочное дело.
meaning: to happen unexpectedly, or to be mentioned
ex: A new quest came up on my map.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I hope this chest turns out to be full of gold.
ru: Надеюсь, этот сундук окажется полным золота.
meaning: to prove to be in the end
ex: The party turned out to be a lot of fun.

en: Use this shortcut, it will save time on every run.
ru: Используй этот короткий путь, он сэкономит время на каждом заходе.
meaning: to use less time to do something
ex: Ordering groceries online saves time.

en: He dodged at the last second, what a move!
ru: Он увернулся в последнюю секунду, вот это ход!
meaning: At the very latest moment possible.
ex: She changed her flight at the last second.

en: As I see it, we have two options: attack now or wait.
ru: Как мне это видится, у нас два варианта: атаковать сейчас или ждать.
meaning: in my opinion
tr: как я это вижу, на мой взгляд
ex: As I see it, the problem is not money but time.

en: Anna is very reliable; if she says she’ll do it, she does.
ru: Анна очень надёжная: если она говорит, что сделает, значит, сделает.
meaning: able to be trusted to do what is expected
ex: Our support player is reliable, he’s never late for practice.

en: You can’t eat raw fish in the game; you need to cook it first.
ru: В игре нельзя есть сырую рыбу, её сначала нужно приготовить.
meaning: not cooked
ex: Don’t eat raw chicken, it’s dangerous.

en: Can we postpone the stream until tomorrow? I’m really tired.
ru: Можем перенести стрим на завтра? Совсем нет сил.
meaning: To move an event to a later time.
ex: The football match was postponed because of the rain.

en: We have an issue with the sound, so give us a second.
ru: У нас проблема со звуком, так что подождите секундочку.
meaning: a problem or subject that people discuss
ex: The main issue is that the team doesn’t have enough time.

en: The same loading screen every minute drives me crazy.
ru: Один и тот же экран загрузки каждую минуту сводит меня с ума.
meaning: Make me very annoyed or upset.
ex: My little brother’s noise drives me crazy when I’m studying.

en: Rare items like this are hard to come by in the early game.
ru: Такие редкие предметы трудно раздобыть в начале игры.
meaning: to get something, often with effort
ex: Good jobs are hard to come by these days.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Watch out, the chest turns into a monster when you open it!
ru: Осторожно, сундук превращается в монстра, когда его открываешь!
meaning: to change and become something different
ex: The small shop turned into a successful business.

en: We want to save money for a trip to Japan next year.
ru: Мы хотим накопить денег на поездку в Японию в следующем году.
meaning: to keep money instead of spending it
ex: I save money by waiting for game sales.

en: That treasure looks great, but it’s not worth the risk.
ru: Сокровище выглядит здорово, но риск того не стоит.
meaning: The possible danger is bigger than the possible gain.
ex: Driving in this storm? It’s not worth the risk.

en: The point is, we don’t have enough time.
ru: Суть в том, что у нас не хватает времени.
meaning: used to say the most important thing
ex: The point is to stay alive, not to kill everyone.

en: My parents are proud of me for finishing university.
ru: Родители гордятся мной, потому что у меня теперь диплом.
meaning: to feel pleased about something good you or someone you know did
ex: We’re proud of the team, even though we lost the match.

en: This sauce is way too spicy, I’m crying on stream.
ru: Этот соус слишком острый, я плачу прямо на стриме.
meaning: having a strong, hot taste
ex: I like spicy food, but my brother doesn’t.

en: Could we reschedule the meeting for Thursday?
ru: Можем перенести встречу на четверг?
meaning: To change the time of an event.
ex: I’ll have to reschedule my stream because of a power cut.

en: There must be a solution to this puzzle, but I can’t see it.
ru: У этой головоломки должно быть решение, но я его не вижу.
meaning: a way to solve a problem
ex: The IT team found a quick solution to the network problem.

en: You’re kidding! You got the rare drop three times in a row?
ru: Ты шутишь! Тебе редкий предмет выпал три раза подряд?
meaning: I’m surprised and can hardly believe you.
ex: You’re kidding, they cancelled the whole trip?

en: That crazy trick shot actually came off!
ru: Этот безумный трюковой выстрел действительно удался!
meaning: to succeed, or to stop being attached
ex: The handle came off in my hand.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The bad weather set our trip back by two days.
ru: Плохая погода отодвинула нашу поездку на два дня.
meaning: to delay progress
ex: That bug set back my progress by hours.

en: Don’t forget to save your progress before the boss fight!
ru: Не забудь сохраниться перед боем с боссом!
meaning: to keep your current game data
ex: Save your progress, then close the laptop.

en: I’m taking the other job offer, so no hard feelings, okay?
ru: Я принимаю другое предложение о работе, так что без обид, ладно?
meaning: Said to show you are not angry or upset.
ex: You beat me three times in a row, but no hard feelings.

en: The main reason is that this class has a really fast dash.
ru: Главная причина в том, что у этого класса очень быстрый рывок.
meaning: used to give the most important reason
ex: The main reason is that the rent is lower there.

en: We were disappointed when the cinema was already closed.
ru: Мы расстроились, когда кинотеатр оказался уже закрыт.
meaning: sad because something was not as good as you hoped
ex: Don’t be disappointed, chat, the next stream will be even better.

en: I have no appetite when I’m stressed.
ru: Когда я напряжён, у меня пропадает аппетит.
meaning: the feeling that you want to eat
ex: The boss fight gave me an appetite, so I’m making a sandwich.

en: Sorry, guys, we have to cancel the stream today, the internet is down.
ru: Простите, ребята, сегодня стрим придётся отменить: пропал интернет.
meaning: To decide that a planned event will not happen.
ex: They cancelled our flight at the last minute.

en: There’s too much lag, I can’t even aim properly.
ru: Слишком много лагов, я даже прицелиться нормально не могу.
meaning: a delay between an action and its result online
ex: The video call had so much lag that we couldn’t talk.

en: Is the bridge safe? I guess so, nobody has fallen yet.
ru: Мост безопасен? Наверное, пока никто не упал.
meaning: Used to agree, but without being sure.
ex: Do you want some tea? I guess so, it’s cold outside.

en: Our visas finally came through yesterday.
ru: Вчера наши визы наконец-то пришли.
meaning: to arrive officially, or to succeed in a hard moment
ex: Our healer came through at the last second and saved us.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We set out to beat the final boss without taking any damage.
ru: Мы взялись победить финального босса, не получив ни одного урона.
meaning: to start a task with a goal; to begin a journey
ex: They set out at dawn to climb the mountain.

en: Turn off the lights when you leave, it helps save energy.
ru: Выключай свет, когда уходишь, это помогает экономить энергию.
meaning: to use less power or effort
ex: Don’t run now, save energy for the next fight.

en: Put your wallet away, it’s on me tonight.
ru: Убери кошелёк, сегодня я угощаю.
meaning: I will pay, or I am responsible for it.
ex: It’s on me, everyone stay back, I’ll deal with the boss.

en: That’s the reason why I never eat there anymore.
ru: Вот причина, по которой там больше не едят.
meaning: used to explain the cause
ex: The reason why we lost was bad communication.

en: She looked upset after the phone call with her mum.
ru: Она выглядела расстроенной после разговора по телефону с мамой.
meaning: unhappy or worried because something bad happened
ex: He got upset when his character died at the very end of the level.

en: Let’s order takeaway tonight, I don’t want to cook.
ru: Давай сегодня закажем еду навынос, готовить не хочется.
meaning: hot food that you buy in a restaurant and eat elsewhere
ex: We’re ordering takeaway for the whole team during the tournament.

en: We intend to leave early to avoid the traffic.
ru: Мы собираемся выехать пораньше, чтобы не попасть в пробку.
meaning: To plan to do something.
ex: We intend to finish the whole map this weekend.

en: I just got my thousandth follower, thank you all!
ru: У меня только что появился тысячный подписчик, всем спасибо!
meaning: a person who follows your account to see your posts
ex: She has over ten thousand followers on her page.

en: All of a sudden, the whole screen went black.
ru: Внезапно весь экран стал чёрным.
meaning: Suddenly.
ex: All of a sudden, it started to rain heavily.

en: I think I’m coming down with the flu.
ru: Кажется, я заболеваю гриппом.
meaning: to start to get an illness
ex: Half my team came down with a cold, so we cancelled the tournament.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We ran into the enemy team right at the spawn.
ru: Мы столкнулись с вражеской командой прямо на точке возрождения.
meaning: to meet someone or something by chance
ex: We ran into our old teacher at the supermarket yesterday.

en: I don’t want to waste money on a skin I’ll never use.
ru: Не хочу тратить деньги на скин, которым никогда не буду пользоваться.
meaning: to spend money on things that are not useful
ex: Don’t waste money on cheap shoes that break in a month.

en: A hard jump? Leave it to me.
ru: Сложный прыжок? Предоставьте это мне.
meaning: Let me do it; I will take care of it.
ex: Leave it to me, I’ll book the hotel.

en: On the whole, the game is great, but the ending is weak.
ru: В целом игра отличная, но концовка слабая.
meaning: in general, thinking about everything
ex: On the whole, it was a good week.

en: He often feels lonely in a big city where he knows nobody.
ru: Он часто чувствует себя одиноко в большом городе, где никого не знает.
meaning: sad because you have no friends or company
ex: The empty server felt lonely at three in the morning.

en: You should leave a tip if the waiter was friendly.
ru: Стоит оставить чаевые, если официант был приветлив.
meaning: extra money you give to a waiter for good service
ex: Viewers sometimes leave a tip for the streamer.

en: We’re definitely coming back to this island after the next level.
ru: Мы обязательно вернёмся на этот остров после следующего уровня.
meaning: Without any doubt, for sure.
ex: I’ll definitely be there on time.

en: We have fifty viewers now, so say hi to everyone in chat!
ru: Сейчас у нас пятьдесят зрителей, так что поздоровайтесь все в чате!
meaning: a person who watches a video or stream
ex: This show has millions of viewers every week.

en: We lost, but at least we got some good loot.
ru: Мы проиграли, но хотя бы получили неплохую добычу.
meaning: Used to say a good thing in a bad situation.
ex: At least the weather is nice today.

en: The bill came to eighty dollars for the four of us.
ru: Счёт на четверых составил восемьдесят долларов.
meaning: to add up to a total, or to wake up
ex: Your total score comes to ten thousand points.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Careful, a car almost ran him over.
ru: Осторожно, его чуть не сбила машина.
meaning: to hit someone with a vehicle and drive over them
ex: You can run over enemies with the buggy.

en: We love to spend time together on weekends.
ru: Мы любим проводить время вместе по выходным.
meaning: to use time doing something
ex: I spend a lot of time in this game.

en: Go ahead, I’ve got your back.
ru: Вперёд, я прикрою тебя.
meaning: I will protect and support you.
tr: я тебя прикрою, я с тобой
ex: Tell your boss the truth, I’ve got your back.

en: In the end, we picked the safest strategy and won.
ru: В итоге мы выбрали самую безопасную стратегию и победили.
meaning: finally, after a long time or discussion
ex: In the end, we decided to stay at home.

en: My cousin is shy and rarely speaks to strangers.
ru: Мой двоюродный брат застенчивый и редко разговаривает с незнакомцами.
meaning: nervous and uncomfortable when meeting or talking to people
ex: Don’t be shy, chat, say hi in the comments!

en: My sister is vegetarian, so we cook without meat.
ru: Моя сестра вегетарианка, поэтому мы готовим без мяса.
meaning: a person who does not eat meat
ex: Is there a vegetarian option in the game’s tavern, or only meat?

en: There’s a possibility that our flight will be delayed.
ru: Есть вероятность, что наш рейс задержат.
meaning: Something that might happen or be true.
ex: There’s a possibility that the next boss is hidden in the cave.

en: I’m going to stream the new game tonight, come and watch.
ru: Сегодня вечером буду стримить новую игру, заходите смотреть.
meaning: to broadcast or watch something live on the internet
ex: We stream movies at home instead of buying DVDs.

en: Don’t talk to me right now, I’m totally in the zone.
ru: Не говори со мной сейчас, я полностью в потоке.
meaning: Fully focused and playing or working very well.
ex: When I’m writing code at night, I get in the zone.

en: Our whole strategy came apart when the leader disconnected.
ru: Вся наша стратегия развалилась, когда лидер отключился.
meaning: to break into pieces, or to fail
ex: The old chair came apart when we sat on it.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Someone tried to break into their house last night.
ru: Кто-то пытался вломиться в их дом прошлой ночью.
meaning: to enter a place by force
ex: Let’s break into the enemy base through the back door.

en: Do you spend money on games every month?
ru: Ты тратишь деньги на игры каждый месяц?
meaning: to pay money for things
ex: We spend money on groceries every week.

en: A new level tonight? Count me in.
ru: Новый уровень сегодня вечером? Считайте меня в деле.
meaning: I want to join; include me.
ex: Count me in for the barbecue on Saturday.

en: Cooking at home is cheaper in the long run.
ru: В долгосрочной перспективе готовить дома дешевле.
meaning: over a long period of time
tr: в долгосрочной перспективе, в конечном счёте
ex: In the long run, learning the controls properly will save you time.

en: The new waiter is very polite and always smiles at the guests.
ru: Новый официант очень вежливый и всегда улыбается гостям.
meaning: behaving in a way that is respectful and not rude
ex: He’s always polite, even when the team is losing.

en: In this survival game you must boil water before you drink it.
ru: В этой игре на выживание воду нужно кипятить перед питьём.
meaning: to heat a liquid until it bubbles
ex: Boil the eggs for ten minutes.

en: We have two options: fight the boss or sneak past.
ru: У нас два варианта: сразиться с боссом или проскользнуть мимо.
meaning: One of the things you can choose.
ex: The cheapest option is to go by bus.

en: Your profile picture is hilarious, who drew that?
ru: Твоя аватарка на профиле просто умора, кто это нарисовал?
meaning: a page with information about a person online
ex: I need to update my profile on the job site.

en: Our best player had to carry the team again this match.
ru: Нашему лучшему игроку снова пришлось тащить команду на себе в этом матче.
meaning: Do most of the work so your team can succeed.
ex: One person always carries the team in group projects.

en: We came up against serious problems when the project started.
ru: Мы столкнулись с серьёзными проблемами, когда проект стартовал.
meaning: to meet a difficulty or an opponent
ex: In the finals we came up against the best team in the region.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: In story mode, the prisoners break out of jail in the first mission.
ru: В сюжетном режиме заключённые сбегают из тюрьмы в первой миссии.
meaning: to escape; to start suddenly, like a fire or a war
ex: A fire broke out in the building next door.

en: We’ll spend the night at the camp, then continue at dawn.
ru: Мы переночуем в лагере, а на рассвете двинемся дальше.
meaning: to stay somewhere until the next morning
ex: They spent the night at a small hotel by the lake.

en: Good call, saving before the boss was smart.
ru: Верное решение, сохраниться перед боссом было разумно.
meaning: A wise decision or choice.
ex: Good call bringing a jacket, it’s freezing out.

en: At first, this character felt weak, but now it’s my favourite.
ru: Сначала этот персонаж казался слабым, а теперь он любимый.
meaning: in the beginning
ex: At first the course seemed difficult, but then it got easier.

en: It’s rude to look at your phone while someone is talking to you.
ru: Невежливо смотреть в телефон, когда с тобой разговаривают.
meaning: not polite, in a way that offends people
ex: Being rude to teammates in the voice chat never helps.

en: I’m going to fry some eggs real quick, don’t pause the game.
ru: Я быстро пожарю яйца, не ставь игру на паузу.
meaning: to cook food in hot oil
ex: Fry the onions until they are golden.

en: If the door doesn’t open, what’s our backup plan?
ru: Если дверь не откроется, какой у нас запасной план?
meaning: A second plan to use if the first one fails.
ex: Always have a backup plan in case it rains.

en: I turned off every notification because the phone kept buzzing during the game.
ru: Все уведомления теперь отключены: телефон всё время жужжал во время игры.
meaning: a message that tells you something new has happened
ex: I got a notification that my package has arrived.

expr: take it with a grain of salt
en: Take the streamer’s tier list with a grain of salt, it’s just his opinion.
ru: Относись к тир-листу стримера с долей скептицизма: это просто его мнение.
meaning: Don’t completely believe something.
tr: относиться скептически, не принимать на веру
ex: Take online reviews with a grain of salt.
hint: t… i… w… a… g… o… s…

en: A random player came up to me in the game and asked for help.
ru: Случайный игрок подошёл ко мне в игре и попросил о помощи.
meaning: to move close to someone
ex: A man came up to us and asked for directions.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The team will carry out the test next week.
ru: Команда проведёт тест на следующей неделе.
meaning: to do or complete a task or plan
ex: We’ll carry out the plan as soon as the boss turns around.

en: I need to make an appointment with the dentist this week.
ru: Мне нужно записаться к стоматологу на этой неделе.
meaning: to arrange a time to meet someone, e.g. a doctor
ex: Make an appointment with the shop owner in the game before you trade.

en: Let’s play it safe and wait for the guard to leave.
ru: Давай подстрахуемся и подождём, пока стражник уйдёт.
meaning: To avoid risks and be careful.
ex: I’ll play it safe and take the earlier train.

en: First of all, thank you all for coming.
ru: Прежде всего, спасибо, что все пришли.
meaning: used to introduce the first point
ex: First of all, let’s check the map and pick a spot.

en: Our uncle is very generous; he paid for the whole dinner.
ru: Наш дядя очень щедрый: он заплатил за весь ужин.
meaning: happy to give money, time or help to others
ex: A generous viewer just sent ten gifts to the channel!

en: You can bake a cake in the game’s kitchen to get extra health.
ru: В игровой кухне можно испечь торт, чтобы получить дополнительное здоровье.
meaning: to cook food in an oven
ex: She likes to bake bread on Sundays.

en: Staying alive is the first priority, and loot comes second.
ru: Выжить — главный приоритет, а добыча на втором месте.
meaning: Something that is more important than other things.
ex: My priority this month is saving money.

en: The game works on almost any device, even an old tablet.
ru: Игра работает почти на любом устройстве, даже на старом планшете.
meaning: a small machine, such as a phone or tablet
ex: He uses a different device for work and for fun.

en: That small bug is just the tip of the iceberg.
ru: Этот мелкий баг — лишь верхушка айсберга.
meaning: A small visible part of a much bigger problem.
ex: The late payment is just the tip of the iceberg, the company has bigger problems.

en: It all comes down to the last round.
ru: Всё решит последний раунд.
meaning: to be the most important factor, or to depend on
ex: Choosing a flat comes down to price and location.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Why does everyone pick on me every match?
ru: Почему меня выбирают мишенью в каждом матче?
meaning: to treat someone unfairly again and again
ex: The older kids used to pick on him at school.

en: We can make a profit if we sell this armor in the next town.
ru: Мы получим прибыль, если продадим эту броню в следующем городе.
meaning: to earn more money than you spent
ex: The small shop barely makes a profit in winter.

en: Okay, here goes, I’m jumping across the gap!
ru: Ну, поехали, прыгаю через пропасть!
meaning: Said just before doing something scary or important.
ex: Here goes, I’m opening my exam results.

en: Compared to last year, prices are much higher.
ru: По сравнению с прошлым годом цены намного выше.
meaning: when you think about how two things are different
ex: Compared to the old version, the new one loads faster.

en: It’s selfish to eat the last piece of cake without asking.
ru: Съесть последний кусок торта, не спросив, — это эгоистично.
meaning: caring only about yourself and not about other people
ex: He was selfish and took all the loot for himself.

en: Let’s chop down three trees to build a small house.
ru: Давай срубим три дерева и построим небольшой дом.
meaning: to cut something into pieces with a knife
ex: Chop the onions into small pieces.

en: Are you available tonight for a game?
ru: У тебя есть время сегодня вечером, чтобы поиграть?
meaning: Free to do something, or possible to get or use.
ex: Is this room available for the weekend?

en: You need free software to record your gameplay.
ru: Тебе нужна бесплатная программа, чтобы записывать геймплей.
meaning: programs that run on a computer
ex: Our company pays for the accounting software every year.

en: The save file broke, so we’re back to square one.
ru: Файл сохранения сломался, так что мы вернулись к исходной точке.
meaning: Back at the beginning after failing.
tr: вернуться к исходной точке, начинать с нуля
ex: Our plan failed, so we’re back to square one.

en: He’ll come round to the idea eventually.
ru: В конце концов он смирится с этой идеей.
meaning: to change your opinion, or to wake up
ex: My team didn’t like the plan, but they came round after the first win.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Don’t hold back, use your best skill now!
ru: Не сдерживайся, используй свой лучший навык сейчас!
meaning: to stop yourself from doing or showing something
ex: She couldn’t hold back her tears.

en: We should make a reservation for dinner on Friday.
ru: Нам стоит заказать столик на ужин в пятницу.
meaning: to book a table or room
ex: Make a reservation for the whole team before the stream party.

en: We have one life left, fingers crossed!
ru: У нас осталась одна жизнь, держим кулаки!
meaning: Said when hoping for good luck.
ex: Fingers crossed the weather stays nice for the wedding.

en: I prefer playing with friends, as opposed to playing with strangers.
ru: Лучше играть с друзьями, а не с незнакомцами.
meaning: used to show a clear difference between two things
ex: We chose the train as opposed to the plane.

en: Thanks for being honest with me about the project; I know it was hard to say.
ru: Спасибо, что был со мной честен насчёт проекта; знаю, это было непросто сказать.
meaning: telling the truth and not cheating
ex: To be honest, chat, that was the worst round of my life.

en: I’m going to buy groceries after work.
ru: После работы я схожу за продуктами.
meaning: food and other things you buy in a supermarket
ex: In the game you buy groceries from the market to feed your team.

en: It’s urgent: the village is under attack and we need help!
ru: Это срочно: деревню атакуют, и нам нужна помощь!
meaning: Needing action or attention immediately.
ex: I have something urgent to tell you.

en: Wait, I have to install one more driver before the game runs.
ru: Подожди, мне надо установить ещё один драйвер, прежде чем игра запустится.
meaning: to put a program on a computer so you can use it
ex: The technician will install the new printer tomorrow.

en: If you want to reach the top rank, you need to step up your game.
ru: Если хочешь попасть в топ рейтинга, нужно подтянуть свой уровень.
meaning: Improve your performance.
ex: He stepped up his game at work after the warning.

en: Our plane takes off at nine, so we should leave now.
ru: Наш самолёт взлетает в девять, так что пора выезжать.
meaning: to leave the ground, or to remove clothes
ex: Take off that heavy armor before you jump in the water.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Sorry, a traffic jam held us up.
ru: Извините, нас задержала пробка.
meaning: to delay someone or something
ex: A lag spike held up the whole match.

en: Welcome to the lobby, please take a seat and wait for the match.
ru: Добро пожаловать в лобби, присаживайтесь и ждите матч.
meaning: to sit down
ex: Please take a seat, the doctor will see you soon.

en: Three rare items in a row? What are the odds!
ru: Три редких предмета подряд? Каковы шансы!
meaning: Said when something is very unlikely to happen.
ex: We met in a different country. What are the odds?

en: I’d walk rather than wait for the bus.
ru: Лучше пойти пешком, чем ждать автобус.
meaning: used to say what you prefer not to do
ex: Use stealth rather than fighting every guard.

en: It was very thoughtful of you to bring flowers for my grandmother.
ru: Очень внимательно с твоей стороны было принести цветы моей бабушке.
meaning: caring about other people and their feelings
ex: A thoughtful teammate always shares the health packs.

en: I’m on a diet, so no dessert for me.
ru: Я на диете, так что десерт мне не нужен.
meaning: eating less or certain foods to lose weight
ex: I’m on a diet during stream week: only water and nuts.

en: My goal for today’s stream is to reach level fifty.
ru: Моя цель на сегодняшний стрим — добраться до пятидесятого уровня.
meaning: Something you want to achieve.
ex: Our goal this summer is to visit three new countries.

en: Which platform do you play on, PC or console?
ru: На какой платформе ты играешь — на ПК или на консоли?
meaning: a system or website where people use services
ex: Many teachers use an online platform for homework.

en: We don’t have a plan for the weekend, so let’s play it by ear.
ru: У нас нет плана на выходные, так что будем действовать по обстановке.
meaning: Decide what to do as things happen.
ex: We don’t know the map, so we’ll just play it by ear.

en: Can you take out the sniper on the roof?
ru: Можешь убрать снайпера на крыше?
meaning: to remove something, or to kill or destroy an enemy
ex: Please take out the trash before you leave.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We need to cut back on sweets this month.
ru: В этом месяце нужно сократить сладкое.
meaning: to reduce the amount of something
ex: You should cut back on spending coins on random boxes.

en: We have trouble with the connection, so the video keeps freezing.
ru: У нас проблемы со связью, поэтому видео постоянно зависает.
meaning: to find something difficult or problematic
ex: I often have trouble waking up on Mondays.

en: You’ve got to be kidding, another boss right after that one?
ru: Вы, наверное, шутите, ещё один босс сразу после этого?
meaning: Said when you cannot believe something is true.
ex: You’ve got to be kidding, the flight is cancelled again?

en: This controller feels the same as the old one.
ru: Этот контроллер ощущается так же, как старый.
meaning: not different from something
ex: My phone is the same as yours.

en: She’s always cheerful in the morning, even before her coffee.
ru: Она всегда бодра и весела по утрам, даже до кофе.
meaning: happy and positive
ex: Our cheerful support player keeps the whole squad smiling.

en: I’m starving, chat, can we take a short break?
ru: Я умираю с голоду, чат, можно сделать короткий перерыв?
meaning: very hungry
ex: We were starving after the long hike.

en: We need a better strategy for this level.
ru: Нам нужна стратегия получше для этого уровня.
meaning: A plan for achieving something difficult.
ex: Our strategy is to arrive early and avoid the lines.

en: I can’t open your attachment, can you send it again?
ru: Я не могу открыть твоё вложение, можешь отправить ещё раз?
meaning: a file you send together with an email
ex: Don’t open an attachment from an unknown sender.

en: Working from home two days a week gives you the best of both worlds.
ru: Работа из дома два дня в неделю даёт тебе лучшее из двух миров.
meaning: The advantages of two different things.
ex: This game has the best of both worlds: great story and fast action.

en: I want to take up painting this autumn.
ru: Этой осенью я хочу заняться рисованием.
meaning: to start a new hobby or activity
ex: She took up streaming after her friends said she was funny.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Our team got cut off from the main base.
ru: Нашу команду отрезали от основной базы.
meaning: to separate from others; to stop the supply of something
ex: The storm cut off the village for two days.

en: You should take advice from players who’ve beaten this level.
ru: Тебе стоит прислушаться к советам тех, кто уже прошёл этот уровень.
meaning: to listen to and use someone’s suggestions
ex: She took advice from her teacher and changed her plan.

en: A secret door behind the bookcase? I didn’t see that coming.
ru: Потайная дверь за шкафом? Вот это поворот.
meaning: I did not expect that at all.
ex: She quit her job? I didn’t see that coming.

en: This recipe is similar to the one my grandmother uses.
ru: Этот рецепт похож на тот, которым пользуется бабушка.
meaning: almost the same as something
ex: This game is similar to the one we played last year.

en: My sister is afraid of spiders and screams every time she sees one.
ru: Моя сестра боится пауков и кричит каждый раз, когда видит одного.
meaning: to feel fear because of someone or something
ex: Are you afraid of the dark levels in this horror game?

en: Could we have the bill, please?
ru: Можно нам счёт, пожалуйста?
meaning: a piece of paper that shows how much you must pay
ex: The waiter in the game brings the bill after the quest.

en: The forecast says it’ll rain all weekend.
ru: В прогнозе говорится, что все выходные будет дождь.
meaning: A statement about what the weather will be like.
ex: The in-game forecast shows a storm tonight.

en: The page won’t load, so I’ll try another browser.
ru: Страница не загружается, так что попробую другой браузер.
meaning: a program you use to look at websites
ex: Clear your browser history if the site works slowly.

en: He wanted to stream live, but got cold feet at the last moment.
ru: Он хотел выйти в прямой эфир, но в последний момент струсил.
meaning: Become too nervous to do something planned.
ex: She got cold feet before the wedding.

en: I take it back, that boss was actually easy.
ru: Беру свои слова обратно, этот босс оказался несложным.
meaning: to say you were wrong, or to return something
ex: I’m taking this jacket back to the shop because it’s too small.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: My old bag is slowly falling apart.
ru: Моя старая сумка потихоньку разваливается.
meaning: to break into pieces; to stop working well
ex: Our team fell apart after the first mistake.

en: We’ll be late because of the heavy traffic on the main road.
ru: Мы опоздаем из-за плотного движения на главной дороге.
meaning: a lot of cars on a road
ex: The server has heavy traffic on Friday nights.

en: We barely survived that fight.
ru: Мы едва пережили этот бой.
meaning: Only just; almost not.
ex: I barely slept last night because of the noise.

en: Unlike the first game, this one has an open world.
ru: В отличие от первой части, здесь открытый мир.
meaning: different from something
ex: Unlike me, my sister loves getting up early.

en: Mum is worried about my grandfather because he doesn’t answer the phone.
ru: Мама переживает за дедушку, потому что он не отвечает на телефон.
meaning: to think about problems and feel anxious
ex: We’re worried about the server, it keeps freezing.

en: We have a reservation for four at eight o’clock.
ru: У нас бронь на четверых на восемь часов.
meaning: an arrangement to keep a table or room for you
ex: We made a reservation at a cafe for the whole stream team.

en: It’s so humid here that my clothes never dry.
ru: Здесь такая влажность, что одежда никогда не сохнет.
meaning: Warm and wet in the air, which feels uncomfortable.
ex: The swamp level is humid, and the screen is covered in mist.

en: I’ll send my application to the studio tomorrow morning.
ru: Завтра утром отправлю свою заявку в студию.
meaning: a formal request for a job, course or permit
ex: Her application for the course was accepted.

expr: have a lot on your plate
en: I can’t join the raid, I have a lot on my plate this week.
ru: Я не могу идти в рейд, на этой неделе у меня очень много дел.
meaning: Have a lot of work or problems to deal with.
ex: She has a lot on her plate with two jobs and kids.
hint: h… a… l… o… y… p…

en: Can you take over for a minute? I need some water.
ru: Можешь меня подменить на минуту? Мне нужно попить воды.
meaning: to start doing something that someone else was doing
ex: A new manager will take over the team in January.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We’re falling behind, the other team has more kills.
ru: Мы отстаём, у другой команды больше убийств.
meaning: to be slower or less successful than others
ex: He fell behind with his rent.

en: I have a strong opinion about this update: they ruined the map.
ru: У меня твёрдое мнение об этом обновлении: они испортили карту.
meaning: a very firm belief about something
ex: She has strong opinions about politics.

en: Before we start, let’s make sure we’re all on the same page.
ru: Прежде чем начать, давайте убедимся, что мы понимаем всё одинаково.
meaning: Having the same understanding or opinion.
ex: My manager and I need to be on the same page about the deadline.

en: Which door we pick? It makes no difference, they lead to the same room.
ru: Какую дверь выбрать? Разницы нет, они ведут в одну комнату.
meaning: it is not important which one you choose
tr: нет разницы, это не имеет значения
ex: It makes no difference to me where we eat.

en: It’s hard to forgive a friend who has lied to you.
ru: Трудно простить друга, который тебе солгал.
meaning: to stop being angry with someone who did something wrong
ex: Forgive me, team, I clicked the wrong button.

en: We eat too much fast food during long stream marathons.
ru: Во время долгих стрим-марафонов мы едим слишком много фастфуда.
meaning: food that is cooked and served very quickly
ex: Fast food is quick but not very healthy.

en: It’s just a light drizzle in the game, so no need to find shelter.
ru: В игре всего лишь лёгкая морось, так что укрытие искать не нужно.
meaning: Light rain with very small drops.
ex: A fine drizzle fell all morning.

en: I like my wireless headset, because I can walk around while I play.
ru: Мне нравится моя беспроводная гарнитура: можно ходить по комнате, пока играю.
meaning: not using wires or cables
ex: Our office has a fast wireless network.

en: Fifty dollars for one skin? That’s a rip-off.
ru: Пятьдесят долларов за один скин? Это грабёж.
meaning: Something that costs far too much.
ex: That restaurant was a rip-off, the portions were tiny.

en: She really takes after her mother.
ru: Она очень похожа на свою маму.
meaning: to look or behave like an older family member
ex: The new hero takes after the legendary warrior from the first game.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Don’t fall for the fake chest, it’s a trap!
ru: Не ведись на фальшивый сундук, это ловушка!
meaning: to believe a trick; to start loving someone
ex: Don’t fall for that trick, it’s a scam.

en: This restaurant is highly recommended by everyone we know.
ru: Этот ресторан очень рекомендуют все наши знакомые.
meaning: very much advised by others
ex: This game is highly recommended for co-op fans.

expr: i have a bad feeling about this
en: It’s too quiet in here, I have a bad feeling about this.
ru: Здесь слишком тихо, у меня дурное предчувствие.
meaning: I think something bad will happen.
ex: I have a bad feeling about this trip, the weather looks terrible.
hint: i… h… a… b… f… a… t…

en: It doesn’t matter if you’re late; we’ll wait.
ru: Неважно, если опоздаешь, мы подождём.
meaning: it is not important
