ex: It doesn’t matter who wins; the match is just for fun.

en: We really miss our old neighbours; they moved to another city.
ru: Мы очень скучаем по нашим старым соседям: они переехали в другой город.
meaning: to feel sad because someone or something is not with you
ex: Chat, we miss the old maps from the first version.

en: Sorry for the mess on my desk, chat, there are chips everywhere.
ru: Простите за бардак на столе, чат, везде чипсы.
meaning: a dirty or untidy state
ex: The kitchen was a mess after the party.

en: A thunderstorm just started, look at those lightning effects!
ru: Только что началась гроза, смотри, какие эффекты молний!
meaning: A storm with thunder, lightning and heavy rain.
ex: We stayed inside because of the thunderstorm.

en: The game collects a lot of data about how we play.
ru: Игра собирает много данных о том, как мы играем.
meaning: facts and numbers that are stored on a computer
ex: We need more data before we make a decision about the new site.

en: If the shop is closed, we’re out of luck, no potions today.
ru: Если магазин закрыт, нам не повезло: сегодня зелий не будет.
meaning: Having no luck; unable to get what you want.
ex: If you want tickets for tonight, you’re out of luck.

en: We took their whole team apart in the first round.
ru: Мы разгромили всю их команду в первом раунде.
meaning: to separate into pieces, or to defeat easily
ex: He took the old radio apart to see how it works.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Our holiday plans fell through at the last minute.
ru: Наши планы на отпуск сорвались в последний момент.
meaning: to fail to happen
ex: The raid fell through because half the players quit.

en: We’re fully aware that the next boss is much harder.
ru: Мы прекрасно понимаем, что следующий босс намного сложнее.
meaning: knowing about something completely
ex: He is fully aware of the risks of the job.

en: There are ten of them and two of us, we’re outnumbered.
ru: Их десять, а нас двое, они нас превосходят числом.
meaning: The other side has many more people than we do.
tr: нас меньше, они превосходят нас числом
ex: At the meeting we’re outnumbered, so let’s prepare well.

en: As far as I’m concerned, this is the best weapon in the game.
ru: Что касается меня, это лучшее оружие в игре.
meaning: used to give your own opinion
tr: что касается меня, по моему мнению
ex: As far as I’m concerned, the meeting is over.

en: Mum is angry with us because we forgot to wash the dishes.
ru: Мама сердится на нас, потому что мы забыли помыть посуду.
meaning: to feel strong displeasure toward someone
ex: Please don’t be angry with me, I lost connection in the middle of the fight.

en: The rent for this flat is too high.
ru: Арендная плата за эту квартиру слишком высокая.
meaning: money you pay regularly to live in a place
ex: In this game you pay rent for your house every week.

en: It’s so foggy that I can’t see the bridge.
ru: Такой туман, что я не вижу мост.
meaning: Covered with thick fog, so it is hard to see.
ex: It was foggy this morning, so the flights were late.

en: Always make a backup of your save before you try mods.
ru: Всегда делай резервную копию сохранения, прежде чем ставить моды.
meaning: an extra copy of files in case the original is lost
ex: We keep a backup of all the documents in the cloud.

en: The spawn point is in the middle of nowhere, there are no houses at all.
ru: Точка возрождения посреди глуши, вокруг вообще нет домов.
meaning: In a place very far from everything.
tr: в глуши, у чёрта на куличках
ex: Their cabin is in the middle of nowhere, so there’s no signal.

en: Could you take this plate away, please?
ru: Не могли бы вы унести эту тарелку?
meaning: to remove something from a place or person
ex: Dying takes away half of your gold.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I’m still working on my aim, so be patient.
ru: Я всё ещё работаю над меткостью, так что потерпите.
meaning: to spend time improving or making something
ex: She is working on a new project at the office.

en: This version of the game feels completely different from the old one.
ru: Эта версия игры совершенно не похожа на старую.
meaning: not the same in any way
ex: Life in the village is completely different from city life.

en: We can’t afford to lose any more lives.
ru: Мы не можем позволить себе потерять ещё жизни.
meaning: It would be too dangerous or costly to do this.
ex: We can’t afford to wait, the offer ends today.

en: I’m convinced that we made the right choice.
ru: Нет сомнений, что мы сделали правильный выбор.
meaning: I am very sure that
tr: я убеждён, что, нет сомнений, что
ex: I’m convinced that the hidden door is behind this statue.

en: Her mood changes very fast; she can be happy and sad in one hour.
ru: Её настроение очень быстро меняется: за час она может побывать и счастливой, и грустной.
meaning: the way you feel at a particular time
ex: I’m not in the mood for a hard boss tonight.

en: I need to buy some furniture for my house in the game.
ru: Мне нужно купить мебель для моего дома в игре.
meaning: things like tables, chairs and beds in a room
ex: We bought new furniture for the living room.

en: It’s freezing outside, so put on a warm coat.
ru: На улице ужасно холодно, так что надень тёплое пальто.
meaning: Extremely cold.
ex: My character is freezing in the snow, so we need a campfire.

en: I think there’s a virus on my laptop, because it keeps opening weird pages.
ru: Кажется, у меня на ноутбуке вирус: он постоянно открывает странные страницы.
meaning: a harmful program that damages a computer
ex: The antivirus program found a virus in the downloaded file.

en: Hold your horses, don’t pull the whole room yet!
ru: Не горячись, не тяни сразу всю комнату мобов!
meaning: Wait; don’t be too fast.
ex: Hold your horses, we haven’t decided what to buy yet.

en: Together we can take down the dragon in one go.
ru: Вместе мы сможем одолеть дракона за один заход.
meaning: to defeat, to write down, or to remove
ex: Can you take down my phone number?
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I’ll call my grandma to check up on her.
ru: Позвоню бабушке, проверю, как она.
meaning: to see if someone or something is okay
ex: Check up on the new player to see if they need help.

en: I’m extremely tired after streaming for six hours straight.
ru: Я просто валюсь с ног после шести часов стрима подряд.
meaning: very tired, with no energy
ex: He was extremely tired after the long flight.

en: There’s no time to lose, the bridge is collapsing!
ru: Нельзя терять ни секунды, мост рушится!
meaning: We must act immediately.
ex: There’s no time to lose, the shop closes in five minutes.

en: I suppose we could try the other route.
ru: Полагаю, можно попробовать другой маршрут.
meaning: I think so, but I’m not very sure
ex: I suppose you’re right.

en: I get on well with my new flatmate; we have the same sense of humour.
ru: Я отлично лажу с новым соседом по квартире: у нас одинаковое чувство юмора.
meaning: to have a friendly relationship with someone
ex: Do you get on well with the other players in your team?

en: Our neighbour is very friendly.
ru: Наш сосед очень дружелюбный.
meaning: a person who lives near you
ex: My neighbour in the game keeps stealing my apples.

en: There’s a heatwave this week, so everyone is staying indoors.
ru: На этой неделе жара, поэтому все сидят дома.
meaning: A period of very hot weather.
ex: A heatwave in the desert level slowly drains your health.

en: Someone tried to hack my account, so I changed the password.
ru: Кто-то пытался взломать мой аккаунт, так что пароль уже сменён.
meaning: to get into a computer system without permission
ex: They hacked the company’s website last night.

en: I’m deleting this game for good, it takes too much time.
ru: Я удаляю эту игру навсегда: она отнимает слишком много времени.
meaning: Forever; permanently.
ex: They moved abroad for good last year.

en: It’s a lot to take in, so please explain it slowly.
ru: Это очень много информации, объясни, пожалуйста, помедленнее.
meaning: to understand or absorb information
ex: Let’s take in the view before the final fight.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Stop showing off and help us with the boss!
ru: Хватит красоваться и помоги нам с боссом!
meaning: to try to impress people with your skills or things
ex: He loves showing off his new car.

en: Your homemade pizza is absolutely delicious.
ru: Твоя домашняя пицца просто восхитительна.
meaning: very tasty, extremely good
ex: The in-game cooking buff sounds absolutely delicious.

en: It’s now or never, we have to open the door before the timer ends.
ru: Сейчас или никогда, нужно открыть дверь до конца таймера.
meaning: This is the only chance to do it.
ex: It’s now or never, so tell her how you feel.

en: I guess we should leave now.
ru: Наверное, нам пора идти.
meaning: I think so, but I’m not sure
ex: I guess this is the best build.

en: A real friendship doesn’t end after one argument.
ru: Настоящая дружба не заканчивается после одной ссоры.
meaning: a relationship between friends
ex: Our friendship started in an online game ten years ago.

en: They’re still paying the mortgage on their flat.
ru: Они всё ещё выплачивают ипотеку за свою квартиру.
meaning: a loan from a bank to buy a house
ex: In this simulator, you take a mortgage to buy your first house.

en: A cool breeze from the sea made the afternoon pleasant.
ru: Прохладный морской бриз сделал день приятным.
meaning: A light, gentle wind.
ex: The leaves move in the breeze, and the graphics look great.

en: I don’t show my face on stream because I care about my privacy.
ru: Я не показываю лицо на стриме, потому что забочусь о своей приватности.
meaning: the right to keep your personal life secret
ex: Read the privacy rules before you sign up to the site.

en: With this build, we’ll clear the dungeon in no time.
ru: С этой сборкой мы пройдём подземелье в два счёта.
meaning: Very quickly.
ex: Don’t worry, we’ll finish cleaning in no time.

en: We’ll take on the top team of the league tonight.
ru: Сегодня вечером мы сыграем против лучшей команды лиги.
meaning: to accept a task, or to fight an opponent
ex: I can’t take on any more work this month.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: She got angry and hung up on me.
ru: Она разозлилась и бросила трубку.
meaning: to end a phone call
ex: Don’t hang up, stay on voice chat.

en: The instructions in this tutorial were perfectly clear.
ru: Инструкции в этом обучении были абсолютно понятны.
meaning: completely easy to understand
ex: Your plan is perfectly clear, let’s go.

en: We must protect the princess at any cost.
ru: Мы должны защитить принцессу любой ценой.
meaning: Whatever the price or sacrifice.
ex: He wanted to win the contract at any cost.

en: Will they fix this bug today? I doubt it.
ru: Исправят этот баг сегодня? Вряд ли.
meaning: I don’t think that is true or likely
ex: Will he call back? I doubt it.

en: They have a very warm relationship with their children.
ru: У них очень тёплые отношения с детьми.
meaning: the way two people or groups feel and behave towards each other
ex: The relationship between the teammates got better after the talk.

en: I need to do the laundry before the trip.
ru: Мне нужно постирать вещи перед поездкой.
meaning: to wash dirty clothes
ex: Hold on, let me do the laundry while the game loads.

en: If the temperature drops again, you’ll need warmer armour.
ru: Если температура опять упадёт, тебе понадобится более тёплая броня.
meaning: How hot or cold something is.
ex: The temperature fell to minus ten last night.

en: Make sure your connection is secure before you enter your card details.
ru: Убедись, что соединение защищённое, прежде чем вводить данные карты.
meaning: safe from danger or from attack
ex: Make sure your game account is secure with a strong password.

en: Keep that rope, it might come in handy later in the level.
ru: Оставь эту верёвку, она может пригодиться позже на уровне.
meaning: Be useful in the future.
ex: A small flashlight always comes in handy on trips.

en: My kids took to swimming right away.
ru: Мои дети сразу полюбили плавание.
meaning: to start to like someone or something
ex: Chat really took to the new mascot.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The new trend didn’t catch on in our country.
ru: Новый тренд у нас не прижился.
meaning: to become popular; to understand
ex: That game mode caught on fast among streamers.

en: Many viewers are deeply disappointed with the ending of the show.
ru: Многие зрители глубоко разочарованы концовкой сериала.
meaning: very sad because something is not as good as hoped
ex: We were deeply disappointed with the game’s final level.

en: Don’t press everything all at once, you’ll get confused.
ru: Не нажимай всё сразу, запутаешься.
meaning: At the same time; suddenly together.
ex: Too many guests arrived all at once and the kitchen was a mess.

en: It will most likely rain this evening.
ru: Вероятнее всего, вечером пойдёт дождь.
meaning: very probably
ex: Most likely, the next boss is weak to fire.

en: She decided to break up with her boyfriend after two years.
ru: Она решила расстаться с парнем после двух лет отношений.
meaning: to end a romantic relationship with someone
ex: The two best players broke up with their old team and joined ours.

en: There’s a leak in the bathroom ceiling.
ru: В потолке ванной течёт.
meaning: a hole or crack where liquid comes through
ex: A leak of the game’s new map appeared online yesterday.

en: The sky is overcast, so the stealth mission should be easier.
ru: Небо затянуто тучами, так что скрытная миссия должна пройти легче.
meaning: Covered with grey clouds.
ex: It was overcast all day, and the beach was empty.

en: Wood is the most important resource on this map, so collect as much as you can.
ru: Дерево — самый важный ресурс на этой карте, так что собирай как можно больше.
meaning: something useful that you can use, such as money or materials
ex: Our library has lots of free resources for students.

en: Try blocking right before the hit. That should do the trick.
ru: Попробуй заблокировать прямо перед ударом. Это должно сработать.
meaning: Solve the problem successfully.
ex: A warm cup of tea should do the trick for your cold.

en: Don’t take it out on me just because you had a bad day.
ru: Не срывайся на мне только потому, что у тебя был плохой день.
meaning: to be angry at someone who did nothing wrong
ex: He lost the match and took it out on his teammates.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Thanks for pointing out the hidden trap!
ru: Спасибо, что указал на скрытую ловушку!
meaning: to show or tell someone about something
ex: Let me point out one small mistake in the report.

en: Because of the heavy rain, the match was moved to a different map.
ru: Из-за сильного дождя матч перенесли на другую карту.
meaning: a lot of rain falling fast
ex: Heavy rain made us cancel the picnic.

en: Today I’ll show you what happens behind the scenes of my streams.
ru: Сегодня покажу, что происходит за кулисами моих стримов.
meaning: In the private part that the public does not see.
ex: Behind the scenes, the waiters work very hard to keep the restaurant running.

en: A higher level is not necessarily better; skill matters more.
ru: Более высокий уровень не обязательно лучше: важнее навык.
meaning: not always true
ex: The most popular restaurant is not necessarily the best.

en: He is in love with his coworker, but he is too shy to tell her.
ru: Он влюблён в коллегу, но слишком стесняется ей сказать.
meaning: to have strong romantic feelings for someone
ex: Chat, I’m in love with this soundtrack, it’s perfect.

en: My armor is almost broken, I need to repair it.
ru: Моя броня почти сломана, её нужно починить.
meaning: to fix something that is broken
ex: We need to repair the bike before the weekend.

en: It gets chilly in the evening, so take a jacket.
ru: Вечером становится прохладно, так что возьми куртку.
meaning: Rather cold, but not very cold.
ex: The game gets chilly at night, and my character shivers.

en: The company interviewed five candidates for the job today.
ru: Сегодня компания провела собеседования с пятью кандидатами на эту должность.
meaning: a person who is trying to get a job or a prize
ex: In the game the new candidate must win the vote of the team.

en: Let’s get the ball rolling and start the meeting with the budget.
ru: Давайте начнём и откроем встречу с вопроса о бюджете.
meaning: Start something so that it can continue.
ex: Chat, I’ll get the ball rolling with a quick warm-up round.

en: Put on your headset, we can’t hear you.
ru: Надень гарнитуру, мы тебя не слышим.
meaning: to wear something, or to turn something on
ex: It’s cold, put on a jacket.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Back me up, I’m going in!
ru: Прикрой меня, я захожу!
meaning: to support someone
ex: My friends always back me up in arguments.

en: I need some strong coffee for this all-night stream.
ru: Мне нужен крепкий кофе для этого ночного стрима.
meaning: coffee with a lot of flavour and caffeine
ex: He drinks strong coffee every morning before work.

en: For the record, everyone knew this plan wouldn’t work.
ru: Для протокола: все знали, что этот план не сработает.
meaning: Said to make a fact clear and official.
ex: For the record, chat, that jump was not a mistake on purpose.

en: In theory, the trip takes two hours.
ru: Теоретически поездка занимает два часа.
meaning: if everything works as planned
ex: In theory, this combo should kill him in one go.

en: We try to keep in touch with our school friends, even from other cities.
ru: Мы стараемся поддерживать связь со школьными друзьями, даже из других городов.
meaning: to continue to talk or write to someone
ex: I keep in touch with my old teammates through voice chat.

en: I have a terrible headache, I need to lie down.
ru: У меня ужасно болит голова, нужно прилечь.
meaning: a pain in your head
ex: These bright colours give me a headache after hours of gaming.

en: Lightning just hit that tree, did you see it?
ru: Молния только что ударила в то дерево, это было видно?
meaning: A bright flash of light in the sky during a storm.
ex: Never stand under a tree during lightning.

en: Teaching is a hard profession, but it’s very rewarding.
ru: Преподавание — трудная профессия, но очень благодарная.
meaning: a job that needs special training
ex: Being a professional gamer is a real profession now.

en: You take the shield, I take the bow? It’s a deal.
ru: Ты берёшь щит, я лук? Договорились.
meaning: Used to agree to an offer.
ex: You cook dinner and I’ll wash the dishes. It’s a deal.

en: We keep putting off the trip because of work.
ru: Мы всё откладываем поездку из-за работы.
meaning: to delay something until later
ex: Stop putting off the final mission and just do it.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: He backed out of the deal at the last minute.
ru: Он в последний момент отказался от сделки.
meaning: to decide not to do something you promised
ex: Don’t back out now, we already joined the queue.

en: The lag is a major problem for our team in ranked games.
ru: Лаги — серьёзная проблема для нашей команды в рейтинговых играх.
meaning: a very serious or important problem
ex: Money is a major problem for many young families.

en: In case you’re wondering, yes, we are playing on the hardest mode.
ru: Если вам интересно, да, мы играем на самом сложном уровне.
meaning: Said to answer a question people may have.
ex: In case you’re wondering, the restaurant is closed on Mondays.

en: It sounds good, but in practice this trick is really hard to pull off.
ru: Звучит хорошо, но на практике этот приём очень сложно выполнить.
meaning: in real situations
ex: In practice, the plan didn’t work.

en: I am close to my grandmother; we talk almost every day.
ru: Мы с бабушкой очень близки: говорим почти каждый день.
meaning: to have a strong, warm relationship with someone
ex: The squad is close to each other, like a second family.

en: You need a prescription to buy this medicine.
ru: Для покупки этого лекарства нужен рецепт.
meaning: a paper from a doctor for a medicine
ex: In the game, the doctor gives you a prescription for a healing potion.

en: It’s going to be sunny tomorrow, so let’s go to the beach.
ru: Завтра будет солнечно, так что поедем на пляж.
meaning: With a lot of sun and little cloud.
ex: The sunny weather in the game makes the grass look bright.

en: You don’t need a special qualification to apply for this job.
ru: Для этой работы не нужна специальная квалификация.
meaning: an exam or course you have passed
ex: She has a qualification in graphic design.

en: This level is too long. You’re telling me, I’ve been here for an hour!
ru: Этот уровень слишком длинный. Ещё бы, я тут уже час!
meaning: Used to say you strongly agree.
ex: Traffic today is crazy. You’re telling me, I was stuck for an hour.

en: I can’t put up with this lag any longer.
ru: Я больше не могу мириться с этими лагами.
meaning: to accept something annoying without complaining
ex: She puts up with the noise from her neighbors.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The enemy won’t back down, so we must hold the line.
ru: Враг не отступит, так что мы должны удержать линию.
meaning: to give up a position in an argument or fight
ex: She refused to back down in the argument.

en: He had a serious injury in the last match and can’t play.
ru: Он получил серьёзную травму в последнем матче и не может играть.
meaning: a bad physical hurt
ex: She suffered a serious injury in a car accident.

en: Long story short, we missed the train and walked home.
ru: Короче говоря, мы опоздали на поезд и пошли домой пешком.
meaning: Said before giving only the main result of a story.
ex: Long story short, the boss died and we got all the loot.

en: For a start, it’s too expensive.
ru: Во-первых, это слишком дорого.
meaning: used to give the first reason
ex: For a start, this character is too slow.

en: My little sister is crazy about horses and draws them all day.
ru: Моя младшая сестра без ума от лошадей и рисует их целыми днями.
meaning: to love or like something or someone very much
ex: Chat is crazy about the new character, and honestly, so are we.

en: The pharmacy on the corner is open all night.
ru: Аптека на углу открыта всю ночь.
meaning: a shop that sells medicines
ex: Buy the antidote at the pharmacy in the second town.

en: A storm is coming, so we should find shelter.
ru: Надвигается буря, так что нужно найти укрытие.
meaning: A period of very bad weather with strong wind and rain.
ex: The storm knocked down a few trees last night.

en: He has a degree in computer science, but now he streams games full-time.
ru: У него диплом по информатике, но сейчас он занимается только стримами игр.
meaning: a university qualification
ex: She got her degree last year and found a job quickly.

en: Please bear with me, I’m fixing my microphone and it’ll take a minute.
ru: Пожалуйста, потерпите немного, я чиню микрофон, это займёт минуту.
meaning: Be patient while I do something.
ex: Bear with me, I’m still looking for the right document.

en: Please put your toys away before dinner.
ru: Пожалуйста, убери свои игрушки до ужина.
meaning: to put something in its proper place
ex: Put away your weapon, this is a safe zone.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Two players dropped out before the tournament began.
ru: Двое игроков выбыли ещё до начала турнира.
meaning: to leave a course or competition before the end
ex: He dropped out of college to start a business.

en: Eating while I play is a bad habit of mine.
ru: Привычка есть во время игры у меня вредная.
meaning: a regular thing you do that is not good for you
ex: Biting your nails is a bad habit.

en: If you ask me, this level is way harder than the last one.
ru: По-моему, этот уровень намного сложнее прошлого.
meaning: Used to give your own opinion.
ex: If you ask me, the new café is too expensive.

en: Besides, we still have an extra life.
ru: К тому же у нас ещё есть дополнительная жизнь.
meaning: also, used to add a stronger reason
ex: I don’t want to go out; besides, it’s cold.

en: It was sensible of her to save money instead of buying a new phone.
ru: Разумно с её стороны было копить деньги вместо покупки нового телефона.
meaning: having good judgement and making reasonable decisions
ex: The sensible choice here is to retreat and heal.

en: She has a high fever and a cough.
ru: У неё высокая температура и кашель.
meaning: a body temperature that is higher than normal
ex: My character has a fever and loses health every minute.

en: A snowstorm closed the road to the mountains.
ru: Метель закрыла дорогу в горы.
meaning: A heavy snowfall with strong wind.
ex: We got caught in a snowstorm in the game and couldn’t see anything.

en: I have a big assignment due on Monday, so I can’t join the raid.
ru: В понедельник надо сдать большое задание, так что в рейд я не пойду.
meaning: a piece of work given to a student or employee
ex: In this game, each assignment gives you extra points.

en: I can’t put this game down, it’s too addictive.
ru: Не могу оторваться от этой игры, она слишком затягивает.
meaning: to place something on a surface, or to stop holding it
ex: She put down her bag and sat on the sofa.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Feel free to drop in any time this week.
ru: Заходите в любое время на этой неделе.
meaning: to visit someone without planning
ex: Some viewers drop in just to say hello.

en: Winning the championship took years of hard work.
ru: Победа в чемпионате потребовала многолетнего упорного труда.
meaning: a lot of effort and energy
ex: Success in games takes hard work and time.

en: Stay tuned, chat, the big boss fight is coming up next.
ru: Не переключайтесь, чат, дальше большая битва с боссом.
meaning: Said to ask people to wait for more news or content.
ex: Stay tuned for the weather report after the news.

en: Take an umbrella; otherwise you’ll get wet.
ru: Возьми зонт, иначе промокнешь.
meaning: if not, or in a different situation
ex: Save now; otherwise you’ll lose your progress.

en: Our manager is hard-working and often stays at the office until late.
ru: Наш менеджер трудолюбивый и часто остаётся в офисе допоздна.
meaning: putting a lot of effort into your work
ex: Our hard-working healer never stops supporting the squad.

en: Sorry chat, I have a bad cough, let me mute for a second.
ru: Простите, чат, у меня сильный кашель, на секунду отключу микрофон.
meaning: a sudden noise made when air comes out of your throat
ex: A dry cough kept me awake all night.

en: It’s pouring outside, so let’s stay in and play something.
ru: На улице льёт как из ведра, так что давай останемся дома и во что-нибудь поиграем.
meaning: To rain very heavily.
ex: It’s pouring in the game, so the screen is really dark.

en: I need to revise all night for tomorrow’s test.
ru: Мне надо всю ночь повторять материал к завтрашнему тесту.
meaning: to study again what you have learned
ex: I’ll revise the plan after we play a few more rounds.

en: The firefighters quickly put out the fire.
ru: Пожарные быстро потушили огонь.
meaning: to stop a fire or light, or to publish something
ex: The studio will put out a new trailer tomorrow.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Let’s fill up the tank before the trip.
ru: Давай заправим полный бак перед поездкой.
meaning: to make something completely full
ex: Fill up your health bar before the next wave.

en: The baby was fast asleep when we got home.
ru: Малыш крепко спал, когда мы пришли домой.
meaning: sleeping deeply
ex: My teammate fell fast asleep during the stream.

en: No offence, but your plan sounds a little risky.
ru: Без обид, но твой план звучит рискованно.
meaning: Said before saying something that may upset someone.
ex: No offence, but this soup needs more salt.

en: We’ll lose unless we all attack at once.
ru: Мы проиграем, если не атакуем все сразу.
meaning: if not, except if
ex: I’ll be there at six unless the train is late.

en: We’re fed up with the noise from the neighbours’ party every weekend.
ru: Нам надоел шум от вечеринок у соседей каждые выходные.
meaning: to be annoyed or tired of something that continues
ex: Chat is fed up with the lag, and so are we.

en: I’m allergic to nuts, so I always check the label.
ru: У меня аллергия на орехи, поэтому я всегда читаю этикетку.
meaning: having a bad reaction to a food or substance
ex: My character is allergic to bee stings, so avoid the hive.

en: It’s cloudy today, so we may not see the sunset.
ru: Сегодня облачно, так что закат мы, возможно, не увидим.
meaning: Covered with clouds.
ex: The cloudy sky in this game makes everything look gloomy.

en: The lecture was so boring that I almost fell asleep.
ru: Лекция была такой скучной, что я чуть не уснул.
meaning: a talk given to a group to teach about a subject
ex: He watched an online lecture while he was waiting for the match.

en: We put together a team of five for the tournament.
ru: Мы собрали команду из пяти человек для турнира.
meaning: to build something or combine parts
ex: It took two hours to put the wardrobe together.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The organizers called off the tournament because of server problems.
ru: Организаторы отменили турнир из-за проблем с серверами.
meaning: to cancel something planned
ex: They called off the picnic because of rain.

en: This shop sells a wide range of products for every budget.
ru: Этот магазин продаёт широкий ассортимент товаров на любой бюджет.
meaning: a large variety of things
ex: The game has a wide range of weapons.

en: You think you can beat me at this level? In your dreams!
ru: Думаешь, победишь меня на этом уровне? Даже не мечтай!
meaning: Said when you think something will never happen.
tr: даже не мечтай, в твоих мечтах
ex: In your dreams, I’m not lending you my car.

en: You can use the car provided that you bring it back by six.
ru: Можно взять машину при условии, что вернёшь её к шести.
meaning: only if something happens
ex: We’ll win provided that our healer stays alive.

en: He’s anxious about the exam and can’t sleep well.
ru: Он тревожится из-за экзамена и плохо спит.
meaning: worried and afraid about something that may happen
ex: I always feel anxious before the last wave of enemies.

en: This game makes me feel dizzy, the camera moves too fast.
ru: От этой игры кружится голова, камера двигается слишком быстро.
meaning: feeling that everything is turning around you
ex: I felt dizzy after standing up too quickly.

en: Wow, look at this landscape, it’s like a painting.
ru: Вау, посмотри на этот пейзаж, как будто картина.
meaning: The natural scenery of an area, including hills and fields.
ex: The landscape here changes completely in autumn.

en: I did some research before buying a new graphics card.
ru: Перед покупкой новой видеокарты пришлось немного изучить вопрос.
meaning: careful study to find new information
ex: Our team does research on how people use social media.

en: She put forward a great idea at the meeting.
ru: Она выдвинула отличную идею на встрече.
meaning: to suggest an idea or plan
ex: Chat put forward a funny plan to beat the boss with only a spoon.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Please pass on my thanks to the team.
ru: Пожалуйста, передайте мою благодарность команде.
meaning: to give information or something to another person
ex: Pass on the tip about the secret room to the others.

en: Their new game was a huge success worldwide.
ru: Их новая игра имела огромный успех по всему миру.
meaning: a very great success
ex: Our party was a huge success.

en: Nothing personal, but I prefer to work on this project on my own.
ru: Ничего личного, но над этим проектом я предпочитаю работать самостоятельно.
meaning: Said to show you are not attacking the person.
ex: Nothing personal, friend, but I’m taking the last chest.

en: Take extra ammo in case the fight lasts long.
ru: Возьми побольше патронов на случай, если бой затянется.
meaning: because something might happen
ex: Take a jacket in case it gets cold.

en: She felt insecure at her new job and thought everyone was better.
ru: Она чувствовала себя неуверенно на новой работе и думала, что все лучше неё.
meaning: not confident about yourself or your abilities
ex: Some new players feel insecure when they join a strong team.

en: Wait, I need a second to heal before we open the door.
ru: Подожди, мне нужна секунда, чтобы подлечиться, прежде чем мы откроем дверь.
meaning: to become healthy again, or to make someone healthy
ex: It takes a few days for a small cut to heal.

en: The scenery along the coast is unbelievable.
ru: Виды вдоль побережья просто невероятные.
meaning: The natural views of a place, such as hills and trees.
ex: I stopped just to enjoy the scenery in this level.

en: The company offered him a one-year contract as a video editor.
ru: Компания предложила ему годовой контракт монтажёра.
meaning: a legal agreement, especially about work
ex: Read the contract carefully before you sign it.

en: Put that sword back in the chest, it’s cursed!
ru: Положи этот меч обратно в сундук, он проклят!
meaning: to return something to its place, or to delay it
ex: They put the meeting back to Friday.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Your skin really stands out in the crowd.
ru: Твой скин реально выделяется в толпе.
meaning: to be easy to notice because of being different
ex: She stands out because of her bright coat.

en: We’re working on a tight deadline, so no long lunches this week.
ru: Мы работаем в сжатые сроки, поэтому на этой неделе без долгих обедов.
meaning: a very short time to finish something
ex: The streamer works with a tight deadline before the big release.

en: Novices win a lot. Was that beginner’s luck? It’s your first time in this game!
ru: Новичкам везёт? Ты ведь впервые в этой игре!
meaning: Success that happens only because it is your first try.
ex: She won the first time she played chess, pure beginner’s luck.

en: He talks as if he knows everything.
ru: Он говорит так, как будто знает всё.
meaning: in a way that suggests something
ex: It feels as if the game is lagging.

en: He was ashamed of his behaviour at the party and apologized.
ru: Ему было стыдно за своё поведение на вечеринке, и он извинился.
meaning: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something you did
ex: Don’t feel ashamed of dying in the first minute, it happens to everyone.

en: The doctor says the treatment will take three weeks.
ru: Врач говорит, что лечение займёт три недели.
meaning: medical care given to a sick or hurt person
ex: In the game, treatment in the hospital costs a lot of gold.

en: The wildlife in this game is incredible, there are even foxes.
ru: Дикая природа в этой игре невероятная, тут даже лисы есть.
meaning: Animals and plants that live in nature.
ex: We saw a lot of wildlife on our trip to the national park.

en: She got a promotion after only one year, so we’re celebrating tonight.
ru: Её повысили всего через год, так что сегодня мы это отмечаем.
meaning: a move to a better job in a company
ex: In the game, you earn a promotion after you win ten matches.

en: Can you put us up for one night?
ru: Ты можешь приютить нас на одну ночь?
meaning: to give someone a place to sleep, or to build or raise
ex: Put up your shield, the arrows are coming!
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: What does this abbreviation stand for?
ru: Что означает эта аббревиатура?
meaning: to mean or represent something
ex: GG stands for good game.

en: There is fierce competition in the tournament this year.
ru: В этом году на турнире жёсткая конкуренция.
meaning: very strong rivalry between people
ex: There is fierce competition for jobs in this field.

en: Don’t worry, the exam will be a piece of cake.
ru: Не волнуйся, экзамен будет проще простого.
meaning: Something very easy to do.
ex: That boss was a piece of cake once we found its weak spot.

en: I’ll turn the music down so that chat can hear me.
ru: Сейчас сделаем музыку тише, чтобы чат меня слышал.
meaning: used to give the purpose of an action
ex: He spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.

en: She felt guilty for forgetting her friend’s birthday.
ru: Она чувствовала вину за то, что забыла о дне рождения подруги.
meaning: feeling bad because you did something wrong
ex: I feel guilty that we lost because of my mistake in the last fight.

en: One side effect of this medicine is sleepiness.
ru: Один из побочных эффектов этого лекарства — сонливость.
meaning: an unwanted result of taking a medicine
ex: The potion gives you extra speed, but there’s a side effect: you can’t see well.

en: Let’s explore the whole island before we do the main quest.
ru: Давай исследуем весь остров, прежде чем браться за основной квест.
meaning: To travel around a place to find out what it is like.
ex: We want to explore the old town on foot.

en: My workload is crazy this week, so I probably won’t be online.
ru: На этой неделе у меня сумасшедшая нагрузка, так что я, скорее всего, не буду в сети.
meaning: the amount of work a person has to do
ex: The team’s workload is heavy during the tournament.

en: Please hold on, I’ll put you through to the manager.
ru: Подождите, пожалуйста, я переключу вас на руководителя.
meaning: to connect someone by phone
ex: The final level puts players through a very hard test.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Real friends stand by you when things get hard.
ru: Настоящие друзья поддерживают тебя, когда становится трудно.
meaning: to stay loyal and support someone
ex: I’ll stand by you even if we lose this match.

en: We’re making steady progress on the new house.
ru: Мы стабильно продвигаемся со строительством нового дома.
meaning: regular improvement without sudden jumps
ex: Steady progress in the game beats rushing.

en: Beat the boss without getting hit? That’s easier said than done.
ru: Победить босса, ни разу не получив урона? Легко сказать.
meaning: Something sounds simple but is hard to do.
ex: Quitting sugar is easier said than done.

en: We left early in order to avoid the traffic.
ru: Мы выехали пораньше, чтобы избежать пробок.
meaning: used to say why you do something
ex: In order to unlock this skin, you need to finish ten matches.

en: We’re really grateful for your help with the move.
ru: Мы очень благодарны за вашу помощь с переездом.
meaning: feeling thankful for something someone did
ex: Chat, we’re so grateful to everyone who joined the stream tonight.

en: Keep the wound clean to avoid an infection.
ru: Держи рану в чистоте, чтобы избежать инфекции.
meaning: an illness caused by germs
ex: The zombie bite gives you an infection that slowly drains your health.

en: Careful, there’s a cliff right behind you!
ru: Осторожно, прямо у тебя за спиной обрыв!
meaning: A high, steep wall of rock, often by the sea.
ex: They stood at the edge of the cliff and looked at the sea.

en: I have to work overtime again, so start without me.
ru: Мне опять придётся работать сверхурочно, так что начинайте без меня.
meaning: extra hours that you work after normal hours
ex: I’m tired because I did two hours of overtime yesterday.

en: Let’s put aside our differences and win this round.
ru: Давайте забудем разногласия и выиграем этот раунд.
meaning: to ignore a problem, or to save something for later
ex: I put aside some money every month for a trip.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: You have to stand up for yourself at work.
ru: На работе нужно уметь постоять за себя.
meaning: to defend someone or an idea
ex: Stand up for your teammate when chat is rude.

en: There was a sharp increase in viewers after the update.
ru: После обновления произошёл резкий рост числа зрителей.
meaning: a sudden and big rise
ex: Prices showed a sharp increase last month.

en: You want to try again? That’s the spirit!
ru: Хочешь попробовать ещё раз? Вот это настрой!
meaning: Said to praise a positive, brave attitude.
ex: That’s the spirit, keep studying and you’ll pass.

en: This mode is free, and what’s more, it has no ads.
ru: Этот режим бесплатный, и более того, в нём нет рекламы.
meaning: used to add a more important point
ex: The room is big, and what’s more, it has a great view.

en: The nurse was very sympathetic and listened to every worry.
ru: Медсестра была очень сочувствующей и выслушала все тревоги.
meaning: showing that you understand and care about someone’s problems
ex: A sympathetic teammate will never laugh at your mistakes.

en: I’m trying to get in shape before summer.
ru: Я стараюсь привести себя в форму к лету.
meaning: healthy and strong because you exercise
ex: You have to stay in shape in this game or your character gets tired.

en: We walked through a green valley surrounded by mountains.
ru: Мы шли по зелёной долине, окружённой горами.
meaning: A low area of land between hills or mountains.
ex: The valley is hidden behind the mountains, so we need to find the path.

en: I do remote work three days a week, so I’m often home when the new game comes out.
ru: Я работаю удалённо три дня в неделю, так что часто бываю дома, когда выходит новая игра.
meaning: done from a distance, not in an office
ex: Do you want to try a remote control for your game console?

en: He put in a lot of hours to finish the project.
ru: Он вложил много часов, чтобы закончить проект.
meaning: to spend time or effort on something
ex: I put in about fifty hours to unlock that ending.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Sorry, this jump always messes me up.
ru: Прости, этот прыжок у меня вечно не получается.
meaning: to do something badly or ruin it
ex: Don’t mess up the schedule again.

en: There’s only a slight difference between these two skins.
ru: Между этими двумя скинами лишь небольшая разница.
meaning: a very small change
ex: I see a slight difference in the colour of the two shirts.

en: Easy does it, move slowly past the guards.
ru: Потихоньку, двигайся медленно мимо стражников.
meaning: Be slow and careful.
ex: Easy does it, the shelf is heavy.

en: I’m not angry. On the contrary, this makes me happy.
ru: Это не злит. Совсем наоборот, это радует.
meaning: used to say the opposite is true
ex: The game isn’t boring; on the contrary, it’s very exciting.

en: He’s very sensitive and gets hurt by small jokes.
ru: Он очень чувствительный и обижается на мелкие шутки.
meaning: easily upset or offended
ex: Some players are sensitive about their rank, so be kind.

en: Chat, I’m eating a healthy salad today, no more chips!
ru: Чат, сегодня я ем полезный салат, больше никаких чипсов!
meaning: good for your body; not ill
ex: Try to eat healthy food every day.

en: Out here in the wilderness there are no towns, so we must craft our own gear.
ru: Здесь, в дикой местности, нет городов, так что снаряжение придётся делать самим.
meaning: A wild natural area where nobody lives.
ex: He spent a month alone in the wilderness.

en: He works as a freelance designer, so he chooses his own hours.
ru: Он работает фрилансером-дизайнером, поэтому сам выбирает часы работы.
meaning: working for different companies, not one employer
ex: She makes freelance videos for small streamers.

en: I’m looking for a team that plays ranked every night.
ru: Я ищу команду, которая играет рейтинговые матчи каждый вечер.
meaning: to try to find someone or something
ex: We’re looking for a flat near the center.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We were just messing around in the lobby.
ru: Мы просто дурачились в лобби.
meaning: to play or act silly without a serious purpose
ex: Stop messing around and do your homework.

en: Rushing in alone is a common mistake for new players.
ru: Бросаться вперёд в одиночку — типичная ошибка новичков.
meaning: a mistake many people make
ex: Forgetting a password is a common mistake.

en: Let’s order pasta. Actually, on second thought, I’ll have the soup.
ru: Закажем пасту. Хотя нет, подумав, возьму суп.
meaning: After thinking again, I have changed my mind.
ex: On second thought, let’s skip the chest, it looks suspicious.

en: Sure, it’s cheap, but that’s not the point; it’s just not fun.
ru: Да, оно дешёвое, но не в этом дело: просто это не весело.
meaning: used to say a thing is not the important issue
tr: не в этом дело, суть не в этом
ex: That’s not the point; the point is you should have told me.

en: My dad is so stubborn; he never changes his mind, even when he is wrong.
ru: Мой папа такой упрямый: он никогда не меняет своего мнения, даже когда неправ.
meaning: refusing to change your ideas or decisions
ex: That boss is stubborn — it never stops, so we must move all the time.

en: I have a sharp pain in my back.
ru: У меня острая боль в спине.
meaning: the feeling you have when part of your body hurts
ex: My wrist is in pain after ten hours of playing.

en: We drove along the coast and stopped at tiny fishing villages.
ru: Мы ехали вдоль побережья и останавливались в крошечных рыбацких деревнях.
meaning: The land next to the sea.
ex: The map’s coast has caves that hide treasure.

en: Every employee gets a free ticket to the gaming event.
ru: Каждый сотрудник получает бесплатный билет на игровую выставку.
meaning: a person who works for a company
ex: The new employee starts on Monday.

en: Can you look after my cat while I’m away?
ru: Можешь присмотреть за моим котом, пока меня не будет?
meaning: to take care of someone or something
ex: Please look after our healer, he’s low on health.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Grinding every night finally paid off, I got the rare drop!
ru: Ежедневный гринд наконец окупился, выпал редкий предмет!
meaning: to bring a good result after hard effort
ex: All that hard work finally paid off.

en: Let’s go for a walk and get some fresh air.
ru: Давай прогуляемся и подышим свежим воздухом.
meaning: clean cool air outside
ex: After eight hours online, some fresh air feels great.

en: Both offers are good, so it’s your call.
ru: Оба предложения хорошие, так что решение за тобой.
meaning: You have the right to make the decision.
ex: It’s your call, chat: left tunnel or right tunnel?

expr: let me put it this way
en: Let me put it this way: that plan won’t happen again.
ru: Скажем так: этот план больше не повторится.
meaning: used before explaining something more clearly
ex: Let me put it this way: this boss is not for beginners.
hint: l… m… p… i… t… w…

en: Our teacher is easy-going and never gets angry about small things.
ru: Наш учитель спокойный и покладистый и не сердится по мелочам.
meaning: relaxed and not easily worried or upset
ex: He’s easy-going, so he never gets mad when we lose.

en: These vitamins in the game give your character extra stamina.
ru: Эти витамины в игре дают персонажу дополнительную выносливость.
meaning: a substance in food that your body needs
ex: Take a vitamin every morning in winter.

en: Let’s swim to the shore before the shark finds us.
ru: Давай доплывём до берега, пока нас не нашла акула.
meaning: The land at the edge of the sea or a lake.
ex: We walked along the shore at sunset.

en: The studio wants to hire two more testers for the game.
ru: Студия хочет нанять ещё двух тестировщиков для игры.
meaning: to give someone a job
ex: We want to hire a new designer soon.

en: We’re really looking forward to the holidays.
ru: Мы очень ждём праздники.
meaning: to feel happy about something that will happen
ex: I’m looking forward to the new season of the game.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Doctors can’t rule out a simple cold yet.
ru: Врачи пока не могут исключить простую простуду.
meaning: to decide that something is not possible
ex: We can’t rule out that the boss has a second phase.

en: It was bitterly cold in the snow level, so our character kept shivering.
ru: В снежном уровне было нестерпимо холодно, поэтому наш персонаж всё время дрожал.
meaning: extremely cold in an unpleasant way
ex: It was bitterly cold when we walked to work.

en: Against all odds, we beat the final boss with one life left!
ru: Вопреки всему мы победили финального босса с одной жизнью!
meaning: Succeeding even though it seemed almost impossible.
ex: Against all odds, the small team won the championship.

en: To put it simply, press the button when the bar is full.
ru: Проще говоря, нажимай кнопку, когда полоска заполнится.
meaning: used to explain something in an easy way
ex: To put it simply, we have no money left.

en: My new neighbour is a reserved person; he rarely talks about himself.
ru: Мой новый сосед сдержанный человек и редко рассказывает о себе.
meaning: not showing your feelings or opinions to others
ex: He’s reserved in voice chat, but he’s very funny in text.

en: My character has a leg injury, so he can’t run.
ru: У моего персонажа травма ноги, поэтому он не может бегать.
meaning: damage to a part of your body
ex: He missed the season because of a knee injury.

en: There’s a hidden cave behind that waterfall.
ru: За тем водопадом есть скрытая пещера.
meaning: Water that falls from a high place down a rock.
ex: We had a picnic near a beautiful waterfall.

en: He decided to resign after the argument with the manager.
ru: Он решил уволиться после ссоры с руководителем.
meaning: to officially leave your job
ex: In the game story, the captain resigns after losing the battle.

en: Hold on, let me look the boss’s weakness up online.
ru: Погоди, поищу слабое место босса в интернете.
meaning: to search for information
ex: I looked up the word in the dictionary.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Do you want to team up and clear the dungeon?
ru: Хочешь объединиться в команду и зачистить подземелье?
meaning: to join someone to work or play together
ex: Two local shops teamed up for a big sale.

en: The house was badly damaged in the storm.
ru: Дом сильно пострадал во время бури.
meaning: hurt or broken in a serious way
ex: My armor is badly damaged, I need to repair it.

en: If we leave at five, we’ll get a head start on the traffic.
ru: Если выедем в пять, то опередим пробки.
meaning: An advantage of starting earlier than others.
ex: Take a head start and run to the exit while I distract it.

en: The bottom line is that we need more people.
ru: Суть в том, что нам нужно больше людей.
meaning: the most important fact
tr: суть в том, что, итог такой
ex: The bottom line is that this build is just too weak.

en: She’s an ambitious young manager who wants to lead the whole department.
ru: Она амбициозная молодая сотрудница, которая хочет возглавить весь отдел.
meaning: having a strong wish to be successful
ex: We’re ambitious this season and want to reach the top league.

en: I do a thirty-minute workout every morning.
ru: Каждое утро я делаю получасовую тренировку.
meaning: a session of physical exercise
ex: My finger workout before streams helps me play faster.

en: It takes six hours to reach the peak, but the view is amazing.
ru: Чтобы добраться до вершины, нужно шесть часов, но вид потрясающий.
meaning: The pointed top of a mountain.
ex: We need to reach the highest peak before the storm hits.

en: How do you cope with all the toxic players online?
ru: Как ты справляешься со всеми токсичными игроками в сети?
meaning: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
ex: It’s hard to cope with stress at work.

en: Look out, there’s a sniper on the left!
ru: Осторожно, слева снайпер!
meaning: to be careful, or to watch for danger
ex: Look out, there’s a bike coming!
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: One more kill and I level up!
ru: Ещё одно убийство, и у меня новый уровень!
meaning: to reach a higher level in a game or skill
ex: I want to level up my English this year.

en: This streamer is widely known for his funny reactions.
ru: Этот стример широко известен своими смешными реакциями.
meaning: known by many people
ex: It’s widely known that the city has great food.

en: You’ll beat the boss without healing? Good luck with that!
ru: Победишь босса без лечения? Ну, удачи с этим!
meaning: Said when you think something is very hard or unlikely.
ex: You want to park downtown on Saturday? Good luck with that.

en: It turns out the secret chest was behind the waterfall all along.
ru: Оказывается, секретный сундук всё это время был за водопадом.
meaning: used to say you found a surprising fact
ex: It turns out he lives next door.

en: He’s moody in the mornings, so we don’t talk to him before coffee.
ru: По утрам у него скверное настроение, поэтому мы с ним не разговариваем до кофе.
meaning: often changing quickly from happy to sad or angry
ex: Our moody teammate disappears from the call when we lose.

en: Let’s play one easy match as a warm-up before ranked games.
ru: Давай сыграем один лёгкий матч для разминки перед рейтинговыми играми.
meaning: light exercise done before a sport
ex: Always do a warm-up before you run.

en: I hate this desert, it’s hot and there’s no water anywhere.
ru: Терпеть не могу эту пустыню: жарко и нигде нет воды.
meaning: A large, dry area with very little rain.
ex: We crossed the desert by jeep.

en: This ranked match is so stressful that my hands are shaking.
ru: Этот рейтинговый матч такой нервный, что у меня трясутся руки.
meaning: making you feel worried and tense
ex: Moving to a new job can be very stressful.

en: The manager promised to look into the problem.
ru: Руководитель пообещал разобраться с проблемой.
meaning: to investigate something
ex: The developers are looking into the bug that crashes the game.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Power up your shield before the boss attacks.
ru: Зарядите щит до того, как босс атакует.
meaning: to give energy to something or start it
ex: Wait for the phone to power up.

en: It’s highly unlikely that we’ll find the secret room without a hint.
ru: Крайне маловероятно, что мы найдём секретную комнату без подсказки.
meaning: very improbable
ex: It’s highly unlikely that the train will be on time.

en: Thanks for the charger, I owe you one.
ru: Спасибо за зарядку, с меня причитается.
meaning: You helped me, so I will help you later.
tr: я твой должник, с меня причитается
ex: That heal saved us, I owe you one.

en: In my experience, cheap shoes break quickly.
ru: По опыту, дешёвая обувь быстро ломается.
meaning: from what I have seen or done myself
ex: In my experience, ranked matches are more stressful.

en: A loyal friend stays with you even when things are difficult.
ru: Верный друг остаётся рядом, даже когда трудно.
meaning: always supporting a person or group
ex: Our loyal viewers have watched every single stream.

en: My character has no stamina left, so he can’t sprint.
ru: У моего персонажа не осталось выносливости, поэтому он не может бежать.
meaning: the energy to do something for a long time
ex: Swimming every week improves your stamina.

en: There’s a small cave near the beach where kids like to play.
ru: Рядом с пляжем есть небольшая пещера, где любят играть дети.
meaning: A large natural hole in the side of a hill or under the ground.
ex: Let’s light a torch and go into the cave.

en: I’m really motivated to reach the top rank this season.
ru: Меня очень мотивирует цель достичь топового ранга в этом сезоне.
meaning: wanting to do something and putting effort into it
ex: Good teachers keep their students motivated.

en: Don’t look down on new players, everyone starts somewhere.
ru: Не смотри свысока на новичков, все с чего-то начинают.
meaning: to think you are better than someone
ex: He looks down on people who don’t read books.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Let’s gear up before we enter the raid.
ru: Давайте экипируемся перед входом в рейд.
meaning: to prepare with the right equipment
ex: We need to gear up for the hike.

en: This internet is painfully slow, the download will take hours.
ru: Этот интернет мучительно медленный, загрузка займёт несколько часов.
meaning: extremely slow in an annoying way
ex: The loading screen in this old game is painfully slow.

en: Phew, that was a close call, one more hit and we were dead.
ru: Фух, едва пронесло: ещё один удар, и нам конец.
meaning: A situation where something bad almost happened.
ex: That was a close call, I nearly missed my flight.

en: It’s cold today. That’s true, we need warm coats.
ru: Сегодня холодно. Это правда, нужны тёплые куртки.
meaning: I agree, it is correct
ex: That’s true; the dragon is weak to ice.

en: My parents were very supportive when I changed my career.
ru: Родители очень поддерживали меня во время смены профессии.
meaning: giving help and encouragement
ex: A supportive squad makes every hard level easier.

en: Our opponent in the final is the best team in the region.
ru: Наш соперник в финале — лучшая команда региона.
meaning: a person or team you play against
ex: The tennis opponent was much taller than him.

en: This trail is easy, so even kids can walk it.
ru: Эта тропа лёгкая, так что по ней могут пройти даже дети.
meaning: A path through the countryside or forest.
ex: Follow the trail of footprints, the monster went this way.

en: Streaming for six hours wasn’t very productive, because nobody came.
ru: Шесть часов стрима были не слишком продуктивными: никто не пришёл.
meaning: doing or producing a lot of useful things
ex: I’m more productive in the morning than in the afternoon.

en: I look up to my older brother.
ru: Я равняюсь на своего старшего брата.
meaning: to respect and admire someone
ex: Many young players look up to that streamer.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: A big wave of enemies wiped out our whole team.
ru: Огромная волна врагов выкосила всю нашу команду.
meaning: to destroy or kill completely
ex: The storm wiped out the whole harvest.

en: We have mixed feelings about moving to another city.
ru: У нас смешанные чувства по поводу переезда в другой город.
meaning: both positive and negative emotions at once
ex: I have mixed feelings about the new update.

en: Finding that key was a lucky break.
ru: Найти этот ключ было большой удачей.
meaning: A piece of good luck that helps you.
ex: Getting that job was a lucky break for her.

en: I’m afraid I disagree; the old map was much better.
ru: К сожалению, не согласен: старая карта была намного лучше.
meaning: a polite way to say you have a different opinion
tr: боюсь, не соглашусь, к сожалению, не согласен
ex: I’m afraid I disagree with the report.

en: He is very considerate and always turns the music down at night.
ru: Он очень тактичный и всегда делает музыку тише по ночам.
meaning: careful not to hurt or bother other people
ex: A considerate player mutes his mic when his family is sleeping.

en: The referee stopped the match because of the rain.
ru: Судья остановил матч из-за дождя.
meaning: the official who controls a sports match
ex: The referee in this tournament is really strict about cheating.

en: We’re going to hike in the mountains this weekend.
ru: В эти выходные мы идём в поход в горы.
meaning: To walk a long distance in the countryside.
ex: The hike to the top of the map takes ages.

en: We’re making good progress, we’ve cleared half of the dungeon.
ru: Мы хорошо продвигаемся — половина подземелья уже пройдена.
meaning: improvement or movement toward a goal
ex: The students made great progress this semester.

en: Never look back, just keep running to the exit!
ru: Не оглядывайся, просто беги к выходу!
meaning: to turn and look behind, or to think about the past
ex: When I look back, I miss our old flat.

en: Tickets for the concert sold out in an hour.
ru: Билеты на концерт разошлись за час.
meaning: to be completely sold, with none left
ex: The limited skin sold out in minutes.

en: This game has a steep learning curve, but it’s worth it.
ru: У этой игры крутая кривая обучения, но она того стоит.
meaning: a skill that is hard to learn at first
ex: The new software has a steep learning curve at work.

en: At this rate, we’ll never finish the level before midnight.
ru: В таком темпе мы не закончим уровень до полуночи.
meaning: If things continue at the same speed.
ex: At this rate, we’ll miss the train.

en: I feel a bit of envy when I see her travel photos.
ru: Я чувствую лёгкую зависть, когда смотрю её фотографии из путешествий.
meaning: the feeling of wanting what someone else has
ex: Chat, don’t envy my rare items, you’ll get them soon too.

en: We signed up for the tournament next weekend, so we’ll practice a lot.
ru: Мы записались на турнир в следующие выходные, так что будем много тренироваться.
meaning: a competition in which many players or teams take part
ex: Our school has a table tennis tournament every spring.

en: We should protect the environment by using fewer plastic bags.
ru: Нам стоит беречь окружающую среду и пользоваться меньшим количеством пластиковых пакетов.
meaning: The natural world around us, such as air, water and land.
ex: The game environment changes from day to night.

en: If we beat this boss, we can unlock a new character.
ru: Если победим этого босса, то сможем открыть нового персонажа.
meaning: to open something that was closed or not available
ex: You can unlock your phone with your face.

en: Can we just look around the shop before we buy anything?
ru: Можно мы просто осмотримся в магазине, прежде чем что-то купим?
meaning: to walk around and see a place
ex: Look around the room, there might be a secret door.

ru: Можешь подытожить главную мысль одним предложением?
meaning: to give the main points in a short form
ex: To sum up the match: we lost but had fun.

en: You need a stable connection to play online without lag.
ru: Нужно стабильное соединение, чтобы играть онлайн без лагов.
meaning: an internet link that works without breaks
ex: We need a stable connection for the video call.

en: To be fair, the test was harder than usual.
ru: Если по справедливости, тест был сложнее обычного.
meaning: Used to add a fair point in someone’s favour.
ex: To be fair, the boss has more health than we expected.

en: Kind words from friends can really improve a child’s self-esteem.
ru: Добрые слова друзей действительно могут повысить самооценку ребёнка.
meaning: the feeling of respect for yourself
ex: Winning small matches helps build a player’s self-esteem.

en: Our team can become the champion if we win this round.
ru: Наша команда может стать чемпионом, если выиграет этот раунд.
meaning: the person or team that wins a competition
ex: The champion of the city marathon is only seventeen.

en: Don’t go into the forest at night, there are wolves.
ru: Не ходи в лес ночью, там волки.
meaning: A large area covered with trees.
ex: We picked mushrooms in the forest last autumn.

en: The new patch fixed the bug, but now the sound is gone.
ru: Новый патч исправил баг, но теперь пропал звук.
meaning: a small update that fixes problems in software
ex: The company released a security patch yesterday.

en: Could you look over my CV before I send it?
ru: Можешь просмотреть моё резюме перед отправкой?
meaning: to check something quickly
ex: Let me look over my inventory before we leave town.

en: I almost pass out every time that jump scare hits.
ru: Я чуть не теряю сознание каждый раз, когда срабатывает этот скример.
meaning: to suddenly become unconscious
ex: It was so hot that she almost passed out.

en: A balanced diet gives you energy for long days.
ru: Сбалансированное питание даёт энергию на долгие дни.
meaning: eating many types of healthy food
ex: Even gamers need a balanced diet.

en: As a rule of thumb, don’t cook with a pan that’s too hot.
ru: Как правило, не стоит готовить на слишком горячей сковороде.
meaning: A simple, practical guide that is usually true.
ex: A good rule of thumb: save before every boss.

en: We have a lot in common; we both love hiking and old films.
ru: У нас много общего: мы оба любим походы и старые фильмы.
meaning: to share many interests or qualities with someone
ex: We became friends in the game because we have a lot in common.

en: The score is two to two, so the next goal decides everything.
ru: Счёт два-два, так что следующий гол решит всё.
meaning: the number of points in a game
ex: What was the score in the football match yesterday?

en: The island is only reachable by boat, so we need to find a captain.
ru: На остров можно добраться только на лодке, так что нужно найти капитана.
meaning: A piece of land with water all around it.
ex: We stayed on a tiny island with no cars.

en: I found a bug in the game: my character is stuck in a wall.
ru: Нашёлся баг в игре: мой персонаж застрял в стене.
meaning: a mistake in a computer program
ex: The developers spent two days fixing a bug in the app.

en: Chat, look through the settings and tell me what’s wrong with my mic.
ru: Чат, просмотрите настройки и скажите, что не так с моим микрофоном.
meaning: to read or search quickly through something
ex: She looked through old photos all evening.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The shop is giving away free coffee today.
ru: Сегодня магазин бесплатно раздаёт кофе.
meaning: to give something for free; to reveal a secret
ex: The streamer is giving away free game keys to viewers.

en: The boss took heavy damage from that explosion.
ru: Босс получил серьёзный урон от того взрыва.
meaning: a lot of harm
ex: The storm caused heavy damage to the town.

en: All in all, the trip was great.
ru: В целом поездка получилась отличной.
meaning: Considering everything.
tr: в целом, в общем и целом
ex: All in all, it was a fun stream, thanks for coming, everyone.

en: My sister is keen on painting and goes to classes twice a week.
ru: Моя сестра увлекается рисованием и ходит на занятия дважды в неделю.
meaning: to be very interested in or enthusiastic about something
ex: Are you keen on trying the new co-op mode tonight?

en: Our coach says we need to run more.
ru: Наш тренер говорит, что нам нужно больше бегать.
meaning: a person who trains a sports player or team
ex: Our team coach watches the recordings of every match.

en: Behind that mountain range there’s a whole new region.
ru: За тем горным хребтом находится целый новый регион.
meaning: A long line of mountains.
ex: The mountain range covers the whole northern border.

en: That was a weird glitch, the whole map just disappeared!
ru: Какой странный глюк — вся карта просто исчезла!
meaning: a small problem that makes a machine or program work badly
ex: A technical glitch stopped the online meeting for ten minutes.

en: Please look out for a man in a red coat at the station.
ru: Пожалуйста, высматривай на вокзале мужчину в красном пальто.
meaning: to watch carefully for someone or something
ex: Look out for traps in the next room.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Keep away from the lava, it hurts a lot.
ru: Держись подальше от лавы, она сильно жжёт.
meaning: to stay at a distance from something
ex: Keep the kids away from the stove.

en: There was a long queue at the cinema, so we went home.
ru: В кино была длинная очередь, поэтому мы пошли домой.
meaning: a long line of people waiting
ex: There’s a long queue for the ranked match tonight.

en: You mentioned coffee, and speaking of which, I need one right now.
ru: Раз уж заговорили о кофе, мне сейчас очень нужна чашка.
meaning: Used to move to a related subject just mentioned.
tr: кстати об этом, раз уж зашла речь
ex: Speaking of which, chat, don’t forget to subscribe.

en: They fell out with their old team and started their own channel.
ru: Они поссорились со своей старой командой и завели собственный канал.
meaning: to stop being friends after an argument
ex: I never want to fall out with my best friend over money.

en: We can defeat this boss if we all attack together.
ru: Мы можем победить этого босса, если все атакуем вместе.
meaning: to win against someone in a fight or game
ex: The home team suffered a heavy defeat last night.

en: Give me a sec, I’m trying to figure out this puzzle.
ru: Секунду, пытаюсь разобраться с этой головоломкой.
meaning: to understand something or find the answer by thinking about it
ex: I can’t figure out where the key is.

en: Our whole squad gets along really well, so ranked matches are fun.
ru: Вся наша команда отлично ладит, поэтому рейтинговые матчи — одно удовольствие.
meaning: to have a friendly relationship with someone
ex: My sister and her roommate don’t really get along.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Wait, turn your mic on, we can’t hear you.
ru: Подожди, включи микрофон, нас не слышно.
meaning: to start a machine, light or device
ex: It’s dark in here, can you turn on the light?

en: We’re finally making progress on this boss, his health bar is almost at half.
ru: Мы наконец-то продвигаемся в бою с этим боссом, его здоровье почти на половине.
meaning: to move forward and get closer to a goal
ex: My sister is making progress with her English every month.

en: Whoa, that was close, the boss almost got us!
ru: Ого, чуть не попались, босс почти нас достал!
meaning: Something bad almost happened, but it did not.
ex: That was close, that car almost hit the cyclist.

en: As far as I know, the shop closes at eight on Sundays.
ru: Насколько известно, по воскресеньям магазин закрывается в восемь.
meaning: used when you think something is true but are not completely sure
tr: насколько мне известно, насколько я знаю
ex: As far as I know, this sword gets weaker after the next patch.

en: I’m so frustrated — we lost the same round four times in a row.
ru: Как же бесит: мы четыре раза подряд проиграли один и тот же раунд.
meaning: annoyed and upset because you cannot do or change something
ex: My sister was frustrated because the printer kept jamming.

en: I can’t afford the legendary sword yet, I only have two hundred coins.
ru: Я пока не могу позволить себе легендарный меч, у меня всего двести монет.
meaning: to have enough money to buy or pay for something
ex: We can’t afford a new car this year, so we’re fixing the old one.

en: The map says our next destination is a ruined castle on top of that hill.
ru: На карте написано, что наш следующий пункт назначения — разрушенный замок на вершине того холма.
meaning: The place where someone or something is going.
ex: Our final destination is a small village by the sea.

en: The game wants to update again, and it will take twenty minutes.
ru: Игра опять хочет обновиться, и это займёт двадцать минут.
meaning: to make something newer by adding the latest changes
ex: I need to update my CV before the interview.

en: I always tell a silly joke at the start of a party to break the ice.
ru: Я всегда начинаю вечеринку с какой-нибудь глупой шутки, чтобы растопить лёд.
meaning: Make people feel relaxed when they first meet.
ex: Our streamer always asks chat a funny question to break the ice before the game starts.

en: I’m running out of ammo — cover me!
ru: У меня заканчиваются патроны — прикрой!
meaning: to use all of something, so there is none left
ex: We ran out of time.

en: I have to get up at six tomorrow for my flight.
ru: Завтра мне нужно встать в шесть утра на рейс.
meaning: to leave your bed and stand up
ex: Quick, get up before the boss hits you again!
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Please turn off the oven before we leave.
ru: Выключи духовку, пожалуйста, прежде чем мы уйдём.
meaning: to stop a machine, light or device
ex: Turn off chat notifications during the boss fight.

en: I always do research before I buy a new laptop.
ru: Перед покупкой нового ноутбука я всегда изучаю вопрос.
meaning: to study a subject carefully to find information
ex: Do some research on the best build before you start the game.

en: Nice try, but the boss dodges that attack every time.
ru: Хорошая попытка, но босс каждый раз уворачивается от этой атаки.
meaning: Said when someone tried hard but did not succeed.
ex: Nice try, but the shop won’t give you a refund after a month.

en: This build deals huge damage, but on the other hand you die in two hits.
ru: Эта сборка наносит огромный урон, но с другой стороны, умираешь с двух ударов.
meaning: used to introduce a different or opposite point
ex: The flat is cheap, but on the other hand it’s very far from the centre.

en: I’m so relieved — we finally beat that boss on the last try!
ru: Какое облегчение: мы наконец победили этого босса с последней попытки!
meaning: happy because a worry or danger has gone
ex: She was relieved when the test results came back fine.

en: This jacket was a real bargain, it cost half the usual price.
ru: Эта куртка оказалась настоящей выгодной покупкой, она стоила вдвое дешевле обычного.
meaning: something you buy for a much lower price than normal
ex: That armor set is a bargain for only fifty gold.

en: If we book in advance, the flights will be much cheaper.
ru: Если забронировать заранее, билеты будут намного дешевле.
meaning: To reserve something a long time before you need it.
ex: You should book in advance if you want a seat on the beta server.

en: Check your graphics settings, because the game looks too dark.
ru: Проверь настройки графики — игра выглядит слишком тёмной.
meaning: options on a device or program that you can change
ex: Open the privacy settings on your phone and turn off location.

en: It’s already late, so we should hit the road before the traffic gets bad.
ru: Уже поздно, так что нам пора отправляться в путь, пока не начались пробки.
meaning: Start a journey; leave.
ex: Let’s hit the road, the next level is far away on the map.

en: Don’t give up, we’re almost there!
ru: Не сдавайся, мы почти дошли!
meaning: to stop trying to do something
ex: I gave up on this game last year.

en: Wait for me, I’ll get back to the game in two minutes.
ru: Подожди меня, через две минуты я вернусь в игру.
meaning: to return to a place
ex: What time did you get back from work yesterday?
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I can’t hear the footsteps, turn the game volume up.
ru: Я не слышу шагов, сделай звук в игре погромче.
meaning: to make sound, heat or light stronger
ex: Could you turn up the heating? It’s freezing.

en: Pay attention to his left arm, he always raises it before the big attack.
ru: Следи за его левой рукой: он всегда поднимает её перед сильной атакой.
meaning: to look at or listen to something carefully
ex: You should pay attention to the road when you drive in the rain.

en: Sorry I’m late, I’m on my way and I’ll be there in ten minutes.
ru: Простите за опоздание, я уже в пути, буду через десять минут.
meaning: Travelling to a place right now; coming.
ex: Hang tight, I’m on my way to your base with a healing potion.

en: I see your point, but we should still wait until Monday.
ru: Понимаю твою мысль, но всё же лучше подождать до понедельника.
meaning: I understand your argument, even if I may not fully agree
tr: понимаю твою мысль, я понимаю, к чему ты
ex: I see your point, but healing the tank first is safer.

en: Chat, stop spamming, it’s really annoying when I’m trying to concentrate.
ru: Чат, хватит спамить, это очень раздражает, когда пытаешься сосредоточиться.
meaning: making you feel a little angry or impatient
ex: The noise from the street is so annoying at night.

en: The game crashes every five minutes, so I’m asking for a refund.
ru: Игра вылетает каждые пять минут, так что я прошу вернуть деньги.
meaning: money that a shop gives back when you return something
ex: The shop gave us a full refund because the toaster was broken.

en: Honestly, this quest is more about the journey than the ending.
ru: Честно говоря, этот квест больше про путь, чем про финал.
meaning: A trip from one place to another, especially a long one.
ex: The journey from Moscow to Kazan takes about twelve hours by train.

en: I’ll upload the video to my channel tonight.
ru: Сегодня вечером загружу это видео на свой канал.
meaning: to send a file from your device to the internet
ex: Please upload your report to the shared folder by noon.

en: We’ve been stuck on this level for hours, so let’s call it a day.
ru: Мы уже несколько часов торчим на этом уровне, так что давай на сегодня закончим.
meaning: Stop working or doing something for the rest of the day.
ex: I’m tired and my eyes hurt, so I’m going to call it a day and go home.

en: Okay, I need to make a decision: left or right?
ru: Так, мне надо решить: налево или направо?
meaning: to decide something (we say make, not do)
ex: It was a hard decision to make.

en: It takes weeks to get over a cold like that.
ru: Нужны недели, чтобы оправиться от такой простуды.
meaning: to recover from an illness or a bad experience
ex: I can’t get over how hard that last boss was.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: They offered me the job, but I might turn it down.
ru: Мне предложили работу, но я, возможно, откажусь.
meaning: to refuse an offer; to make sound or heat lower
ex: Turn down the music, I can’t hear my teammates.

en: Let’s not waste time and get to the airport early.
ru: Давай не будем терять время и приедем в аэропорт пораньше.
meaning: to use time badly on things that are not useful
ex: Don’t waste time arguing with chat, just keep playing.

en: Watch out, there’s a trap behind that door!
ru: Осторожно, за этой дверью ловушка!
meaning: Used to warn someone about danger.
ex: Watch out, the floor is wet.

en: Which weapon is better? It depends on the map.
ru: Какое оружие лучше? Зависит от карты.
meaning: the answer changes according to something else
ex: It depends on the weather whether we go hiking or not.

en: Don’t worry, I feel confident about this match; our team is strong.
ru: Не переживай, насчёт этого матча полная уверенность: команда у нас сильная.
meaning: sure about your own abilities or about what will happen
ex: He seemed confident during the job interview.

en: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
ru: Сохрани чек на случай, если понадобится вернуть туфли.
meaning: a piece of paper that shows you have paid for something
ex: The store sends a receipt to your email for every in-game purchase.

en: We’re going sightseeing in the old town tomorrow morning.
ru: Завтра утром мы идём осматривать достопримечательности старого города.
meaning: Visiting famous or interesting places as a tourist.
ex: I spent two hours just sightseeing on the new map instead of doing quests.

en: It takes forever to download this game on our slow internet.
ru: На нашем медленном интернете эта игра скачивается целую вечность.
meaning: to copy a file from the internet to your device
ex: The server crashed, so the whole team had to download the file again.

en: If you die once, no big deal, we have plenty of lives left.
ru: Если ты один раз умрёшь, ничего страшного, жизней у нас полно.
meaning: Not important or serious.
ex: Missing the bus is no big deal, we’ll just take a taxi.

en: I was about to win, and then the boss one-shot me.
ru: Победа была в шаге, а потом босс убил меня с одного удара.
meaning: to be going to do something very soon
ex: The movie is about to start.

en: Run! If we get away from the guards, we keep all the loot.
ru: Бежим! Если мы уйдём от стражи, вся добыча останется нам.
meaning: to escape from someone or somewhere
ex: We need to get away from the city for a weekend.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Give me a minute, I’m setting up the stream.
ru: Дай минутку, я настраиваю трансляцию.
meaning: to prepare or arrange something so it is ready
ex: We set up a small business together two years ago.

en: You said we’d split the loot equally, so keep your promise.
