ru: Ты сказал, что мы поделим добычу поровну, так что держи слово.
meaning: to do what you said you would do
ex: He always keeps his promises, even when it’s hard to do so at work.

en: Our health is low and the boss just got stronger, we’re in trouble.
ru: У нас мало здоровья, а босс стал сильнее, мы в беде.
meaning: We are in a difficult or dangerous situation.
tr: мы в беде, у нас проблемы
ex: We’re in trouble if the train is cancelled, because the meeting starts at nine.

en: You want to save money first? Yeah, that makes sense.
ru: Хочешь сначала накопить денег? Да, это логично.
meaning: that sounds reasonable and easy to understand
tr: это логично, в этом есть смысл
ex: Oh, you hid behind the wall so they couldn’t see you, that makes sense.

en: My hands are shaking, I’m so nervous before this final.
ru: Руки трясутся, так волнуюсь перед этим финалом.
meaning: a little afraid or worried about something
ex: She gets nervous before every presentation at work.

en: We have a small budget for the holidays, so we’ll stay at home.
ru: У нас небольшой бюджет на праздники, так что мы останемся дома.
meaning: the amount of money you plan to spend on something
ex: I’m on a tight budget in this game, so I can only buy one upgrade.

en: Let me send you our itinerary so you know where we’ll be each day.
ru: Давай я пришлю наш маршрут, чтобы тебе было понятно, где мы будем каждый день.
meaning: A detailed plan of a journey, with places and times.
ex: My itinerary for the stream today: ten minutes of chat, then the new dungeon.

en: I keep dying because my connection is terrible today.
ru: Я всё время умираю, потому что сегодня ужасное соединение.
meaning: a link between your device and the internet
ex: The video call froze because of a bad connection.

en: When the teammate left the match for the third time, that was the last straw.
ru: Когда тиммейт в третий раз вышел из матча, это стало последней каплей.
meaning: The final problem that makes you lose patience.
ex: My neighbor’s loud music at 3 a.m. was the last straw, so we called the landlord.

en: Sorry, I can’t keep up with you — you’re talking too fast.
ru: Простите, не успеваю за вами — вы говорите слишком быстро.
meaning: to move or progress at the same speed as someone or something
ex: It’s hard to keep up with all the new updates.

en: We can get by on one salary for a few months.
ru: Несколько месяцев мы сможем перебиться на одну зарплату.
meaning: to manage to live with just enough money or skills
ex: I can get by with a basic sword until the next town.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Our car broke down on the highway.
ru: Наша машина сломалась на трассе.
meaning: to stop working because of a problem
ex: My controller broke down in the middle of the final fight.

en: I think we made a mistake when we booked this hotel.
ru: Кажется, мы ошиблись, забронировав этот отель.
meaning: to do something wrong by accident
ex: If you make a mistake in this level, you have to start again.

en: Well played, that was a clever trick with the door.
ru: Отлично сыграно, это был хитрый ход с дверью.
meaning: Said to praise someone’s skill in a game or contest.
ex: Well played, you convinced the whole committee in five minutes.

en: The thing is, chat, I’ve never played this class before.
ru: Дело в том, чат, что этим классом раньше не играли ни разу.
meaning: used to introduce the real reason or problem
tr: дело в том, что; всё дело в том, что
ex: I’d love to come, but the thing is, I have an early meeting.

en: I’m really stressed — this boss has beaten us ten times already.
ru: Очень напряжно: этот босс уже десять раз нас победил.
meaning: feeling worried and unable to relax
ex: My dad is stressed because of the deadline at the office.

en: You only need five ingredients to make this soup.
ru: Для этого супа нужно всего пять ингредиентов.
meaning: one of the foods you use to make a dish
ex: To craft the potion, you need three ingredients: a flower, a mushroom and some water.

en: Our luggage didn’t arrive, so we’re waiting at the airport office.
ru: Наш багаж не прилетел, поэтому мы ждём в офисе аэропорта.
meaning: The bags and cases you take with you when you travel.
ex: My character carries too much luggage and moves really slowly.

en: If you like the stream, don’t forget to subscribe!
ru: Если вам нравится стрим, не забудьте подписаться!
meaning: to pay or sign up to regularly receive something
ex: I want to subscribe to a newsletter about cooking.

en: Don’t cut corners on the setup, or the stream will lag again.
ru: Не халтурь с настройкой, иначе стрим опять будет лагать.
meaning: Do something in a cheaper or less careful way.
ex: The builders cut corners, and now the roof leaks.

en: We need to come up with a better plan.
ru: Нам надо придумать план получше.
meaning: to think of an idea, a plan or an answer
ex: Who came up with this name?

en: We finally got through the hardest level after twenty tries.
ru: Мы наконец-то прошли самый сложный уровень после двадцати попыток.
meaning: to finish or survive a difficult task or period
ex: It’s been a stressful month, but we’ll get through it.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Just carry on without me, I’ll join you in a minute.
ru: Продолжайте без меня, я присоединюсь через минуту.
meaning: to continue doing something
ex: Sorry for the interruption, please carry on with your story.

en: Our teammates really made an effort to win the final round.
ru: Наши товарищи по команде очень старались выиграть финальный раунд.
meaning: to try hard to do something
ex: She makes an effort to call her grandmother every Sunday.

en: Nice one, the hidden chest is open!
ru: Отлично, скрытый сундук открыт!
meaning: Said when someone does or says something good.
ex: Nice one! You got us a table by the window.

en: In my opinion, the book was better than the film.
ru: По-моему, книга была лучше фильма.
meaning: used to say what you personally think
ex: In my opinion, the second level is the best part of the game.

en: Stay calm, we still have time to win this round.
ru: Сохраняй спокойствие, у нас ещё есть время выиграть раунд.
meaning: relaxed and not showing worry or anger
ex: She stayed calm when the baby started crying in the shop.

en: I’m eating leftovers from yesterday’s pizza while we wait for the server.
ru: Пока мы ждём сервер, я доедаю вчерашнюю пиццу.
meaning: food that remains after a meal and is eaten later
ex: We had leftovers for lunch, so nobody had to cook.

en: The departure time is 7:40, so we need to leave home at five.
ru: Время отправления — 7:40, так что нам нужно выйти из дома в пять.
meaning: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a trip.
ex: Our departure from the starting village is right after the tutorial.

en: I forgot my password, so I can’t get into my game account.
ru: Я не помню пароль, поэтому не могу зайти в игровой аккаунт.
meaning: a secret word you use to enter a computer or account
ex: Use a long password that is hard to guess.

en: We didn’t save before the boss fight, so we had to learn the hard way.
ru: Мы не сохранились перед боссом, так что пришлось учиться на горьком опыте.
meaning: Learn something from a bad experience.
tr: учиться на горьком опыте, набивать шишки
ex: He ignored the warning and learned the hard way not to trust strangers online.

en: The boss is stunned — let’s take advantage of it!
ru: Босс оглушён — давай этим воспользуемся!
meaning: to use a situation or a chance to get something good from it
ex: Take advantage of the double XP weekend.

en: We got on the train just before the doors closed.
ru: Мы сели в поезд за секунду до закрытия дверей.
meaning: to enter a bus, train, plane, or climb on a bike or horse
ex: Get on the horse and follow me to the castle!
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Can you pick the kids up from school today?
ru: Можешь сегодня забрать детей из школы?
meaning: to collect someone or something; to lift from the floor
ex: Pick up that sword, it’s much stronger than yours.

en: One small change at work can make a difference to the whole team.
ru: Одно небольшое изменение на работе может повлиять на всю команду.
meaning: to have an important effect on something
ex: A better headset makes a difference when we play as a squad.

en: Good job, team, we beat the whole level without dying.
ru: Отличная работа, команда, мы прошли весь уровень, ни разу не погибнув.
meaning: Said to praise someone for doing something well.
ex: Good job on the presentation, the client loved it.

en: The trip is expensive, not to mention tiring.
ru: Поездка дорогая, не говоря уже о том, что утомительная.
meaning: used to add another important thing to what you just said
ex: The graphics are amazing, not to mention the music.

en: That was so brave — you ran straight at the whole enemy team!
ru: Вот это смелость: ты бросился прямо на всю вражескую команду!
meaning: willing to do something dangerous or difficult without fear
ex: It was brave of him to speak in front of the whole class.

en: I have a dentist appointment at ten tomorrow.
ru: Завтра в десять у меня приём у стоматолога.
meaning: an arranged time to meet a doctor or other professional
ex: Sorry, I have to leave the stream early, I have a doctor’s appointment.

en: Sorry for the delay, guys, the stream will start in five minutes.
ru: Простите за задержку, ребята, стрим начнётся через пять минут.
meaning: A period of time when something happens later than planned.
ex: There’s a two-hour delay at the airport because of the snow.

en: Don’t share your account with anyone, or you might lose all your items.
ru: Никому не давай свой аккаунт, а то можешь потерять все предметы.
meaning: your personal page or record on a website or service
ex: She opened a bank account to save for a trip.

en: This legendary item drops once in a blue moon, so don’t count on it.
ru: Этот легендарный предмет выпадает очень редко, так что не рассчитывай на него.
meaning: Very rarely.
tr: раз в сто лет, очень редко
ex: We only go to the cinema once in a blue moon, because tickets are expensive.

en: It’s worth trying one more time.
ru: Стоит попробовать ещё раз.
meaning: used to say that doing something is useful or will be good
ex: This game is worth playing with a friend.

en: You should get off at the next stop.
ru: Тебе нужно выйти на следующей остановке.
meaning: to leave a bus, train, plane, or bike
ex: Get off the roof, enemies can see you there!
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Hold on, my game just froze.
ru: Секунду, у меня игра зависла.
meaning: to wait for a short time
ex: Hold on, I’ll check my calendar.

en: This puzzle doesn’t make sense, why is the key behind the locked door?
ru: В этой головоломке нет смысла: почему ключ лежит за запертой дверью?
meaning: to be clear and easy to understand
ex: Your plan makes sense, so let’s do it on Friday.

en: Take a breath, you’ve got this, the last boss is almost dead.
ru: Выдохни, у тебя получится, последний босс почти повержен.
meaning: Said to encourage someone: you can do it.
ex: You’ve got this, it’s just a short interview.

en: Mages are fast and fragile, whereas knights are slow but very tough.
ru: Маги быстрые и хрупкие, тогда как рыцари медленные, но очень крепкие.
meaning: used to compare two things that are very different
tr: тогда как, в то время как
ex: My brother loves crowded parties, whereas I prefer a quiet evening.

en: Come on, don’t be lazy, we need to farm more resources before the raid.
ru: Давай, не ленись, нужно добыть ещё ресурсов перед рейдом.
meaning: not wanting to work or make an effort
ex: On Sundays we feel lazy and stay in bed until noon.

en: If your symptoms don’t go away in three days, see a doctor.
ru: Если симптомы не пройдут за три дня, сходите к врачу.
meaning: a sign that you have an illness
ex: Chat, I have all the symptoms of a cold, so the stream will be short today.

en: She’s studying abroad this year, so we only talk online.
ru: Она в этом году учится за границей, поэтому мы общаемся только онлайн.
meaning: In or to a foreign country.
ex: In this game you can sail abroad and trade with distant islands.

en: Your screen is frozen, so we can’t see what you’re doing.
ru: Твой экран завис, поэтому мы не видим, что ты делаешь.
meaning: the flat surface of a computer or phone where you see things
ex: My phone screen cracked when I dropped it.

en: The new patch is kind of annoying, but I’m getting used to it.
ru: Новый патч немного бесит, но я привыкаю.
meaning: Slightly or in some way; not exactly.
ex: Are you tired? Kind of, yes, I slept badly.

en: I’m finally getting the hang of this weapon.
ru: С этим оружием наконец-то начинает получаться.
meaning: to learn how to do something, usually after some practice
ex: You’ll get the hang of it after a few games.

en: Get out of the zone, the storm is closing in!
ru: Выбирайся из зоны, шторм сужается!
meaning: to leave a place or vehicle
ex: Get out of the car and help me with the bags.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I want to find out when the shop opens.
ru: Хочу узнать, во сколько открывается магазин.
meaning: to learn a fact or discover information
ex: Let’s find out what the secret door does.

en: He makes a living by selling handmade furniture online.
ru: Он зарабатывает на жизнь продажей мебели ручной работы через интернет.
meaning: to earn enough money to live
ex: She makes a living by streaming games every evening.

en: Don’t worry about it, we can restart the level.
ru: Не переживай, мы можем перезапустить уровень.
meaning: Said to tell someone that a mistake is not a problem.
ex: Don’t worry about it, I’ll wash the dishes tonight.

en: You can borrow my laptop as long as you’re careful with it.
ru: Можно взять мой ноутбук, если будешь аккуратен с ним.
meaning: only if something is true or happens
tr: при условии что, лишь бы, пока
ex: We can win as long as nobody leaves the point.

en: The new players in our lobby are really friendly, they help everyone.
ru: Новые игроки в нашем лобби очень дружелюбные, они всем помогают.
meaning: kind and pleasant to other people
ex: Our neighbours are friendly and always say hello.

en: It took him a month to recover after the operation.
ru: Ему понадобился месяц, чтобы восстановиться после операции.
meaning: to become healthy or strong again after being ill or hurt
ex: Hide behind the wall and let your health recover for a few seconds.

en: Let’s buy a souvenir from each town before the story moves on.
ru: Давай купим сувенир в каждом городе, пока сюжет не пошёл дальше.
meaning: An object you buy to remember a place you visited.
ex: I brought my sister a small souvenir from Italy.

en: Just delete the old email and try again.
ru: Просто удали старое письмо и попробуй ещё раз.
meaning: to remove something from a computer or phone
ex: I had to delete some games to free up space.

en: We’ve pretty much finished this map, only one chest is left.
ru: Мы почти полностью прошли эту карту, остался только один сундук.
meaning: Almost; nearly.
ex: I pretty much know everyone in this street, so just ask me.

en: Let’s get together on Saturday and cook something.
ru: Давайте встретимся в субботу и что-нибудь приготовим.
meaning: to meet socially with other people
ex: Our guild gets together every Friday for a raid night.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Don’t panic, it will all work out.
ru: Не паникуй, всё наладится.
meaning: to end well; to succeed in the end
ex: I hope our strategy works out in the next round.

en: It’s easy to make friends in this game, everyone in the lobby is so friendly.
ru: В этой игре легко найти друзей, все в лобби очень дружелюбные.
meaning: to start a friendship with people
ex: It was hard to make friends when we moved to a new city.

en: Take your time, the shop is open until ten.
ru: Не торопись, магазин открыт до десяти.
meaning: You do not need to hurry.
ex: Take your time, the boss isn’t going anywhere.

en: If it’s going to rain, then in that case let’s stay home.
ru: Если пойдёт дождь, тогда в таком случае останемся дома.
meaning: if that is the situation
ex: If the boss has a shield, in that case we need fire damage.

en: You’re so lucky — that was the rarest item in the whole game!
ru: Вот это везение: это самый редкий предмет во всей игре!
meaning: having good things happen by chance
ex: We were lucky with the weather on our trip.

en: Sorry, I can’t talk now, I’m in a hurry.
ru: Извини, сейчас не могу говорить, я спешу.
meaning: to need to do something quickly because of lack of time
ex: Don’t be in a hurry in this level, the enemies are hidden everywhere.

en: Accommodation is expensive here, so we’re looking at cheap hostels.
ru: Жильё здесь дорогое, поэтому мы смотрим дешёвые хостелы.
meaning: A place where you can stay, such as a hotel or room.
ex: The inn is the only accommodation in this part of the game.

en: Wait, save the game before you go into that cave!
ru: Стой, сохранись перед тем, как идти в ту пещеру!
meaning: to keep information or progress on a device
ex: Remember to save the document every few minutes.

en: Another match? I’m down, let me grab some snacks first.
ru: Ещё один матч? Я за, только сначала возьму перекусить.
meaning: I agree and want to do it too.
ex: Pizza tonight? I’m down, I haven’t eaten since morning.

en: I need to get rid of this useless junk before my bag is full.
ru: Надо избавиться от этого бесполезного хлама, пока рюкзак не заполнился.
meaning: to throw away or remove something you do not want
ex: We finally got rid of the old sofa.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Let’s sort out the loot before we leave the dungeon.
ru: Давайте разберём добычу, прежде чем выйдем из подземелья.
meaning: to organize something or solve a problem
ex: I need to sort out my documents before the trip.

en: Let’s make a plan for the weekend before everyone gets busy.
ru: Давай составим план на выходные, пока все не заняты.
meaning: to decide how you will do something
ex: Let’s make a plan before we enter the dungeon.

en: No rush, we can wait until you find a better weapon.
ru: Не спеши, можем подождать, пока найдётся оружие получше.
meaning: There is no need to hurry.
ex: No rush, send me the report whenever you have time.

en: I agree with you, the new map is way too small.
ru: Согласен с тобой: новая карта слишком маленькая.
meaning: I think the same as you
tr: я с тобой согласен, согласны с тобой
ex: I agree with you; that meeting could have been an email.

en: I’m scared of this level, the monsters jump out of nowhere.
ru: Мне страшно на этом уровне, монстры выпрыгивают из ниоткуда.
meaning: to feel fear because of someone or something
ex: My little brother is scared of dogs.

en: You look tired, you should get some rest.
ru: Ты выглядишь усталым, тебе стоит отдохнуть.
meaning: to relax or sleep so that you feel better
ex: We’ve been playing for six hours, let’s get some rest and continue tomorrow.

en: That giant statue is the biggest tourist attraction in the whole game world.
ru: Эта гигантская статуя — главная туристическая достопримечательность всего игрового мира.
meaning: A place that many tourists visit because it is interesting.
ex: The old castle is the main tourist attraction in the town.

en: Let me search for a guide, because I’m stuck on this level.
ru: Дай поищу гайд — на этом уровне никак не пройти.
meaning: to look for information online or somewhere else
ex: I did a quick search and found a cheap flight.

en: You’ve played for ten hours, so no wonder you’re tired.
ru: Ты играешь уже десять часов, так что неудивительно, что ты устал.
meaning: It’s not surprising.
ex: No wonder he’s late, the whole city is stuck in traffic.

en: It’s easy to get around this city without a car.
ru: По этому городу легко передвигаться без машины.
meaning: to move or travel from place to place
ex: There’s a glitch that lets you get around the locked door.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We have to check in at the hotel before noon.
ru: Нам нужно зарегистрироваться в отеле до полудня.
meaning: to register when you arrive at a hotel or airport
ex: Everyone, check in on voice chat before the match starts.

en: Can I make a suggestion? Let’s try the stealth route this time.
ru: Можно предложить? Давайте в этот раз попробуем пройти скрытно.
meaning: to offer an idea for others to think about
ex: She made a suggestion at the meeting that everyone liked.

en: Oops, sorry about that, wrong button!
ru: Упс, прости за это, не та кнопка!
meaning: Said to apologise for a small mistake.
ex: Sorry about that, the line was bad and the call dropped.

en: Sorry, I don’t agree; the plan is too risky.
ru: Извини, но мы не согласны: план слишком рискованный.
meaning: I have a different opinion
ex: I don’t agree that this character is overpowered.

en: Viewers, are you bored with this slow part? I’ll skip it.
ru: Зрители, вам скучно от этой медленной части? Сейчас пропущу.
meaning: to feel uninterested because something is not exciting
ex: We’re bored with the same dinner every Monday.

en: We share the household chores so nobody does everything alone.
ru: Мы делим домашние дела, чтобы никто не делал всё один.
meaning: regular small jobs you do to keep a home clean
ex: I have no time for the game after all my household chores.

en: My commute takes an hour each way, so I listen to podcasts.
ru: Дорога на работу занимает час в одну сторону, так что я слушаю подкасты.
meaning: The regular trip between home and work or school.
tr: поездка на работу, ездить на работу
ex: Respawning is a long commute in this game, because the nearest town is far away.

en: Is there an official website with the patch notes?
ru: Есть ли официальный сайт с описанием обновления?
meaning: a place on the internet with pages about a person or company
ex: Our company is building a new website this month.

en: I’m feeling a bit under the weather, so I’ll stay in bed today.
ru: Мне немного нездоровится, так что сегодня останусь в постели.
meaning: Feeling slightly ill.
ex: Sorry chat, the streamer is under the weather today, so the stream will be short.

en: I’m trying to get my idea across, but nobody listens.
ru: Я пытаюсь донести свою идею, но никто не слушает.
meaning: to make someone understand an idea or message
ex: The streamer couldn’t get the rules across to the new viewers.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Check out this crazy skin that just dropped for me!
ru: Зацени этот безумный скин, который мне только что выпал!
meaning: to look at something interesting; to leave a hotel
ex: You should check out that new café near the station.

en: We’re going to make a complaint because the room was dirty.
ru: Мы собираемся подать жалобу, потому что в номере было грязно.
meaning: to say officially that you are not happy about something
ex: Viewers made a complaint about the loud music in the stream.

en: That’s my fault, the plan was bad.
ru: Это моя вина, план был неудачный.
meaning: I am the one who caused the problem.
ex: It’s my fault we missed the train, the alarm never rang.

en: I’m not sure this strategy will work against a full team.
ru: Нет уверенности, что эта стратегия сработает против полной команды.
meaning: I don’t know if something is true or right
ex: I’m not sure if I can come on Friday.

en: Guys, I’m so excited about the new update coming tomorrow!
ru: Ребята, так жду завтрашнего обновления, прямо не терпится!
meaning: to feel happy and full of energy about something
ex: She’s excited about her trip to the sea next week.

en: This is a great deal: two potions for the price of one!
ru: Отличное предложение: два зелья по цене одного!
meaning: an agreement or offer, especially one that saves you money
ex: We got a good deal on the flight tickets.

en: Chat, I’m your tour guide today, so follow me through the jungle.
ru: Чат, сегодня я ваш гид, так что идите за мной по джунглям.
meaning: A person who shows tourists around a place.
ex: Our tour guide knew a lot about the history of the city.

en: Chat, I’m going to post the best clips on my page tomorrow.
ru: Чат, завтра выложу лучшие клипы на свою страницу.
meaning: to put a message or picture online for others to see
ex: She likes to post photos of her dog every Sunday.

en: Please don’t spill the beans about the secret level to the chat yet.
ru: Пожалуйста, пока не выдавай чату секрет про тайный уровень.
meaning: Tell a secret by accident or too early.
ex: Who spilled the beans about the surprise party?

en: Nobody can get away with camping the spawn point forever.
ru: Никому не сойдёт с рук вечно сидеть в засаде у точки возрождения.
meaning: to do something wrong and not be punished
tr: уйти от наказания, сойти с рук
ex: He cheated on the test and got away with it.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We got lost and ended up in a small village.
ru: Мы заблудились и оказались в маленькой деревне.
meaning: to finally be in a place or situation, often by chance
ex: I started with a sword but ended up using a bow.

en: Stop making excuses and just admit you died because of the lag.
ru: Хватит искать оправдания и признай, что ты погиб из-за лагов.
meaning: to give a reason to avoid blame
ex: He always makes an excuse when it’s his turn to cook.

en: Another round? I’m in.
ru: Ещё один раунд? Я за.
meaning: I agree to join or take part.
ex: A movie tonight? I’m in.

en: I love hiking. As a matter of fact, we went last weekend.
ru: Обожаю походы. Кстати, мы как раз ходили на прошлых выходных.
meaning: used to add true or surprising information
ex: As a matter of fact, this level can be beaten in two minutes.

en: I’m really surprised by how fast the new player learned the game.
ru: Меня правда удивляет, как быстро новичок освоил игру.
meaning: to feel surprise because of something unexpected
ex: We were surprised by the sudden snow in October.

en: The tickets were expensive, but the concert was worth the money.
ru: Билеты были дорогими, но концерт стоил своих денег.
meaning: good enough to justify the price you pay
ex: The new skin looks nice, but it isn’t worth the money.

en: Our flight leaves at six, so we should be at the airport by four.
ru: Наш рейс вылетает в шесть, так что к четырём нам нужно быть в аэропорту.
meaning: A journey by plane.
ex: The flight mission in this game is hard because the plane controls are strange.

en: Someone left a funny comment under my last clip.
ru: Кто-то оставил смешной комментарий под моим последним клипом.
meaning: something you write or say about a person, picture or video
ex: The teacher wrote a short comment at the end of my essay.

en: Let’s face it, we’re not going to win this round with only two players.
ru: Давай посмотрим правде в глаза: вдвоём мы этот раунд не выиграем.
meaning: Accept an unpleasant truth.
tr: давай признаем, посмотрим правде в глаза
ex: Let’s face it, this old laptop can’t run modern games.

en: Let’s get down to business, the meeting starts in five minutes.
ru: Давайте перейдём к делу, встреча начнётся через пять минут.
meaning: to start doing something seriously
ex: Enough chatting, let’s get down to clearing this dungeon.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Our teammate didn’t show up for the match.
ru: Наш тиммейт не появился на матч.
meaning: to arrive or appear
ex: He never showed up to the party.

en: My cousin wants to make money by selling old furniture online.
ru: Мой двоюродный брат хочет заработать, продавая старую мебель через интернет.
meaning: to earn money
ex: You can make money in this game by selling rare items.

en: It might not work, but it’s worth a try.
ru: Может не сработать, но попробовать стоит.
meaning: Good enough to be tried, even if it may fail.
ex: The new bus route is worth a try, it might be faster.

en: Some classes are great for beginners, for example the archer.
ru: Некоторые классы отлично подходят новичкам, например лучник.
meaning: used to give an example
ex: Try a new hobby, for example painting or cooking.

en: Please don’t lose your temper, it’s only a game and we can try again.
ru: Пожалуйста, не выходи из себя, это всего лишь игра, можно попробовать снова.
meaning: to suddenly become very angry
ex: My boss never loses his temper, even when things go wrong.

en: There’s a twenty percent discount on all weapons this weekend.
ru: В эти выходные на всё оружие скидка двадцать процентов.
meaning: a reduction in the usual price of something
ex: Students get a discount on train tickets.

en: Where can I buy a ticket for the airship? I have enough gold.
ru: Где можно купить билет на дирижабль? У меня хватает золота.
meaning: A piece of paper or a code that lets you travel or enter.
ex: Can I buy a ticket for the next train, please?

en: Can you share your screen so we can see the map?
ru: Можешь показать свой экран, чтобы мы увидели карту?
meaning: to let other people see or use something
ex: I’ll share the link to the document in the group chat.

expr: at the end of the day
en: At the end of the day, it’s just a game, so let’s have fun.
ru: В конце концов, это просто игра, так что давай получать удовольствие.
meaning: When everything is considered; the most important point.
tr: в конечном счёте, по большому счёту
ex: At the end of the day, you have to do what makes you happy.
hint: a… t… e… o… t… d…

en: She works late every night to get ahead in her career.
ru: Она каждый вечер допоздна работает, чтобы продвинуться по карьерной лестнице.
meaning: to be successful in your job or life
ex: If we farm gold early, we can get ahead of the other team.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We usually hang out at my place on Fridays.
ru: По пятницам мы обычно тусуемся у меня.
meaning: to spend free time relaxing with friends
ex: Let’s hang out in the lobby until everyone joins.

en: Shh, don’t make a noise, the guards will hear us!
ru: Тсс, не шуми, стража нас услышит!
meaning: to produce a sound, usually a loud one
ex: The neighbours made a noise all night, so we couldn’t sleep.

en: I’m starting my driving test now, wish me luck.
ru: Начинаю экзамен по вождению, пожелайте мне удачи.
meaning: Said before doing something difficult.
ex: The final boss is next, wish me luck!

en: There are lots of cheap ways to travel, for instance by night train.
ru: Есть много дешёвых способов путешествовать, например, ночным поездом.
meaning: used to give an example
ex: Use abilities with a short cooldown, for instance the dash.

en: Stop arguing with the teammates, just ping where the enemy is.
ru: Хватит спорить с тиммейтами, просто отметь, где враг.
meaning: to speak angrily to someone because you disagree
ex: I never argue with my parents about money.

en: Winter coats are on sale this week.
ru: На этой неделе зимние куртки продаются со скидкой.
meaning: being sold at a lower price than usual
tr: в продаже со скидкой, на распродаже
ex: Everything in the in-game shop is on sale until Friday.

en: Don’t get lost in the cave, there’s no minimap here.
ru: Не потеряйся в пещере, здесь нет миникарты.
meaning: To not know where you are and be unable to find the way.
ex: We got lost in the old town, but we found a lovely café.

en: The save file is damaged, so the game won’t open.
ru: Файл сохранения повреждён, поэтому игра не запускается.
meaning: a collection of information stored on a computer
ex: Please send me the file as soon as it’s ready.

en: I’m explaining the combo again because I don’t think you get the point.
ru: Я снова объясняю комбо, потому что, кажется, ты не улавливаешь суть.
meaning: Understand what someone means.
ex: I get the point, you want me to leave earlier.

en: I’m trying to get out of that boring meeting tomorrow.
ru: Я пытаюсь отвертеться от этого скучного совещания завтра.
meaning: to avoid doing something you should do
ex: You can’t get out of the quest once you accept it.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Wait for me, I need to catch up with the team!
ru: Подождите меня, мне надо догнать команду!
meaning: to reach the same level or position as others
ex: Let’s have coffee and catch up soon.

en: The kids made a mess in the kitchen again.
ru: Дети опять устроили беспорядок на кухне.
meaning: to make a place dirty or untidy
ex: The team made a mess of the last boss fight.

en: I can’t believe it, we finally found the secret room!
ru: Не могу поверить, мы наконец нашли секретную комнату!
meaning: Said when something is very surprising.
ex: I can’t believe it, I won a free trip!

en: This sword is strong, and in addition it looks really cool.
ru: Этот меч сильный, а вдобавок ещё и выглядит классно.
meaning: also, used to add another point
ex: The hotel is clean, and in addition it’s close to the beach.

en: Sorry, chat, I apologize for the long wait; my internet just died.
ru: Простите, чат, извиняюсь за долгое ожидание: у меня пропал интернет.
meaning: to say sorry for something you did
ex: He apologized for being late to the meeting.

en: I looked at the price tag and put the lamp back.
ru: Один взгляд на ценник — и лампа вернулась на полку.
meaning: a label on a product that shows how much it costs
ex: Look at that price tag, nobody will buy a helmet for ten thousand gold.

en: The metro is so crowded in the morning that I can’t even move.
ru: Утром в метро так многолюдно, что я даже пошевелиться не могу.
meaning: Full of people, with little space.
ex: The market in this game is so crowded that my frame rate drops.

en: My controller’s battery is almost dead, so give me a minute.
ru: Батарея на моём контроллере почти села, так что подожди минутку.
meaning: the thing inside a device that gives it power
ex: My phone battery lasts only half a day now.

en: A huge dragon appeared out of the blue and destroyed our camp.
ru: Огромный дракон появился словно из ниоткуда и разрушил наш лагерь.
meaning: Suddenly and unexpectedly.
ex: My old friend called me out of the blue yesterday.

en: Stop talking and get on with the match, chat is waiting.
ru: Хватит болтать, продолжайте матч, чат ждёт.
meaning: to continue doing something, especially work
ex: I have to get on with my report before dinner.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Calm down, it’s just a game, we can try again.
ru: Успокойся, это всего лишь игра, можно попробовать снова.
meaning: to become relaxed after being angry or upset
ex: She told him to calm down and speak slowly.

en: This sword does a lot of damage to fire enemies.
ru: Этот меч наносит огромный урон огненным врагам.
meaning: to hurt or harm something
ex: The storm did a lot of damage to our garden.

en: Your heal came just in time!
ru: Твоё лечение подоспело как раз вовремя!
meaning: At the last moment before it was too late.
tr: как раз вовремя, в самый раз
ex: We arrived just in time, the doors were closing.

en: We missed the bus, and on top of that it started to rain.
ru: Мы опоздали на автобус, а вдобавок ко всему пошёл дождь.
meaning: used to add something else, often bad
tr: вдобавок ко всему, к тому же
ex: The boss hits hard, and on top of that he summons helpers.

en: You can rely on me, I’ll cover you while you heal.
ru: На меня можно положиться: я прикрою тебя, пока ты лечишься.
meaning: to need and trust someone or something to help you
ex: We rely on public transport to get to work.

en: Do you take cash, or only cards?
ru: Вы принимаете наличные или только карты?
meaning: money in the form of coins and notes
ex: I don’t have enough cash in the game to buy a house.

en: Is there a safe house nearby? My health is almost gone.
ru: Здесь поблизости есть убежище? Здоровья почти не осталось.
meaning: Close to where you are.
ex: There’s a pharmacy nearby, just around the corner.

en: Let me charge my headset first, then we can start.
ru: Дай сначала заряжу наушники, а потом начнём.
meaning: to put electricity into a battery
ex: Where can I charge my laptop in this café?

en: Can you explain the whole game in a nutshell? I only have a minute.
ru: Можешь объяснить всю игру в двух словах? У меня только минута.
meaning: In a few words; briefly.
ex: In a nutshell, the meeting was boring and we changed nothing.

en: I’ve recently got into cooking, and now we watch recipe videos every night.
ru: Недавно мне стало интересно готовить, и теперь мы каждый вечер смотрим видео с рецептами.
meaning: to become interested in something
ex: He got into speedrunning after watching one tournament.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Let’s buy her some flowers to cheer her up.
ru: Давай купим ей цветов, чтобы поднять ей настроение.
meaning: to make someone feel happier
ex: Don’t be sad about losing, cheer up, we’ll win next round.

en: I’ll do my best to be on time for the dinner tomorrow.
ru: Постараюсь изо всех сил прийти вовремя на ужин завтра.
meaning: to try as hard as you can
ex: Just do your best in the match, and we’ll see what happens.

en: Okay, here’s the plan: you distract it and I grab the key.
ru: Итак, вот план: ты отвлекаешь его, а я хватаю ключ.
meaning: Used to start explaining what we will do.
ex: Here’s the plan: we meet at six, eat, then go to the cinema.

en: This item is expensive. However, it makes the run much easier.
ru: Этот предмет дорогой. Однако он сильно упрощает прохождение.
meaning: used to add a contrasting idea
ex: I like the job. However, the commute is exhausting.

en: I really respect players who stay polite even when they’re losing.
ru: Я очень уважаю игроков, которые остаются вежливыми, даже когда проигрывают.
meaning: to admire someone and treat them well
ex: Children should respect their teachers.

en: Please don’t use your parents’ credit card to donate to the stream.
ru: Пожалуйста, не используйте кредитную карту родителей, чтобы донатить на стрим.
meaning: a plastic card that lets you buy now and pay later
ex: You can pay by credit card at most stores.

en: Sorry, we’ll be late, we’re stuck in traffic.
ru: Извини, мы задержимся: мы застряли в пробке.
meaning: To be unable to move forward because there are too many cars.
ex: The taxi driver in this game is stuck in traffic, and the mission timer is running.

en: We’re working on a new project at work, so I’m really busy.
ru: Мы работаем над новым проектом на работе, поэтому сейчас очень много дел.
meaning: a piece of work that is planned and done over time
ex: Our team is making a small project: a mod for our favourite game.

en: Losing that match was a blessing in disguise, because we found our weak spots.
ru: Проигрыш в том матче оказался скрытым благом: мы нашли свои слабые места.
meaning: Something bad that turns out to be good.
tr: не было бы счастья, да несчастье помогло
ex: Losing my job was a blessing in disguise, since I started my own business.

en: Our train got in twenty minutes late.
ru: Наш поезд прибыл с опозданием на двадцать минут.
meaning: to arrive at a place, or to enter a car
ex: Get in the truck, we’re leaving the base now!
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I’ll drop you off at the station on my way.
ru: Я подброшу тебя до вокзала по пути.
meaning: to take someone or something to a place and leave them
ex: Drop off the package at the marked spot to finish the quest.

en: Can you do me a favour and watch my base while I get a snack?
ru: Можешь оказать мне услугу и посторожить мою базу, пока я схожу за перекусом?
meaning: to help someone as a kind act
ex: Could you do me a favour and pick up the kids today?

en: So, what’s the plan? Do we attack from the left or the right?
ru: Так какой у нас план? Атакуем слева или справа?
meaning: A question asking what we will do next.
ex: What’s the plan for the weekend? Are we going to the lake?

en: Although it was late, we decided to go for a walk.
ru: Хотя было поздно, мы решили пойти погулять.
meaning: used to introduce a contrasting fact
ex: Although I’m low on health, I’ll try to finish the fight.

en: Viewers keep complaining about the lag, but it’s not on my side.
ru: Зрители всё время жалуются на лаги, но проблема не у меня.
meaning: to say that you are not happy about something
ex: Our guests complained about the cold room.

en: I need to withdraw some money from the cash machine.
ru: Мне нужно снять немного денег в банкомате.
meaning: to take money out of a bank account
ex: You can withdraw your winnings from the game account after ten days.

en: I prefer public transport because parking in the centre is a nightmare.
ru: Я предпочитаю общественный транспорт: парковка в центре — это кошмар.
meaning: Buses, trains and trams that everyone can use.
ex: You can use public transport in this game, but the subway has only two lines.

en: I can’t play now, because I have a meeting at six.
ru: Сейчас не смогу поиграть: в шесть у меня встреча.
meaning: an event where people get together to talk about work
ex: We had a quick meeting before the stream to plan the game.

en: Stop beating around the bush and tell me who stole my loot!
ru: Хватит ходить вокруг да около, скажи, кто украл мою добычу!
meaning: Avoid saying the main point directly.
ex: Don’t beat around the bush, just tell me if you like the gift.

en: I’ll get back to you about the schedule tomorrow.
ru: Я отвечу тебе насчёт расписания завтра.
meaning: to contact someone later with an answer
ex: Sorry chat, I’ll get back to your question after this fight.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Please fill in this form and sign it.
ru: Пожалуйста, заполните эту анкету и подпишите её.
meaning: to write information in a form
ex: Fill in the empty slots with your best items.

en: I usually do the shopping on Saturday morning.
ru: Обычно я хожу за продуктами в субботу утром.
meaning: to go to shops and buy things you need
ex: He does the shopping in the game’s market before every quest.

en: Don’t open it, it’s a trap!
ru: Не открывай, это ловушка!
meaning: Something looks good but is actually a danger.
ex: A free phone for one euro? It’s a trap, they’ll charge you later.

en: Even though we lost, that was a really fun match.
ru: Хотя мы проиграли, матч был очень весёлым.
meaning: used for a stronger contrast than although
tr: хотя, даже несмотря на то что
ex: Even though it was raining, we went to the park.

en: We’re all tired of losing because of the same mistake.
ru: Нам всем надоело проигрывать из-за одной и той же ошибки.
meaning: to be bored or annoyed by something that continues too long
ex: She’s tired of waiting for the bus every morning.

en: We paid a deposit of five hundred euros for the flat.
ru: Мы заплатили залог в пятьсот евро за квартиру.
meaning: money you pay first to keep or rent something
ex: You must pay a deposit to enter the tournament, but you get it back.

en: Let’s drive downtown, the best shops are near the main square.
ru: Давай поедем в центр города: лучшие магазины рядом с главной площадью.
meaning: In or to the central part of a city.
ex: I work downtown, so the lunch options are great.

en: She decided to apply for a job at a game studio.
ru: Она решила подать заявку на вакансию в игровой студии.
meaning: to ask officially for a job, place or permit
ex: He’s going to apply for a scholarship next month.

en: We’ll just have to bite the bullet and fight the final boss without healing.
ru: Придётся стиснуть зубы и драться с финальным боссом без лечения.
meaning: Do something difficult or unpleasant that you can’t avoid.
ex: I’ll bite the bullet and call the dentist tomorrow.

en: I can’t get through to the server, it keeps timing out.
ru: Не получается достучаться до сервера, он постоянно выдаёт тайм-аут.
meaning: to reach someone or something, or make them understand
ex: I tried calling all day but couldn’t get through to her.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I’m busy now, can I call you back in an hour?
ru: Я сейчас занят, можно перезвонить тебе через час?
meaning: to phone someone again later
ex: Chat is loud, I’ll call you back after the stream.

en: I try to do exercise every day, even after a long stream.
ru: Я стараюсь заниматься спортом каждый день, даже после долгого стрима.
meaning: to move your body to stay healthy
ex: Doctors say you should do exercise for thirty minutes a day.

en: Let me explain step by step how we beat this room.
ru: Объясню по шагам, как мы проходим эту комнату.
meaning: Slowly, one part after another.
ex: Follow the recipe step by step and the cake will be fine.

en: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
ru: Несмотря на пробки, мы приехали вовремя.
meaning: used to say something happened although there was a problem
ex: Despite the lag, we won the round.

en: I’m curious about what’s behind that locked door, let’s check.
ru: Любопытно, что за той запертой дверью, давай проверим.
meaning: to want to know or learn about something
ex: The kids are curious about everything in the old attic.

en: I’m deep in debt to the guild, I owe them ten thousand gold.
ru: Я по уши в долгах перед гильдией, должен им десять тысяч золота.
meaning: money that you owe to someone
ex: She finally cleared her debt after three years.

en: We live in a quiet suburb, about thirty minutes from the centre.
ru: Мы живём в тихом пригороде, примерно в тридцати минутах от центра.
meaning: An area on the edge of a city where people live.
ex: The game starts in a small suburb where nothing ever happens.

en: I’m taking an online course to learn how to edit videos.
ru: Я прохожу онлайн-курс, чтобы научиться монтировать видео.
meaning: a series of lessons on a subject
ex: He’s playing the new level like it’s a hard obstacle course.

en: We’re burning the midnight oil to finish the project before Friday.
ru: Мы засиживаемся допоздна, чтобы закончить проект до пятницы.
meaning: Work or study late into the night.
ex: Our team burned the midnight oil to unlock the last achievement before the event ended.

en: What did you get up to over the weekend?
ru: Чем вы занимались на выходных?
meaning: to do something, often something fun or naughty
ex: I don’t know what my squad gets up to when I’m offline.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Don’t throw away that box, I might need it.
ru: Не выбрасывай эту коробку, она мне может пригодиться.
meaning: to put something in the rubbish because you don’t want it
ex: Don’t throw away the old armor, you can sell it.

en: The company does business with many partners abroad.
ru: Компания ведёт дела со многими партнёрами за границей.
meaning: to work in trade or buy and sell things
ex: In this game you can do business with the traders in every town.

en: Calm down, chat, please ask your questions one at a time.
ru: Спокойнее, чат, задавайте вопросы по одному.
meaning: Separately, not together.
ex: Please come in one at a time, the room is very small.

en: In spite of the nerf, this hero is still very strong.
ru: Несмотря на ослабление, этот герой всё ещё очень сильный.
meaning: used to say something happened although there was a problem
ex: In spite of the cold, lots of people came to the market.

en: I’m in a good mood today, so let’s try the hard mode!
ru: Сегодня отличное настроение, так что давай попробуем сложный режим!
meaning: feeling happy and cheerful
ex: My mum is always in a good mood on weekends.

en: You owe me one for saving you in that fight.
ru: Ты мне должен за спасение в том бою.
meaning: to have to pay money back to someone
ex: I owe you twenty euros for the pizza.

en: This neighbourhood looks dangerous, so stay close to me.
ru: Этот район выглядит опасно, так что держись рядом со мной.
meaning: A part of a town where people live.
ex: It’s a friendly neighbourhood where everybody knows each other.

en: I have an exam on Friday, so I can’t stream this week.
ru: В пятницу у меня экзамен, так что на этой неделе стримов не будет.
meaning: a formal test of what you know
ex: We started a game right after the exam to relax.

expr: cost an arm and a leg
en: That rare skin is so expensive, it’ll cost an arm and a leg.
ru: Этот редкий скин такой дорогой, что обойдётся в целое состояние.
meaning: Be very expensive.
tr: стоить целое состояние, влететь в копеечку
ex: The new phone cost an arm and a leg, but we need it for work.
hint: c… a… a… a… a… l…

en: I don’t understand what you’re getting at.
ru: Не понимаю, к чему ты клонишь.
meaning: to try to say something in an indirect way
ex: Chat, I see what you’re getting at, but I’m not buying that skin.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Give me a minute to wake up before we start the stream.
ru: Дай мне минуту проснуться, прежде чем мы начнём стрим.
meaning: to stop sleeping
ex: I wake up at seven every day.

en: A few hours of games won’t do you any harm.
ru: Пара часов игр тебе не повредит.
meaning: to cause damage or bad effects
ex: Too much coffee can do harm to your sleep.

en: Run, the monster is right behind you!
ru: Беги, монстр прямо за тобой!
meaning: Very close, directly at your back.
ex: Don’t turn around, but there’s a dog right behind you.

en: The flight was delayed because of the fog.
ru: Рейс задержали из-за тумана.
meaning: used to give the reason for something
ex: We lost the match because of bad teamwork.

en: Wow, I’m amazed you pulled off that jump on the first try!
ru: Ничего себе, поражаюсь, что у тебя получился этот прыжок с первого раза!
meaning: very surprised, often in a good way
ex: We were amazed by how big the museum was.

en: Can you lend me some gold until the next quest?
ru: Можешь одолжить мне немного золота до следующего квеста?
meaning: to give something to someone for a short time
ex: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?

en: Use that tall tower as a landmark so we don’t get lost.
ru: Используй ту высокую башню как ориентир, чтобы мы не заблудились.
meaning: A building or object that is easy to recognize and helps you find your way.
ex: The cathedral is the best-known landmark in the city.

en: My boss asked me to work late again, so I’ll be online later.
ru: Начальник опять попросил задержаться, так что я зайду в сеть позже.
meaning: the person who is in charge of you at work
ex: This boss in the game has three phases and hits really hard.

en: Cross your fingers, the next chest might have the sword!
ru: Скрести пальцы, в следующем сундуке может быть меч!
meaning: Hope that something will go well.
ex: Cross your fingers for me, my job interview is tomorrow.

en: Go on, open the chest, I’m watching your back.
ru: Давай, открывай сундук, я прикрою.
meaning: to continue, or to do something now
ex: The meeting went on for three hours.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Did you guys sign up for the weekend tournament?
ru: Вы записались на турнир в выходные?
meaning: to put your name on a list to join something
ex: I want to sign up for a yoga class.

en: If you do the dishes, I’ll cook dinner tonight.
ru: Если ты помоешь посуду, я приготовлю ужин сегодня вечером.
meaning: to wash plates, cups and cutlery after a meal
ex: I’ll be back after I do the dishes, then we can play another round.

en: As you can see, we have almost no health left, so this will be tricky.
ru: Как видите, у нас почти не осталось здоровья, так что будет непросто.
meaning: Used to point out something obvious to the listener.
ex: As you can see, the kitchen is a mess, so please excuse it.

en: This map has many hiding spots, so that’s why I always pick a sniper here.
ru: На этой карте много укрытий, поэтому здесь всегда выбирают снайпера.
meaning: used to give the result of something
ex: I was tired, and that’s why I went to bed early.

en: Chat, we’re absolutely thrilled to reach ten thousand followers!
ru: Чат, мы просто в восторге от того, что нас уже десять тысяч подписчиков!
meaning: extremely happy and excited
ex: She was thrilled with the birthday present.

en: Can I borrow your sword? Mine just broke.
ru: Можно одолжить твой меч? Мой только что сломался.
meaning: to take something from someone and give it back later
ex: Can I borrow your charger for a minute?

en: Let’s leave before rush hour, or we’ll sit in the car for ages.
ru: Давай выедем до часа пик, а то будем сидеть в машине целую вечность.
meaning: The time of day when roads and trains are the busiest.
ex: The in-game traffic gets crazy during rush hour.

en: You can earn extra coins by finishing the daily quests.
ru: Ты можешь заработать дополнительные монеты, выполняя ежедневные квесты.
meaning: to get money for work, or to get something by effort
ex: She earns enough from her job to rent a small flat.

en: Don’t get your hopes up, the drop rate for that mount is tiny.
ru: Не обольщайся: шанс выпадения этого скакуна крошечный.
meaning: Don’t expect something good to happen too much.
ex: Don’t get your hopes up, the company may not call back.

en: We usually go out for dinner on Fridays.
ru: По пятницам мы обычно ходим куда-нибудь поужинать.
meaning: to leave home to do something social
ex: The lights go out and the monster appears.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I can’t log in, the server is down.
ru: Не могу войти, сервер лежит.
meaning: to enter a system with your username and password
ex: You need a password to log in to your account.

en: Wait, let me have a look at the map, I think we took a wrong turn.
ru: Подожди, дай мне взглянуть на карту, кажется, мы свернули не туда.
meaning: to look at something for a short time
ex: Let’s have a look at the apartment before we decide.

en: To be honest, chat, I think this level is way too hard.
ru: Честно говоря, чат, по-моему, этот уровень слишком сложный.
meaning: Used before saying what you really think.
ex: To be honest, I didn’t like the film very much.

en: He practised every day, and as a result he passed the exam.
ru: Он занимался каждый день и в результате сдал экзамен.
meaning: because of what was just said
ex: We ignored the healer, and as a result we lost the match.

en: I’m furious — the game crashed right before the final boss!
ru: Я в ярости: игра вылетела прямо перед финальным боссом!
meaning: extremely angry
ex: Dad was furious when he found the broken window.

en: We spent all our savings on the wedding.
ru: Мы потратили все наши сбережения на свадьбу.
meaning: money that you keep in a bank for the future
ex: I spent all my in-game savings on one legendary item.

en: There’s a huge traffic jam on the bridge, so take the side road.
ru: На мосту огромная пробка, так что поезжай по боковой дороге.
meaning: A long line of cars that move very slowly or not at all.
ex: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.

en: Let’s chat in the lobby while we wait for the others.
ru: Давай поболтаем в лобби, пока ждём остальных.
meaning: to talk in a friendly way, often online
ex: We often chat with colleagues over coffee in the kitchen.

en: Chat is getting out of hand, I’ll turn on slow mode.
ru: Чат выходит из-под контроля, я включу медленный режим.
meaning: Become difficult to control.
tr: выходить из-под контроля, зайти слишком далеко
ex: The party got out of hand and the neighbors called the police.

en: We have to go back to the last checkpoint, the key is still there.
ru: Нам придётся вернуться к последнему чекпоинту, ключ остался там.
meaning: to return to a place
ex: She wants to go back to university next year.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Everyone had to stand up when the teacher came in.
ru: Все должны были встать, когда вошёл учитель.
meaning: to rise from a sitting position
ex: My character can’t stand up after the stun.

en: We had a chat over coffee about our holiday plans.
ru: Мы за кофе поболтали о планах на отпуск.
meaning: to talk in a friendly and relaxed way
ex: The streamer had a chat with viewers before the match.

en: By the way, are the tickets booked already?
ru: Кстати, билеты уже заказаны?
meaning: Used to add a new or unrelated topic.
ex: By the way, chat, today’s stream will be longer than usual.

en: Our team has no tank; therefore, we should play more carefully.
ru: В нашей команде нет танка, поэтому нужно играть осторожнее.
meaning: for that reason, so
ex: The prices went up, therefore fewer people are buying.

en: I feel overwhelmed, there are too many enemies on the screen.
ru: Я просто теряюсь: слишком много врагов на экране.
meaning: feeling that you have too much to deal with
ex: She felt overwhelmed by all the emails after her holiday.

en: Her main income comes from freelance design.
ru: Её основной доход приходит от фриланс-дизайна.
meaning: money that a person earns from work or business
ex: Donations are not my main income, streaming is just a hobby.

en: The thieves’ guild is in the old district by the harbour.
ru: Гильдия воров находится в старом районе у гавани.
meaning: One part of a city or country.
ex: Which district of the city do you live in?

en: Are you online tonight, or do you have to work?
ru: Ты сегодня вечером будешь в сети или тебе надо работать?
meaning: connected to the internet
ex: He does all his shopping online these days.

en: Our support team goes the extra mile and always answers within minutes.
ru: Наша служба поддержки выкладывается по полной и всегда отвечает за считаные минуты.
meaning: Make more effort than people expect.
tr: выложиться по полной, сделать больше обычного
ex: He went the extra mile and built a custom map for the community.

en: My headache just won’t go away.
ru: Моя головная боль никак не проходит.
meaning: to leave, or to stop existing
ex: Don’t go away, the match starts in a minute.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I’ll pay you back on Monday, I promise.
ru: Я верну тебе деньги в понедельник, обещаю.
meaning: to return money you borrowed
ex: I’ll pay you back for the revive by sharing my loot.

en: We’re not here to win, we’re here to have fun!
ru: Мы здесь не ради победы, а чтобы повеселиться!
meaning: to enjoy yourself
ex: Have fun at the party tonight!

en: If you need help with the project, feel free to call me.
ru: Если нужна помощь с проектом, смело звони мне.
meaning: You have my permission; do not hesitate to.
ex: Feel free to type your questions in the chat, I’ll read them.

en: He said the project needs more time, in other words, it’s late.
ru: Он сказал, что проекту нужно больше времени, другими словами, он опаздывает.
meaning: used to say the same thing in a simpler way
ex: This skill resets after a kill; in other words, you can use it again and again.

en: The last minute was so tense, I couldn’t even breathe.
ru: Последняя минута была такой напряжённой, что я даже дышать не мог.
meaning: nervous and unable to relax, or full of worry
ex: The atmosphere at the family dinner was tense.

en: His salary goes up every year.
ru: Его зарплата растёт каждый год.
meaning: money that you get every month from your job
ex: In this game you pay your workers a salary every day.

en: The centre is really busy on weekends, so we usually stay home.
ru: В центре по выходным очень оживлённо, поэтому мы обычно сидим дома.
meaning: Full of people, cars or activity.
ex: The server is busy, so the queue is long.

en: This new technology makes the graphics look almost real.
ru: Эта новая технология делает графику почти как настоящую.
meaning: machines and methods made with science
ex: Modern technology helps people work from home.

en: Hang in there, we’re almost at the checkpoint!
ru: Держись, мы почти у контрольной точки!
meaning: Don’t give up in a difficult time.
ex: Hang in there, the exam week ends on Friday.

en: The bomb goes off in ten seconds, run!
ru: Бомба взорвётся через десять секунд, бегите!
meaning: to explode, ring, or make a loud sound
ex: My alarm goes off at five every day.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Hey, give my sword back, that’s mine!
ru: Эй, верни мой меч, он мой!
meaning: to return something to its owner
ex: Please give back the book when you finish it.

en: You look tired, why don’t you have a rest before the trip?
ru: Ты выглядишь усталым, почему бы тебе не отдохнуть перед поездкой?
meaning: to stop working and relax
ex: Let’s have a rest after this level, my hands hurt.

en: If you want a longer video, let me know in the comments.
ru: Если хотите видео подлиннее, дайте знать в комментариях.
meaning: Tell me, so that I know.
ex: Let me know when you get home safely.

en: What I mean is, don’t rush in without a plan.
ru: Я хочу сказать, что не стоит лезть вперёд без плана.
meaning: used to explain your idea more clearly
tr: я имею в виду, хочу сказать
ex: What I mean is that we should talk to her first.

en: We’re determined to finish this level tonight, no matter how long it takes.
ru: Мы настроены пройти этот уровень сегодня вечером, сколько бы это ни заняло.
meaning: having decided to do something and refusing to stop
ex: He’s determined to learn English this year.

en: Repairing armor is a huge expense in this game.
ru: Ремонт брони в этой игре — огромная статья расходов.
meaning: money that you have to spend on something
ex: Rent is our biggest monthly expense.

en: Let’s try some local food instead of eating in a chain restaurant.
ru: Давай попробуем местную еду, а не будем есть в сетевом ресторане.
meaning: Belonging to the place where you are.
ex: Ask a local, they know where the secret shop is.

en: This program records my screen and my voice at the same time.
ru: Эта программа записывает мой экран и голос одновременно.
meaning: a set of instructions that makes a computer do something
ex: I use a program to count my expenses every month.

expr: hit the nail on the head
en: You hit the nail on the head, the boss is weak against fire!
ru: Ты попал в точку: босс слаб к огню!
meaning: Say exactly the right thing.
tr: попасть в точку, сказать в самую суть
ex: She hit the nail on the head when she said we need a day off.
hint: h… t… n… o… t… h…

en: Go ahead, I’ll cover you from behind.
ru: Иди вперёд, я прикрою сзади.
meaning: to start doing something, or to move forward first
ex: Go ahead and sit down, I’ll bring some tea.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: They broke up last month after three years together.
ru: Они расстались в прошлом месяце после трёх лет вместе.
meaning: to end a relationship or separate into parts
ex: The old team broke up after losing the finals.

en: We had an argument about which map to play, but now it’s fine.
ru: Мы поспорили о том, на какой карте играть, но сейчас всё в порядке.
meaning: to talk angrily with someone who disagrees with you
ex: They had an argument about money last night.

en: If you liked the stream, leave a comment and tell me your favourite part.
ru: Если стрим понравился, оставьте комментарий и расскажите о любимом моменте.
meaning: To write a short message under a post or video.
ex: Please leave a comment on the form if the service was slow.

en: It was a nice trip, I mean, apart from the food.
ru: Поездка была хорошей, то есть, если не считать еду.
meaning: used to explain or correct what you just said
tr: то есть, я имею в виду
ex: It’s a fun game, I mean, the story is boring, but the fights are great.

en: He’s a top player, but he stays humble and always helps beginners.
ru: Он топовый игрок, но остаётся скромным и всегда помогает новичкам.
meaning: not thinking that you are better than other people
ex: She is a famous doctor, but very humble.

en: There’s a small fee if you cancel the booking.
ru: Если отменить бронь, придётся заплатить небольшую комиссию.
meaning: an amount of money you pay for a service
ex: The game takes a fee every time you trade with another player.

en: The raid starts at eight, so please be on time today.
ru: Рейд начинается в восемь, так что, пожалуйста, не опаздывайте сегодня.
meaning: At the planned time, not late.
ex: The train left on time this morning.

en: My keyboard is so loud that people on voice chat complain.
ru: Моя клавиатура такая шумная, что люди в голосовом чате жалуются.
meaning: a set of keys you press to type on a computer
ex: I spilled tea on my keyboard and now two keys don’t work.

en: We’re all in the same boat, nobody has enough gold.
ru: Мы все в одной лодке: ни у кого не хватает золота.
meaning: In the same difficult situation as others.
tr: в одной лодке, в одинаковом положении
ex: Don’t worry about the rent, a lot of us are in the same boat.

en: I’m going through a hard time at work right now.
ru: Сейчас я переживаю трудный период на работе.
meaning: to experience something difficult or unpleasant
ex: We went through every room, but the key wasn’t there.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The sign says keep out, so we can’t enter.
ru: На табличке написано не входить, так что нам нельзя.
meaning: to stay outside and not enter
ex: Keep out of the red zone, it’s poison.

en: Everyone had a good time at the picnic last weekend.
ru: Все хорошо провели время на пикнике в прошлые выходные.
meaning: to enjoy yourself
ex: We had a good time playing co-op last night.

en: Hi everyone, thanks for joining us, we’re starting in a minute.
ru: Всем привет, спасибо, что присоединились, начинаем через минуту.
meaning: Polite words to people who came to watch or take part.
ex: Thanks for joining us at the meeting, please sit anywhere.

en: It seems to me that the second boss is easier than the first.
ru: Мне кажется, что второй босс легче первого.
meaning: used to give a careful opinion
ex: It seems to me that he’s not very happy at work.

en: Don’t be arrogant — one win doesn’t make you the best.
ru: Не будь высокомерным: одна победа ещё не делает тебя лучшим.
meaning: believing that you are better than other people
ex: Nobody likes an arrogant colleague who never listens.

en: These potions are totally overpriced, so I’ll craft my own.
ru: Эти зелья совершенно завышены в цене, так что сварю свои.
meaning: too expensive for what you get
ex: The coffee at the airport is overpriced.

en: Run! We have to reach the gate in time, or the quest fails.
ru: Бежим! Нужно добраться до ворот вовремя, иначе квест провален.
meaning: Early enough to do something before it is too late.
ex: We got to the station just in time to catch the last train.

en: The video quality is bad, so try lowering the stream settings.
ru: Качество видео плохое, поэтому попробуй понизить настройки стрима.
meaning: how good or bad something is
ex: We chose this supplier because of the high quality of the goods.

en: Just press the button when the light turns green. It’s not rocket science.
ru: Просто нажми кнопку, когда загорится зелёный. Это не высшая математика.
meaning: It is not difficult to understand.
tr: это не высшая математика, ничего сложного
ex: Setting up the router is not rocket science, just follow the video.

en: Let’s go over the plan once more before we leave.
ru: Давайте ещё раз пройдёмся по плану, прежде чем уйдём.
meaning: to check or review something carefully
ex: Let’s go over the strategy before the final round.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Let’s warm up with a few easy matches first.
ru: Давайте сначала разомнёмся парой лёгких матчей.
meaning: to prepare your body or skills before an activity
ex: Always warm up before you go for a run.

en: I’ve never played this class, but let me have a go.
ru: Этим классом мне ещё не приходилось играть, но дай попробовать.
meaning: to try to do something
ex: He had a go at cooking sushi for the first time.

en: Chat says our character looks like a potato, that’s hilarious.
ru: Чат пишет, что наш герой похож на картошку, это так смешно.
meaning: That is extremely funny.
ex: That’s hilarious, the cat just tried to jump into the empty box.

en: I tend to think that simple plans work best.
ru: Обычно склоняются к мысли, что простые планы работают лучше всего.
meaning: I usually have the opinion that
ex: I tend to think that stealth is better than a direct attack.

en: Our team leader is a bit bossy, but he usually has a good plan.
ru: Наш капитан немного командует, но обычно у него хороший план.
meaning: always telling other people what to do
ex: My older sister is bossy and tells me what to wear.

en: We bought a second-hand sofa and it’s perfect.
ru: Мы купили подержанный диван, и он отличный.
meaning: not new; already used by someone else
ex: In this market you can sell second-hand gear to other players.

en: I’ll post my stream schedule in the chat tonight.
ru: Сегодня вечером я выложу в чате расписание своих стримов.
meaning: A plan that lists when things will happen.
ex: My work schedule changes every week.

en: If someone is rude in chat, just block them.
ru: Если кто-то грубит в чате, просто заблокируй его.
meaning: to stop someone from contacting you online
ex: Please block that website, it is full of ads.

en: You lost one round. Let it go and focus on the next one.
ru: Ты проиграл один раунд. Отпусти это и сосредоточься на следующем.
meaning: Stop being angry or worried about something.
ex: It was a small mistake, so let it go.

en: I’m going to go for the headshot, cover me.
ru: Я попробую сделать хедшот, прикройте меня.
meaning: to choose something, or try to get it
ex: I’ll go for the pasta, what about you?
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We need to clean up the kitchen before the guests arrive.
ru: Нужно прибраться на кухне, пока не пришли гости.
meaning: to make a place tidy
ex: I’ll clean up the last enemies while you open the chest.

en: Her advice had an impact on my career.
ru: Её совет сильно повлиял на мою карьеру.
meaning: to have a strong effect on something
ex: Every choice in this game has an impact on the ending.

en: We’ll never finish this level. Just kidding, we’re almost there!
ru: Мы никогда не пройдём этот уровень. Шучу, мы почти у цели!
meaning: Said to show that you were not serious.
ex: I’m moving to Mars next week. Just kidding!

en: I’d say this is the best game of the year so far.
ru: По-моему, это лучшая игра года на данный момент.
meaning: used to give an opinion in a careful way
ex: I’d say the party was a success.

en: You can count on us, we’ll be online at eight sharp.
ru: Ты можешь на нас рассчитывать: мы будем в сети ровно в восемь.
meaning: to be sure that someone will do what you need
ex: I’m counting on you to bring the tickets.

en: There was a long queue at the supermarket.
ru: В супермаркете стояла длинная очередь.
meaning: a line of people waiting for something
ex: We’ve been in the queue for the server for twenty minutes.

en: The event has a deadline, so we need to finish it by Sunday.
ru: У ивента есть крайний срок, так что нужно закончить его до воскресенья.
meaning: The latest time by which something must be done.
ex: I have a deadline on Friday for the report.

en: Send me the link and I’ll join your game right away.
ru: Скинь мне ссылку, и я сразу зайду в твою игру.
meaning: a web address you can click
ex: I’ll add the link to the report in the email.

en: If you don’t buy tickets for the tournament now, you’ll miss the boat.
ru: Если не купишь билеты на турнир сейчас, упустишь шанс.
meaning: Lose a chance by being too slow.
ex: I missed the boat on that cheap flight, and now it costs double.

en: Prices have gone up a lot since last year.
ru: С прошлого года цены сильно выросли.
meaning: to increase or rise
ex: Your level goes up every time you finish a quest.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: The teacher is giving out the exam papers.
ru: Учитель раздаёт экзаменационные листы.
meaning: to hand something to each person in a group
ex: The game gives out free coins every day.

en: Should we take a risk and open the chest without checking for traps?
ru: Рискнём и откроем сундук, не проверяя на ловушки?
meaning: to do something that might have a bad result
ex: He took a risk and left his job to start a business.

en: Don’t panic, we still have two lives left.
ru: Без паники, у нас ещё две жизни.
meaning: Do not become frightened and lose control.
ex: Don’t panic, the keys are probably in your other bag.

en: From my point of view, working from home is more productive.
ru: С моей точки зрения, работать из дома продуктивнее.
meaning: used to say how you see something
ex: From my point of view, the ranked mode is too stressful.

en: Don’t blame the new guy, we all made mistakes in that fight.
ru: Не вини новичка, мы все ошибались в этом бою.
meaning: to say that someone did something bad or is responsible for it
ex: You can’t blame him for the traffic.

en: The checkout is on the left, next to the exit.
ru: Касса находится слева, рядом с выходом.
meaning: the place in a shop where you pay
ex: Add the item to your cart and go to checkout.

en: It took a while, but eventually we found the right bus.
ru: Это заняло время, но в итоге мы нашли нужный автобус.
meaning: After a long time, or after a lot of effort.
ex: Keep searching, and eventually you’ll find the hidden key.

en: I’ll send you an email with the details after the meeting.
ru: После встречи отправлю тебе письмо с подробностями.
meaning: a message sent over the internet
ex: He checks his email first thing in the morning.

en: I’m still on the fence about buying the expansion.
ru: Я всё ещё сомневаюсь, покупать ли дополнение.
meaning: Not able to decide.
ex: She’s on the fence about moving to another city.

en: Our server keeps going down every time lots of viewers join.
ru: Наш сервер постоянно падает, когда заходит много зрителей.
meaning: to become lower, or to stop working
ex: The temperature will go down tonight.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: We set off early to avoid the traffic.
ru: Мы выехали пораньше, чтобы не попасть в пробки.
meaning: to begin a journey; to make something start working
ex: Be careful not to set off the alarm in the vault.

en: Let’s take a break, my coffee is cold and my eyes hurt.
ru: Давай сделаем перерыв, мой кофе остыл, и глаза болят.
meaning: to stop for a short rest
ex: You should take a break every hour if you work at a computer.

en: Stay calm and watch the boss’s pattern.
ru: Сохраняй спокойствие и следи за движениями босса.
meaning: Do not get nervous or angry.
ex: Stay calm and call the number on the card.

en: As for me, I always take the shield.
ru: Что касается меня, я всегда беру щит.
meaning: used to give your own view after others
ex: As for me, I’d rather take the train.

en: My friends tease me because I always pick the cutest character.
ru: Друзья подшучивают надо мной за то, что я всегда выбираю самого милого персонажа.
meaning: to make friendly jokes about someone, often to annoy them a little
ex: Her brothers tease her about her new haircut.

en: Sadly, the rare armor isn’t in stock today.
ru: К сожалению, редкой брони сегодня нет в наличии.
meaning: available to buy in a shop
ex: Do you have this shirt in stock in a larger size?

en: The train is late, so in the meantime let’s get some coffee.
ru: Поезд опаздывает, так что пока давай возьмём кофе.
meaning: During the time before something else happens.
ex: The boss respawns in ten minutes, so in the meantime let’s craft some potions.

en: The result of the match surprised everyone in chat.
ru: Результат матча удивил всех в чате.
meaning: something that happens because of something else
ex: The test results will be ready in two days.

en: Are you serious or are you pulling my leg? You really beat it in one hour?
ru: Ты серьёзно или разыгрываешь меня? Ты правда прошёл это за час?
meaning: Joke with someone by saying something untrue.
ex: Stop pulling my leg, I know you didn’t win the lottery.

en: I’ll go along with your plan, but doubts remain.
ru: Я поддержу твой план, хотя сомнения остаются.
meaning: to agree with someone’s idea or plan
ex: The team went along with my idea to rush the tower.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: I want to be a pilot when I grow up.
ru: Я хочу стать пилотом, когда вырасту.
meaning: to change from a child into an adult
ex: He grew up playing arcade games.

en: If we take a chance and go for the final boss now, we might win.
ru: Если мы рискнём и пойдём на финального босса сейчас, то можем выиграть.
meaning: to try something even though it may fail
ex: She took a chance and applied for the job abroad.

en: Before you speak on stage, take a deep breath.
ru: Перед выступлением на сцене сделай глубокий вдох.
meaning: Breathe in slowly to relax.
ex: Take a deep breath, the last jump is the hardest one.

en: Personally, I’d choose the cheaper hotel.
ru: Лично мне ближе отель подешевле.
meaning: used to say this is your own opinion
ex: Personally, I think the new skin looks great.

en: Thanks for the compliment, chat, but we just got lucky.
ru: Спасибо за комплимент, чат, но нам просто повезло.
meaning: a kind thing you say to praise someone
ex: He paid me a compliment on my cooking.

en: The concert tickets are sold out already.
ru: Билеты на концерт уже распроданы.
meaning: with no more left to buy
ex: The limited skin is sold out, so wait for the next season.

en: We need to leave this area as soon as possible, a storm is coming.
ru: Нам нужно покинуть эту зону как можно скорее: надвигается буря.
meaning: As quickly as you can.
ex: Please call me back as soon as possible.

en: Our customer wants the website to be ready by Monday.
ru: Наш клиент хочет, чтобы сайт был готов к понедельнику.
meaning: a person who buys goods or services
ex: A shop in the game lets each customer pick one free item.

en: Take it easy, the boss only has ten percent health left.
ru: Спокойнее, у босса осталось всего десять процентов здоровья.
meaning: Relax; don’t worry or work too hard.
ex: Take it easy this weekend and just rest.

en: We’ll have to go without a healer tonight, he’s offline.
ru: Сегодня придётся обойтись без хилера, его нет в сети.
meaning: to manage when you do not have something
ex: I can go without coffee, but not without sleep.
topic: Фразовые глаголы: get, go, come, take, put, look

en: Please sit down, dinner is ready.
ru: Пожалуйста, садитесь, ужин готов.
meaning: to move into a sitting position
ex: Everyone, sit down on the couch, the final round is starting.

en: He should take responsibility for the mistakes in his report.
ru: Он должен взять на себя ответственность за ошибки в своём отчёте.
meaning: to accept that something is your duty or fault
ex: As team leader, you must take responsibility for the loss in the final round.

en: The bus left already? Better luck next time.
ru: Автобус уже ушёл? В следующий раз повезёт больше.
meaning: Said to someone who failed, hoping they win later.
ex: Better luck next time, we’ll get the chest on the next run.

en: Easy? I wouldn’t say that, this level took an hour.
ru: Лёгкий? Не сказал бы, этот уровень занял час.
meaning: used to politely disagree
tr: не сказал бы, не стал бы так говорить
ex: I wouldn’t say that he’s lazy; he just works slowly.

en: Sorry, we don’t want to let the team down, so we’ll practice more.
ru: Извини, мы не хотим подвести команду, поэтому будем больше тренироваться.
meaning: to disappoint someone by not doing what they expected
ex: I never want to let my family down.

en: The delivery should arrive tomorrow morning.
ru: Доставка должна прийти завтра утром.
meaning: the act of bringing goods to someone’s home
ex: Delivery of your in-game items is instant.

en: I can’t join at the moment, the update is still downloading.
ru: Сейчас я не могу присоединиться: обновление ещё скачивается.
meaning: Right now, at this time.
ex: I’m at work at the moment, can I call you later?

en: Let’s do some training in the practice mode before the real match.
ru: Давай потренируемся в тренировочном режиме перед настоящим матчем.
meaning: teaching or learning a skill or job
ex: The company gives new staff a week of training.

en: Don’t take it for granted that the server will always be free.
